# load the data
```{r}
counts<-Read10X(data.dir = "GSE288579_filtered_feature_bc_matrix/filtered_feature_bc_matrix")
h5.dat<-Read10X_h5(filename = "GSE288579_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")

rna_counts <- h5.dat$`Gene Expression`
atac_counts <- h5.dat$Peaks
rm(h5.dat)

sc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = rna_counts)
sc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(sc, pattern = "^mt-")
rm(rna_counts)
```

```{r}
peak.ref <- StringToGRanges(rownames(atac_counts), sep = c(":", "-"))
seqlevelsStyle(peak.ref)='UCSC'
grange.use <- seqnames(peak.ref) %in% c(c(standardChromosomes(peak.ref),'chrM')) # chr1-19, chrX, chrY, chrM
atac_counts <- atac_counts[as.vector(grange.use), ]
peak.ref <- StringToGRanges(rownames(atac_counts), sep = c(":", "-"))
peak.ref
rm(grange.use)


# Gene annotation for mm10
gene.ref <- genes(EnsDb.Mmusculus.v79)
genome(gene.ref)='mm10'
seqlevels(gene.ref) <- str_replace(string=paste("chr",seqlevels(gene.ref),sep=""), pattern="chrMT", replacement="chrM") # change to UCSC style
gene.ref=gene.ref[seqnames(gene.ref) %in% c(c(standardChromosomes(peak.ref),'chrM')),]

sc = sc[rownames(sc) %in% gene.ref$gene_name,]
gene.ref=gene.ref[match(rownames(sc), gene.ref$gene_name)]

dim(sc); length(gene.ref)
dim(atac_counts); length(peak.ref)
```

```{r}
temp=unlist(strsplit(colnames(sc),'-'))
temp=as.numeric(temp[seq(2, length(temp),2)])
table(temp)
group=factor(c('WT6','KO1','WT3','WT4','WT1','WT5','WT2','KO2')[temp])
ZT=factor(c('ZT22','ZT06','ZT10','ZT14','ZT02','ZT18','ZT06','ZT18')[temp])
rm(temp)
meta.data=data.frame(group, ZT)
rownames(meta.data)=colnames(sc)
sc=AddMetaData(sc, meta.data)
rm(group, meta.data, ZT)
```

```{r}
sc <- subset(
  x = sc,
  subset = nCount_ATAC < 1e5 &
    nCount_ATAC > 1e3 &
    nFeature_ATAC > 500 &
    nCount_RNA < 1e5 &
    nCount_RNA > 1e3 &
    nFeature_RNA > 500 &
    percent.mt < 5
)

```

```{r}
sce.rna <- SingleCellExperiment(list(counts=sc@assays$RNA@counts))
sce.rna <- scDblFinder(sce.rna, samples = sc$group, dbr = 0.005)
table(sce.rna$scDblFinder.class, sc$group)

# https://plger.github.io/scDblFinder/articles/scATAC.html
sce.atac <- SingleCellExperiment(list(counts=sc@assays$ATAC@counts))
sce.atac <- scDblFinder(sce.atac, samples = sc$group, aggregateFeatures=TRUE, nfeatures=100, dbr = 0.005) # Using the top 1000 features
table(sce.atac$scDblFinder.class, sc$group)

sc=sc[,!(sce.rna$scDblFinder.class=='doublet' & sce.atac$scDblFinder.class =='doublet')]
rm(sce.atac, sce.rna)

#######################################
# At least ~0.1% of cells expressing the gene or have peak accessibility
#######################################
rna_counts=sc@assays$RNA@counts
atac_counts=sc@assays$ATAC@counts

cell.filter=(ncol(rna_counts)*0.001)
rna_counts_temp=rna_counts>0
gene.ref=gene.ref[rowSums(rna_counts_temp)>cell.filter ]
rna_counts=rna_counts[rowSums(rna_counts_temp)>cell.filter,]
rm(rna_counts_temp)

atac_counts_temp=atac_counts>0
peak.ref=peak.ref[rowSums(atac_counts_temp)>cell.filter]
atac_counts=atac_counts[rowSums(atac_counts_temp)>cell.filter,]
rm(atac_counts_temp, cell.filter)
```

```{r,include=FALSE}
# RNA analysis
DefaultAssay(sc) <- "RNA"
sc <- SCTransform(sc, verbose = FALSE, return.only.var.genes = FALSE) %>% RunPCA() %>% RunUMAP(dims = 1:50, reduction.name = 'umap.rna', reduction.key = 'rnaUMAP_')

# ATAC analysis
# We exclude the first dimension as this is typically correlated with sequencing depth
DefaultAssay(sc) <- "ATAC"
sc <- RunTFIDF(sc)
sc <- FindTopFeatures(sc, min.cutoff = 'q0')
sc <- RunSVD(sc)
sc <- RunUMAP(sc, reduction = 'lsi', dims = 2:50, reduction.name = "umap.atac", reduction.key = "atacUMAP_")

DefaultAssay(sc)<-"SCT"
sc<-RunHarmony(sc,reduction.use = "pca",
               group.by.vars="group",
               dims.use = 1:20,
               plot_convergence=F,
               reduction.save = "harmony.rna")
DefaultAssay(sc)<-"ATAC"
sc<-RunHarmony(sc,reduction.use = "lsi", 
               dims.use = 2:20,assay.use = "ATAC",
               plot_convergence=F,project.dim = FALSE,
               group.by.vars="group",reduction.save = "harmony.atac")

sc <- FindMultiModalNeighbors(sc, reduction.list = list("harmony.rna", "harmony.atac"), dims.list = list(1:8, 2:8))
sc <- RunUMAP(sc, nn.name = "weighted.nn", 
              reduction.name = "wnn.umap", 
              reduction.key = "wnnUMAP_",
              min.dist = 0.3,n.neighbors = 30L)
sc <- FindClusters(sc, graph.name = "wsnn", algorithm = 3, verbose = FALSE,resolution = 0.1)
```

```{r}
                              "4" = "Endothelial")

                              "5" = "Fibroblasts")

                              "6" = "Kupffer cells")
```

```{r}
names(scliver@assays)
```

#level3 module
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
})
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_result_param_scRhythm_phase2.Rdata")
source("../R/infer_rhythm_module.R")
out_dir <- "outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018"

param_wide <- res_param_liver2$param_wide

module_result_file <- file.path(out_dir, "scCircadianliver_result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV.Rdata")
if (file.exists(module_result_file)) {
  load(module_result_file)
} else {
  res2_module <- infer_rhythm_module(
    param_wide = param_wide,
    compare_by = "celltype",
    group1 = "Hep.CV",
    group2 = "Hep.PV",
    out_dir = out_dir
  )
  save(res2_module, file = module_result_file)
}
stopifnot(identical(unique(as.character(res2_module$module_result$group1)), "Hep.CV"),
          identical(unique(as.character(res2_module$module_result$group2)), "Hep.PV"))
table(res2_module$module_result$module_map)
res2_module$comparison
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
source("external/analysis_helpers/module_heatmap_new.R")
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_object_celltype_use.Rdata")

DefaultAssay(obj_use) <- "RNA"

cell_meta <- obj_use@meta.data
cell_meta$celltype <- as.character(cell_meta$celltype)
cell_meta$theta_pred <- res_phase_liver$theta_pred[match(rownames(cell_meta), res_phase_liver$cell)]
```

#moduel upsetplot
```{r}
rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(UpSetR)
})

# Step 0. IO

infile <- "outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/scCircadianliver_result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV.Rdata"
out_dir <- "outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/final_module_upset"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

load(infile)

# Step 1. Prepare final module membership

module_df <- res2_module$module_result %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, module_map, module_name) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene), !is.na(module_map)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(module_map = paste0("Module", module_map)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, module_map, .keep_all = TRUE)

module_count <- module_df %>%
  dplyr::count(module_map, name = "n_genes") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_genes))

modules_all <- module_count$module_map

readr::write_tsv(
  module_count,
  file.path(out_dir, "final_module_gene_count.tsv")
)

print(module_count)

# Step 2. Build incidence matrix

all_genes <- sort(unique(module_df$gene))
incidence_df <- tibble::tibble(gene = all_genes)

for (m in modules_all) {
  incidence_df[[m]] <- as.integer(
    all_genes %in% module_df$gene[module_df$module_map == m]
  )
}

readr::write_tsv(
  incidence_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "final_module_incidence_matrix.tsv")
)

# Step 3. Check final module assignment

final_assignment_check <- incidence_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(n_modules = rowSums(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(modules_all)))) %>%
  dplyr::count(n_modules, name = "n_genes")

readr::write_tsv(
  final_assignment_check,
  file.path(out_dir, "final_module_assignment_check.tsv")
)

print(final_assignment_check)

# Step 4. UpSet input

upset_df <- incidence_df %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(modules_all)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Step 5. PDF

cairo_pdf(
  file.path(out_dir, "UpSet_final_module_assignment.pdf"),
  width = 12,
  height = 7
)

UpSetR::upset(
  upset_df,
  sets = modules_all,
  keep.order = TRUE,
  order.by = "freq",
  nsets = length(modules_all),
  nintersects = NA,
  sets.bar.color = "grey35",
  main.bar.color = "black",
  matrix.color = "black",
  point.size = 3.2,
  line.size = 1,
  mb.ratio = c(0.65, 0.35),
  text.scale = c(1.5, 1.3, 1.3, 1.1, 1.4, 1.1),
  mainbar.y.label = "Intersection size",
  sets.x.label = "Module size"
)

dev.off()

# Step 6. PNG

png(
  file.path(out_dir, "UpSet_final_module_assignment.png"),
  width = 3200,
  height = 1900,
  res = 300
)

UpSetR::upset(
  upset_df,
  sets = modules_all,
  keep.order = TRUE,
  order.by = "freq",
  nsets = length(modules_all),
  nintersects = NA,
  sets.bar.color = "grey35",

  text.scale = c(1.5, 1.3, 1.3, 1.1, 1.4, 1.1),
  mainbar.y.label = "Intersection size",

)

dev.off()
```

```{r}
  genes_use <- module_gene_list[[as.character(module_id)]] %>%

      status = "no_genes"

    next
  }
  
  ego_bp <- tryCatch(
    enrichGO(
      gene          = genes_use,
      OrgDb         = org.Mm.eg.db,
      ont           = "BP",

      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,

  )

      module_id = module_id,
      focus_celltype = focus_celltype,
      module_label = module_label,
      n_genes = length(genes_use),
      n_terms_raw_p_lt_0_05 = 0,
      n_terms_padj_lt_0_05 = 0,
      status = "enrichGO_failed"
    )
    next
  }
  
  res_bp <- ego_bp@result %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  if (nrow(res_bp) == 0) {
    summary_list[[as.character(module_id)]] <- tibble(
      module_id = module_id,
      focus_celltype = focus_celltype,
      module_label = module_label,
      n_genes = length(genes_use),
      n_terms_raw_p_lt_0_05 = 0,
      n_terms_padj_lt_0_05 = 0,
      status = "no_terms"
    )
    next
  }
  
  top10 <- res_bp %>%
    arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10) %>%
    mutate(
      Description_wrapped = stringr::str_wrap(Description, width = 30),
      neglog10_pval = -log10(pvalue),
      rank_raw = rank(p.adjust, ties.method = "first"),
      color_rank_plot = max(rank_raw) - rank_raw + 1
    )
  
  legend_breaks <- seq(
    min(top10$color_rank_plot),
    max(top10$color_rank_plot),
    length.out = 5
  )
  
  legend_labels <- round(
    seq(
      min(top10$neglog10_pval),
      max(top10$neglog10_pval),
      length.out = 5
    ),
    2
  )
  
  p_go <- ggplot(
    top10,
    aes(
      x = Count,
      y = reorder(Description_wrapped, neglog10_pval),
      fill = color_rank_plot
    )
  ) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_viridis(
      option    = "plasma",
      direction = 1,
      name      = "-log10(pvalue)",
      breaks    = legend_breaks,
      labels    = legend_labels
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Top 10 Enriched GO:BP (Module ", module_id, ")"),
      subtitle = paste0(focus_celltype, " | ", module_label),
      x = "Gene Count",
      y = "GO Biological Process"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
  plot.title    = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
  plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
  axis.title.x  = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
  axis.title.y  = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold"),
  axis.text.x   = element_text(size = 14),
  axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
  legend.title  = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
  legend.text   = element_text(size = 12)
)
  
  print(p_go)
  
  write_tsv(
    res_bp,
    file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0(
        focus_celltype, "_module", module_id, "_",
        module_label, "_GO_BP_full.tsv"
      )
    )
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0(
        focus_celltype, "_module", module_id, "_",
        module_label, "_GO_BP_top10.png"
      )
    ),
    plot = p_go,
    width = 9,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0(
        focus_celltype, "_module", module_id, "_",
        module_label, "_GO_BP_top10.pdf"
      )
    ),
    plot = p_go,
    width = 8,
    height = 8
  )
  
  summary_list[[as.character(module_id)]] <- tibble(
    module_id = module_id,
    focus_celltype = focus_celltype,
    module_label = module_label,
    n_genes = length(genes_use),
    n_terms_raw_p_lt_0_05 = sum(res_bp$pvalue < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_terms_padj_lt_0_05 = sum(res_bp$p.adjust < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    status = "ok"
  )
```

```{r}
rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({

load("outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/scCircadianliver_result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_countmat.Rdata")

out_dir <- "outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/Reactome_module"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 1. 当前 module 结果
module_result <- res2_module$module_result

# 2. 背景基因：去掉 M0
universe_genes <- module_result %>%
  dplyr::filter(module_map != 0) %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
  unique() %>%
  intersect(rownames(count_mat))

length(universe_genes)

# 3. 每个 module 的 gene list
module_gene_list <- split(module_result$gene, module_result$module_map)

str(module_gene_list)

# 4. module 生物学解释
module_info <- tibble::tribble(
  ~module_id, ~focus_celltype, ~module_label,
  1, "Shared", "Stable_Rhythm",
  2, "Hep.PV", "Rhythm_Gain",
  3, "Hep.CV", "Rhythm_Loss_in_Hep.PV",
  4, "Hep.PV", "Amplitude_Enhanced",
  5, "Hep.PV", "Amplitude_Attenuated",
  6, "Hep.PV", "Phase_Advanced",
  7, "Hep.PV", "Phase_Delayed"
)

module_info


#ENTREZID
universe_map <- bitr(
  universe_genes,
  fromType = "SYMBOL",
  toType   = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb    = org.Mm.eg.db
)

universe_entrez <- unique(universe_map$ENTREZID)

length(universe_genes)
length(universe_entrez)

summary_list <- list()

reactome_list <- list()
# Step 4. for 循环跑 module 1–7

for (i in seq_len(nrow(module_info))) {
  
  module_id <- module_info$module_id[i]
  focus_celltype <- module_info$focus_celltype[i]
  module_label <- module_info$module_label[i]
  
  message("Running Reactome for module ", module_id, " ...")
  

  # 4.1 当前 module 的 SYMBOL 基因

  genes_symbol <- module_gene_list[[as.character(module_id)]] %>%
    unique() %>%
    intersect(universe_genes)
  
  if (length(genes_symbol) == 0) {
    summary_list[[as.character(module_id)]] <- tibble(
      module_id = module_id,
      focus_celltype = focus_celltype,
      module_label = module_label,
      n_genes_symbol = 0,
      n_genes_entrez = 0,
      n_terms_raw_p_lt_0_05 = 0,
      n_terms_padj_lt_0_05 = 0,
      status = "no_genes"
    )
    next
  }
  

  # 4.2 SYMBOL -> ENTREZ

  gene_map <- tryCatch(
    bitr(
      genes_symbol,
      fromType = "SYMBOL",
      toType   = "ENTREZID",
      OrgDb    = org.Mm.eg.db
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(gene_map) || nrow(gene_map) == 0) {
    summary_list[[as.character(module_id)]] <- tibble(
      module_id = module_id,
      focus_celltype = focus_celltype,
      module_label = module_label,
      n_genes_symbol = length(genes_symbol),
      n_genes_entrez = 0,
      n_terms_raw_p_lt_0_05 = 0,
      n_terms_padj_lt_0_05 = 0,
      status = "symbol_to_entrez_failed"
    )
    next
  }
  
  genes_entrez <- unique(gene_map$ENTREZID)
  

  # 4.3 Reactome enrichment

  ego_rt <- tryCatch(
    enrichPathway(
      gene          = genes_entrez,
      organism      = "mouse",
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
      pAdjustMethod = "fdr",
      qvalueCutoff  = 0.2,
      universe      = universe_entrez
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(ego_rt)) {
    summary_list[[as.character(module_id)]] <- tibble(
      module_id = module_id,
      focus_celltype = focus_celltype,
      module_label = module_label,
      n_genes_symbol = length(genes_symbol),
      n_genes_entrez = length(genes_entrez),
      n_terms_raw_p_lt_0_05 = 0,
      n_terms_padj_lt_0_05 = 0,
      status = "enrichPathway_failed"
    )
    next
  }
  
  res_rt <- ego_rt@result %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  if (nrow(res_rt) == 0) {
    summary_list[[as.character(module_id)]] <- tibble(
      module_id = module_id,
      focus_celltype = focus_celltype,
      module_label = module_label,
      n_genes_symbol = length(genes_symbol),
      n_genes_entrez = length(genes_entrez),
      n_terms_raw_p_lt_0_05 = 0,
      n_terms_padj_lt_0_05 = 0,
      status = "no_terms"
    )
    next
  }
  reactome_list[[as.character(module_id)]] <- res_rt %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    module_id = module_id,
    focus_celltype = focus_celltype,
    module_label = module_label
  )

  # 4.4 取 top10

  top10 <- res_rt %>%
    arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10) %>%
    mutate(
      Description_wrapped = stringr::str_wrap(Description, width = 30),
      neglog10_pval = -log10(pvalue),
      rank_raw = rank(p.adjust, ties.method = "first"),
      color_rank_plot = max(rank_raw) - rank_raw + 1
    )
  
  legend_breaks <- seq(
    min(top10$color_rank_plot),
    max(top10$color_rank_plot),
    length.out = 5
  )
  
  legend_labels <- round(
    seq(
      min(top10$neglog10_pval),
      max(top10$neglog10_pval),
      length.out = 5
    ),
    2
  )
  

  # 4.5 画图
  # y 轴按 Count 排序

  p_rt <- ggplot(
    top10,
    aes(
      x = Count,
      y = reorder(Description_wrapped, Count),
      fill = color_rank_plot
    )
  ) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low    = "grey85",
      high   = "black",
      name   = "-log10(pvalue)",
      breaks = legend_breaks,
      labels = legend_labels
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Top 10 Enriched Reactome (Module ", module_id, ")"),
      subtitle = paste0(focus_celltype, " | ", module_label),
      x = "Gene Count",
      y = "Reactome Pathway"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x  = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y  = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x   = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      legend.title  = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.text   = element_text(size = 12)
    )
  
  print(p_rt)
  

  # 4.6 保存完整结果表

  write_tsv(
    res_rt,
    file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0(
        focus_celltype, "_module", module_id, "_",
        module_label, "_Reactome_full.tsv"
      )
    )
  )
  

  # 4.7 保存 top10 图

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("module", module_id, "_Reactome_top10.png")),
  plot = p_rt,
  width = 10,
  height = 11,
  dpi = 300
)

  filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("module", module_id, "_Reactome_top10.pdf")),
  plot = p_rt,
  width = 10,
  height = 11
)  
}
```

```{r}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(module_info))) {
  
  module_id <- module_info$module_id[i]
  focus_celltype <- module_info$focus_celltype[i]
  module_label <- module_info$module_label[i]
  
  message("Running Reactome for module ", module_id, " ...")
  
  genes_symbol <- module_gene_list[[as.character(module_id)]] %>%
    unique() %>%
    intersect(universe_genes)
  
  if (length(genes_symbol) == 0) {
    summary_list[[as.character(module_id)]] <- tibble(
      module_id = module_id,
      focus_celltype = focus_celltype,
      module_label = module_label,
      n_genes_symbol = 0,
      n_genes_entrez = 0,
      n_terms_raw_p_lt_0_05 = 0,
      n_terms_padj_lt_0_05 = 0,
      status = "no_genes"
    )
    next
  }
  
  gene_map <- tryCatch(
    bitr(
      genes_symbol,
      fromType = "SYMBOL",
      toType   = "ENTREZID",
      OrgDb    = org.Mm.eg.db
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(gene_map) || nrow(gene_map) == 0) {
    summary_list[[as.character(module_id)]] <- tibble(
      module_id = module_id,
      focus_celltype = focus_celltype,
      module_label = module_label,
      n_genes_symbol = length(genes_symbol),
      n_genes_entrez = 0,
      n_terms_raw_p_lt_0_05 = 0,
      n_terms_padj_lt_0_05 = 0,
      status = "symbol_to_entrez_failed"
    )
    next
  }
  
  genes_entrez <- unique(gene_map$ENTREZID)
  
  ego_rt <- tryCatch(
    enrichPathway(
      gene          = genes_entrez,
      organism      = "mouse",
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
      pAdjustMethod = "fdr",
      qvalueCutoff  = 0.2,
      universe      = universe_entrez
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(ego_rt)) {
    summary_list[[as.character(module_id)]] <- tibble(
      module_id = module_id,
      focus_celltype = focus_celltype,
      module_label = module_label,
      n_genes_symbol = length(genes_symbol),
      n_genes_entrez = length(genes_entrez),
      n_terms_raw_p_lt_0_05 = 0,
      n_terms_padj_lt_0_05 = 0,
      status = "enrichPathway_failed"
    )
    next
  }
  
  res_rt <- ego_rt@result %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  if (nrow(res_rt) == 0) {
    summary_list[[as.character(module_id)]] <- tibble(
      module_id = module_id,
      focus_celltype = focus_celltype,
      module_label = module_label,
      n_genes_symbol = length(genes_symbol),
      n_genes_entrez = length(genes_entrez),
      n_terms_raw_p_lt_0_05 = 0,
      n_terms_padj_lt_0_05 = 0,
      status = "no_terms"
    )
    next
  }
  
  reactome_list[[as.character(module_id)]] <- res_rt %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      module_id = module_id,
      focus_celltype = focus_celltype,
      module_label = module_label
    )
  
  write_tsv(
    res_rt,
    file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0(
        focus_celltype, "_module", module_id, "_",
        module_label, "_Reactome_full.tsv"
      )
    )
  )
  
}
```

```{r}
    z_amp  = as.numeric(scale(gain_amp)),
    z_sig  = as.numeric(scale(gain_sig)),
    gpcr_focus_score = z_expr + z_pct + z_amp + z_sig
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(gpcr_focus_score))

m2_gpcr_df %>%

    max_mean_expr, max_pct_nonzero,
    A_Hep.CV, A_Hep.PV,
    q_Hep.CV, q_Hep.PV,
    gpcr_focus_score
  ) %>%
  print(n = 30)
```

```{r}
# 0. load data

# 2. metadata
wrap_phase <- function(x) {
  ((as.numeric(x) %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi)
}

theta_pred_vec <- as.numeric(res_phase_liver$theta_pred)
names(theta_pred_vec) <- colnames(obj_use)

cell_meta <- obj_use@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),

  ) %>%

    is.finite(theta_wrap)
  )

rownames(cell_meta) <- cell_meta$cell

    phase_ref_pv = as.numeric(phi_Hep.PV)

  ) %>%

    phase_wrap_pv = wrap_phase(phase_ref_pv)
  ) %>%
  arrange(phase_wrap_pv, gene)

gene_order <- gene_meta2$gene

# 4. helper functions
row_zscore <- function(mat) {
  z <- t(apply(mat, 1, function(x) {
    sdx <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    out <- (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sdx
    out[!is.finite(out)] <- 0
    out
  }))
  z <- as.matrix(z)
  rownames(z) <- rownames(mat)
  colnames(z) <- colnames(mat)
  z[!is.finite(z)] <- 0
  z
}

make_phase_cat_from_theta <- function(theta_grid) {
  zt_grid <- (theta_grid / (2 * pi) * 24) %% 24
  phase_cat <- floor((zt_grid - 2) / 4) * 4 + 2
  phase_cat <- phase_cat %% 24
  factor(phase_cat, levels = c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22))
}

cyclic_smooth_matrix <- function(expr_sub, theta_sub, k = 8, n_grid = 60) {
  expr_sub <- as.matrix(expr_sub)
  theta_use <- wrap_phase(theta_sub)
  theta_grid <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_grid + 1)[-1]
  
  pred_list <- furrr::future_map(
    seq_len(nrow(expr_sub)),
    function(i) {
      dat <- data.frame(
        expr = as.numeric(expr_sub[i, ]),
        theta = theta_use
      )
      
      fit <- try(
        mgcv::gam(
          expr ~ s(theta, bs = "cc", k = k),
          data = dat,
          method = "REML",
          knots = list(theta = c(0, 2 * pi))
        ),
        silent = TRUE
      )
      
      pred <- rep(NA_real_, length(theta_grid))
      pred[seq_along(pred)] <- tryCatch(
        predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(theta = theta_grid)),
        error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(theta_grid))
      )
      pred
    },
    .options = furrr::furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
  )
  
  smoothed_mat <- do.call(rbind, pred_list)
  smoothed_mat <- as.matrix(smoothed_mat)
  
  rownames(smoothed_mat) <- rownames(expr_sub)
  colnames(smoothed_mat) <- paste0("Theta_", seq_len(ncol(smoothed_mat)))
  
  keep <- complete.cases(smoothed_mat)
  smoothed_mat <- smoothed_mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  
  list(
    mat_raw = smoothed_mat,
    mat_z = row_zscore(smoothed_mat),
    theta_grid = theta_grid,
    keep_genes = rownames(smoothed_mat)
  )
}

build_top_annotation <- function(theta_grid, group_name) {
  phase_cat <- make_phase_cat_from_theta(theta_grid)
  group_cat <- factor(rep(group_name, length(theta_grid)), levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
  
  anno_df <- data.frame(
    phase = phase_cat,
    group = group_cat,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  
  colnames(anno_df) <- c("Cell phase", "Group")
  
  HeatmapAnnotation(

  )
}

add_phase_separators <- function(theta_grid, anno_name = "Cell phase", lwd = 1.4) {
  phase_num <- as.character(make_phase_cat_from_theta(theta_grid))
  boundary_idx <- which(phase_num[-1] != phase_num[-length(phase_num)])
  x_pos <- boundary_idx / pmax(length(phase_num), 1)
  
  decorate_annotation(anno_name, {
    for (xline in x_pos) {
      grid::grid.lines(
        x = unit(c(xline, xline), "npc"),
        y = unit(c(0, 1), "npc"),
        gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = lwd)
      )
    }
  })
}
```

```{r}
row_zscore <- function(mat) {
  z <- t(apply(mat, 1, function(x) {
    sdx <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    out <- (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sdx
    out[!is.finite(out)] <- 0
    out
  }))
  z <- as.matrix(z)
  rownames(z) <- rownames(mat)
  colnames(z) <- colnames(mat)
  z[!is.finite(z)] <- 0
  z
}

make_phase_cat_from_theta <- function(theta_grid) {
  zt_grid <- (theta_grid / (2 * pi) * 24) %% 24
  phase_cat <- floor((zt_grid - 2) / 4) * 4 + 2
  phase_cat <- phase_cat %% 24
  factor(phase_cat, levels = c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22))
}

cyclic_smooth_matrix <- function(expr_sub, theta_sub, k = 8, n_grid = 60) {
  expr_sub <- as.matrix(expr_sub)
  theta_use <- wrap_phase(theta_sub)
  theta_grid <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_grid + 1)[-1]
  
  pred_list <- furrr::future_map(
    seq_len(nrow(expr_sub)),
    function(i) {
      dat <- data.frame(
        expr = as.numeric(expr_sub[i, ]),
        theta = theta_use
      )
      
      fit <- try(
        mgcv::gam(
          expr ~ s(theta, bs = "cc", k = k),
          data = dat,
          method = "REML",
          knots = list(theta = c(0, 2 * pi))
        ),
        silent = TRUE
      )
      
      pred <- rep(NA_real_, length(theta_grid))
      pred[seq_along(pred)] <- tryCatch(
        predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(theta = theta_grid)),
        error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(theta_grid))
      )
      pred
    },
    .options = furrr::furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
  )
  
  smoothed_mat <- do.call(rbind, pred_list)
  smoothed_mat <- as.matrix(smoothed_mat)
  
  rownames(smoothed_mat) <- rownames(expr_sub)
  colnames(smoothed_mat) <- paste0("Theta_", seq_len(ncol(smoothed_mat)))
  
  keep <- complete.cases(smoothed_mat)
  smoothed_mat <- smoothed_mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  
  list(
    mat_raw = smoothed_mat,
    mat_z = row_zscore(smoothed_mat),
    theta_grid = theta_grid,
    keep_genes = rownames(smoothed_mat)
  )
}

  anno_df <- data.frame(
    phase = phase_cat,
    group = group_cat,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  
  colnames(anno_df) <- c("Cell phase", "Group")
  
  HeatmapAnnotation(

        "10" = "#F5F5F5",

      ),

      )

    show_legend = c(TRUE, TRUE),
    annotation_name_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold"),
    annotation_legend_param = list(
      `Cell phase` = list(
        title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 15, fontface = "bold"),
        labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 13),

      )
    ),
    simple_anno_size = unit(1.2, "cm"),
    gap = unit(0, "mm"),
    border = FALSE,
    gp = gpar(col = NA, lwd = 0)
  )
}

add_phase_separators <- function(theta_grid, anno_name = "Cell phase", lwd = 1.2) {
  phase_num <- as.character(make_phase_cat_from_theta(theta_grid))
  boundary_idx <- which(phase_num[-1] != phase_num[-length(phase_num)])
```

#gpcr gene cos
```{r}
# GPCR module2 genes: batch MAGIC + module_result equation curve
#install.packages("external/Rmagic-master", repos = NULL, type = "source")
# GPCR genes MAGIC cos
rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(Matrix)
  library(readr)
  library(Rmagic)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(org.Mm.eg.db)
})

# 0. load data
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_object_celltype_use.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_infer_scRhythm_phase.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/scCircadianliver_result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV.Rdata")

DefaultAssay(obj_use) <- "RNA"
module_result <- res2_module$module_result

expr_data <- GetAssayData(
  obj_use,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "data"
)

theta_pred_vec <- as.numeric(res_phase_liver$theta_pred)
names(theta_pred_vec) <- colnames(obj_use)

cell_meta <- obj_use@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    theta_pred = theta_pred_vec[cell]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    celltype %in% c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"),
    is.finite(theta_pred)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
  )

# 1. build GPCR gene list from module 2 Reactome term
gpcr_entrez <- reactome_list$`2`$geneID[10] %>%
  strsplit("/") %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unique()

gpcr_map <- bitr(
  gpcr_entrez,
  fromType = "ENTREZID",
  toType = "SYMBOL",
  OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db
)

gpcr_symbols <- gpcr_map$SYMBOL %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort()

module2_genes <- module_result %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  filter(module_map == 2) %>%
  pull(gene) %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort()

m2_gpcr_overlap <- intersect(module2_genes, gpcr_symbols)

focus_genes_final <- m2_gpcr_overlap %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort()

focus_genes_final
length(focus_genes_final)

# 2. module map
module_label_map <- c(
  "0" = "M0 Non-rhythmic",
  "1" = "M1 Stable Rhythm",
  "2" = "M2 Rhythm Gain",
  "3" = "M3 Rhythm Loss",
  "4" = "M4 Amp Enhanced",
  "5" = "M5 Amp Attenuated",
  "6" = "M6 Phase Advanced",
  "7" = "M7 Phase Delayed"
)

module_df <- module_result %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(
    gene = gene,
    module_id = as.character(module_map),
    module_label = recode(as.character(module_map), !!!module_label_map)
  )

# 3. split cells by celltype once
cell_meta_cv <- cell_meta %>%
  filter(celltype == "Hep.CV") %>%
  arrange(theta_pred)

cell_meta_pv <- cell_meta %>%
  filter(celltype == "Hep.PV") %>%
  arrange(theta_pred)

expr_cv <- expr_data[, cell_meta_cv$cell, drop = FALSE]
expr_pv <- expr_data[, cell_meta_pv$cell, drop = FALSE]

magic_input_cv <- t(as.matrix(expr_cv))
magic_input_pv <- t(as.matrix(expr_pv))

celltype_pal <- c(
  "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",
  "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"
)

theta_grid <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 300)

out_dir <- "outputs/liver/MAGIC_RESULT_phase2/gpcr_gene_curves"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 4. loop over genes
for (gene_use in focus_genes_final) {
  
  message("Running: ", gene_use)
  
  gene_in_cv <- gene_use %in% colnames(magic_input_cv)
  gene_in_pv <- gene_use %in% colnames(magic_input_pv)
  
  if (!(gene_in_cv && gene_in_pv)) {
    message("Skip gene not found in MAGIC input: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  
  data_MAGIC_cv <- tryCatch(
    magic(magic_input_cv, genes = gene_use),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  data_MAGIC_pv <- tryCatch(
    magic(magic_input_pv, genes = gene_use),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(data_MAGIC_cv) || is.null(data_MAGIC_pv)) {
    message("Skip gene due to MAGIC failure: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  
  plot_df_magic_cv <- cell_meta_cv %>%
    mutate(
      expr_magic = as.numeric(data_MAGIC_cv$result[, gene_use])
    )
  
  plot_df_magic_pv <- cell_meta_pv %>%
    mutate(
      expr_magic = as.numeric(data_MAGIC_pv$result[, gene_use])
    )
  
  plot_df_magic <- bind_rows(plot_df_magic_cv, plot_df_magic_pv) %>%
    mutate(
      celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(expr_magic))
  
  if (nrow(plot_df_magic) == 0) {
    message("Skip gene due to empty plotting df: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  
  cosinor_df <- plot_df_magic %>%
    group_by(celltype) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      df_ct <- .x %>%
        dplyr::select(theta_pred, expr_magic) %>%
        filter(is.finite(theta_pred), is.finite(expr_magic))
      
      if (nrow(df_ct) < 10 || sd(df_ct$expr_magic) == 0) {
        return(tibble())
      }
      
      fit <- tryCatch(
        lm(expr_magic ~ cos(theta_pred) + sin(theta_pred), data = df_ct),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      
      if (is.null(fit)) {
        return(tibble())
      }
      
      pred <- tryCatch(
        predict(fit, newdata = tibble(theta_pred = theta_grid), se.fit = TRUE),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      
      if (is.null(pred)) {
        return(tibble())
      }
      
      tibble(
        theta_pred = theta_grid,
        expr_fit = as.numeric(pred$fit),
        expr_lower = as.numeric(pred$fit - pred$se.fit),
        expr_upper = as.numeric(pred$fit + pred$se.fit)
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  if (nrow(cosinor_df) == 0) {
    message("Skip gene due to empty cosinor df: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  
  module_info <- module_df %>%
    filter(gene == gene_use) %>%
    distinct(gene, module_id, module_label)
  
  module_id_use <- module_info$module_id[1]
  module_label_use <- module_info$module_label[1]
  
  p_magic_dual <- ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = cosinor_df,
      aes(
        x = theta_pred,
        ymin = expr_lower,
        ymax = expr_upper,
        fill = celltype
      ),
      alpha = 0.18,
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = cosinor_df,
      aes(x = theta_pred, y = expr_fit, color = celltype),
      linewidth = 4
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = celltype_pal, name = NULL) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_pal, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 2*pi),
      breaks = c(0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2, 2*pi),
      labels = c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2", "2π"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.04))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = gene_use,
      x = expression("Predicted phase " * phi),
      y = "Normalized Expression"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 45),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 32, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 32, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 27),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 27),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 25),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 10)
    )
  
  print(p_magic_dual)
  
  file_stub <- paste0(
    "M", module_id_use, "_",
    gsub("[[:space:]]+", "_", module_label_use), "_",
    gene_use, "_MAGIC_cosinor"
  )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_stub, ".pdf")),
    p_magic_dual,
    width = 5,
    height = 5.7
  )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_stub, ".png")),
    p_magic_dual,
    width = 5,
    height = 5.7,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```

```{r}
module_label_map <- c(

  "1" = "M1 Stable Rhythm",
  "2" = "M2 Rhythm Gain",
  "3" = "M3 Rhythm Loss",

# 3. split cells by celltype once
cell_meta_cv <- cell_meta %>%
  filter(celltype == "Hep.CV") %>%
  arrange(theta_pred)

  filter(celltype == "Hep.PV") %>%
  arrange(theta_pred)

expr_cv <- expr_data[, cell_meta_cv$cell, drop = FALSE]
expr_pv <- expr_data[, cell_meta_pv$cell, drop = FALSE]

magic_input_cv <- t(as.matrix(expr_cv))
magic_input_pv <- t(as.matrix(expr_pv))

celltype_pal <- c(
  "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",
  "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"
)

theta_grid <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 300)

out_dir <- "outputs/liver/MAGIC_RESULT_phase2/gpcr_gene_curves_singleSide"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 4. loop over genes
for (gene_use in focus_genes_final) {
  
  message("Running: ", gene_use)
  
  gene_in_cv <- gene_use %in% colnames(magic_input_cv)
  gene_in_pv <- gene_use %in% colnames(magic_input_pv)
  
  if (!(gene_in_cv && gene_in_pv)) {
    message("Skip gene not found in MAGIC input: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  
  data_MAGIC_cv <- tryCatch(
    magic(magic_input_cv, genes = gene_use),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  data_MAGIC_pv <- tryCatch(
    magic(magic_input_pv, genes = gene_use),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(data_MAGIC_cv) || is.null(data_MAGIC_pv)) {
    message("Skip gene due to MAGIC failure: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  
  plot_df_magic_cv <- cell_meta_cv %>%
    mutate(
      expr_magic = as.numeric(data_MAGIC_cv$result[, gene_use])
    )
  
  plot_df_magic_pv <- cell_meta_pv %>%
    mutate(
      expr_magic = as.numeric(data_MAGIC_pv$result[, gene_use])
    )
  
  plot_df_magic <- bind_rows(plot_df_magic_cv, plot_df_magic_pv) %>%
    mutate(
      celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(expr_magic))
  
  if (nrow(plot_df_magic) == 0) {
    message("Skip gene due to empty plotting df: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  
  # 4.1 get module_result parameters
  gene_param <- module_result %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    filter(gene == gene_use) %>%
    transmute(
      gene = gene,
      module_id = as.character(module_map),
      q_Hep.CV = as.numeric(q_Hep.CV),
      q_Hep.PV = as.numeric(q_Hep.PV),
      A_Hep.CV = as.numeric(A_Hep.CV),
      A_Hep.PV = as.numeric(A_Hep.PV),
      phi_Hep.CV = as.numeric(phi_Hep.CV),
      phi_Hep.PV = as.numeric(phi_Hep.PV)
    )
  
  if (nrow(gene_param) != 1) {
    message("Skip gene due to missing or duplicated module_result row: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  
  # 4.2 use MAGIC mean as mesor
  mesor_df <- plot_df_magic %>%
    group_by(celltype) %>%
    summarise(
      mesor_magic = mean(expr_magic, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # 4.3 build single-side / valid-side cosine curve
  cosinor_df <- bind_rows(
    tibble(
      celltype = "Hep.CV",
      theta_pred = theta_grid,
      mesor = mesor_df$mesor_magic[mesor_df$celltype == "Hep.CV"],
      amp = gene_param$A_Hep.CV,
      phase = gene_param$phi_Hep.CV
    ),
    tibble(
      celltype = "Hep.PV",
      theta_pred = theta_grid,
      mesor = mesor_df$mesor_magic[mesor_df$celltype == "Hep.PV"],
      amp = gene_param$A_Hep.PV,
      phase = gene_param$phi_Hep.PV
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      expr_fit = mesor + amp * cos(theta_pred - phase)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(expr_fit),
      is.finite(amp),
      is.finite(phase)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
    )
  
  if (nrow(cosinor_df) == 0) {
    message("Skip gene due to empty cosinor df: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  
  module_info <- module_df %>%
    filter(gene == gene_use) %>%
    distinct(gene, module_id, module_label)
  
  module_id_use <- module_info$module_id[1]
  module_label_use <- module_info$module_label[1]
  
  p_magic_dual <- ggplot() +
    geom_line(
      data = cosinor_df,
      aes(x = theta_pred, y = expr_fit, color = celltype),
      linewidth = 4
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = celltype_pal, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 2*pi),
      breaks = c(0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2, 2*pi),
      labels = c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2", "2π"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.04))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = gene_use,
      x = expression("Predicted phase " * phi),
      y = "Normalized Expression"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 45),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 32, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 32, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 27),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 27),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 25),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 10)
    )
  
  print(p_magic_dual)
  
  file_stub <- paste0(
    "M", module_id_use, "_",
    gsub("[[:space:]]+", "_", module_label_use), "_",
    gene_use, "_MAGIC_singleSide"
  )
```

#cellphase flower plot
```{r}
# cellphase plot
rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(purrr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_object_celltype_use.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_infer_scRhythm_phase.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_countmat.Rdata")

DefaultAssay(obj_use) <- "RNA"


# Step 1. helper

wrap_phase <- function(x) {
  ((as.numeric(x) %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi)
}

hour_to_rad <- function(h) {
  (h %% 24) / 24 * 2 * pi
}


# Step 2. metadata

theta_pred_vec <- as.numeric(res_phase_liver$theta_pred)
names(theta_pred_vec) <- colnames(count_mat)

meta_plot <- obj_use@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    ZT_true = readr::parse_number(as.character(ZT)),
    theta_pred = theta_pred_vec[cell]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    celltype %in% c("Hep.PV", "Hep.CV"),
    is.finite(ZT_true),
    is.finite(theta_pred)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    theta_pred = wrap_phase(theta_pred),
    ZT_group = factor(ZT_true, levels = c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22)),
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.PV", "Hep.CV"))
  )

print(table(meta_plot$celltype, meta_plot$ZT_group))


# Step 3. circular density for theta_pred

circ_density_df <- function(theta_vec, group_name, celltype_name, n_grid = 720, bw = 0.35) {
  
  theta_vec <- as.numeric(theta_vec)
  theta_vec <- theta_vec[is.finite(theta_vec)]
  theta_vec <- wrap_phase(theta_vec)
  
  theta_ext <- c(theta_vec - 2 * pi, theta_vec, theta_vec + 2 * pi)
  
  dens <- stats::density(
    theta_ext,
    from = 0,
    to = 2 * pi,
    n = n_grid,
    bw = bw
  )
  
  tibble::tibble(
    theta = dens$x,
    density = dens$y,
    group = group_name,
    celltype = celltype_name
  )
}

density_df <- meta_plot %>%
  dplyr::group_by(celltype, ZT_group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    theta_list = list(theta_pred),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  purrr::pmap_dfr(function(celltype, ZT_group, theta_list) {
    circ_density_df(
      theta_vec = unlist(theta_list),
      group_name = as.character(ZT_group),
      celltype_name = as.character(celltype),
      n_grid = 720,
      bw = 0.35
    )
  })

density_df <- density_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(celltype, group) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    density_scaled = density / max(density, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    r_inner = 1.10,
    r_outer = 1.10 + density_scaled * 0.95
  )


# Step 4. middle colored ring
# 直接按真实 ZT 组放到对应时间区间：
# ZT02 -> 0~4h
# ZT06 -> 4~8h
# ...
# ZT22 -> 20~24h

ring_base <- tibble::tibble(
  hour = seq(0, 24, length.out = 721)
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    theta = hour_to_rad(hour),
    ZT_group = cut(
      hour %% 24,
      breaks = c(0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24),
      labels = c("2", "6", "10", "14", "18", "22"),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      right = FALSE
    ),
    r0 = 0.98,
    r1 = 1.18
  )

ring_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  ring_base %>% dplyr::mutate(celltype = "Hep.PV"),
  ring_base %>% dplyr::mutate(celltype = "Hep.CV")
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.PV", "Hep.CV"))
  )


# Step 5. outer circle + ticks + labels
# 主刻度每4h，次刻度每2h

circle_df <- tibble::tibble(
  theta = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 500),
  r = 2.05
)

major_tick_df <- tibble::tibble(
  hour = c(0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20),
  theta = hour_to_rad(hour)
)

minor_tick_df <- tibble::tibble(
  hour = c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22),
  theta = hour_to_rad(hour)
)

label_df_major <- tibble::tibble(
  hour = c(0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20),
  theta = hour_to_rad(hour),
  r = 2.18,
  lab = paste0(hour, "h")
)

label_df_minor <- tibble::tibble(
  hour = c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22),
  theta = hour_to_rad(hour),
  r = 2.11,
  lab = paste0(hour, "h")
)


# Step 6. colors

zt_cols <- c(
  "2"  = "#D97B93",
  "6"  = "#F08A72",
  "10" = "#F3B36A",
  "14" = "#A9D17A",
  "18" = "#7FC4A5",
  "22" = "#7E79BF"
)


# Step 7. plot
# 关键：这里只做一次统一旋转
# 0h 顶部，顺时针

p_circ_facet <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = density_df,
    aes(
      x = theta,
      ymin = r_inner,
      ymax = r_outer,
      group = interaction(celltype, group),
      fill = group
    ),
    alpha = 0.35,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = ring_df,
    aes(
      x = theta,
      ymin = r0,
      ymax = r1,
      fill = ZT_group
    ),
    alpha = 0.95,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_path(
    data = circle_df,
    aes(x = theta, y = r),
    color = "grey45",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = major_tick_df,
    aes(
      x = theta, xend = theta,
      y = 0, yend = 2.05
    ),
    color = "grey75",
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = minor_tick_df,
    aes(
      x = theta, xend = theta,
      y = 1.93, yend = 2.05
    ),
    color = "grey45",
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
    ymin = 0, ymax = 0.92,
    fill = "white",
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = label_df_major,
    aes(x = theta, y = r, label = lab),
    size = 4.8,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "grey20"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = label_df_minor,
    aes(x = theta, y = r, label = lab),
    size = 3.6,
    fontface = "plain",
    color = "grey35"
  ) +
  coord_polar(start = 0, direction = 1, clip = "off") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = zt_cols,
    name = "ZT group",
    labels = c("ZT02", "ZT06", "ZT10", "ZT14", "ZT18", "ZT22")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2 * pi)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 2.20)) +
  facet_wrap(~celltype, nrow = 1) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(20, 30, 20, 20)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "ZT Round Distribution of Predicted Phase"
  )

print(p_circ_facet)


# Step 8. save

out_dir <- "outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/circular_phase_plot"
```

```{r}
# cellphase flower plot

suppressPackageStartupMessages({

DefaultAssay(obj_use) <- "RNA"

# Step 1. helper
wrap_phase <- function(x) {
  ((as.numeric(x) %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi)
}

hour_to_rad <- function(h) {
  (h %% 24) / 24 * 2 * pi
}

# Step 2. metadata
theta_pred_vec <- as.numeric(res_phase_liver$theta_pred)
names(theta_pred_vec) <- colnames(count_mat)

meta_plot <- obj_use@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    ZT_true = readr::parse_number(as.character(ZT)),
    theta_pred = theta_pred_vec[cell]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    celltype %in% c("Hep.PV", "Hep.CV"),
    is.finite(ZT_true),
    is.finite(theta_pred)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    theta_pred = wrap_phase(theta_pred),
    ZT_group = factor(ZT_true, levels = c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22)),
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.PV", "Hep.CV"))
  )

print(table(meta_plot$celltype, meta_plot$ZT_group))

# Step 3. circular density
circ_density_df <- function(theta_vec, group_name, celltype_name, n_grid = 720, bw = 0.35) {
  theta_vec <- as.numeric(theta_vec)
  theta_vec <- theta_vec[is.finite(theta_vec)]
  theta_vec <- wrap_phase(theta_vec)

  theta_ext <- c(theta_vec - 2 * pi, theta_vec, theta_vec + 2 * pi)

  dens <- stats::density(
    theta_ext,
    from = 0,
    to = 2 * pi,
    n = n_grid,
    bw = bw
  )

  tibble::tibble(
    theta = dens$x,
    density = dens$y,
    group = group_name,
    celltype = celltype_name
  )
}

density_df <- meta_plot %>%

      group_name = as.character(ZT_group),

    ),

ring_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(

      ),

    ) +

    ) +
```

```{r}
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_object_celltype_use.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_infer_scRhythm_phase.Rdata")

DefaultAssay(obj_use) <- "RNA"

# 1. helper
wrap_phase <- function(x) {
  ((as.numeric(x) %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi)
}

# 2. metadata
theta_pred_vec <- as.numeric(res_phase_liver$theta_pred)
names(theta_pred_vec) <- colnames(count_mat)

meta_plot <- obj_use@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    theta_pred = theta_pred_vec[cell]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    celltype %in% c("Hep.PV", "Hep.CV"),
    is.finite(theta_pred)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    theta_pred = wrap_phase(theta_pred),
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.PV", "Hep.CV"))
  )

# 3. circular density helper
circ_density_df <- function(theta_vec, group_name, n_grid = 720, bw = 0.35) {
  
  theta_vec <- as.numeric(theta_vec)
  theta_vec <- theta_vec[is.finite(theta_vec)]
  theta_vec <- wrap_phase(theta_vec)
  
  # circular extension
  theta_ext <- c(theta_vec - 2*pi, theta_vec, theta_vec + 2*pi)
  
  dens <- stats::density(
    theta_ext,
    from = 0,
    to = 2*pi,
    n = n_grid,
    bw = bw
  )
  
  tibble(
    theta = dens$x,
    density = dens$y,
    celltype = group_name
  )
}

# 4. density dataframe
density_df <- bind_rows(
    circ_density_df(
    theta_vec = meta_plot$theta_pred[meta_plot$celltype == "Hep.CV"],
    group_name = "Hep.CV",

  ),

    bw = 0.35
  )

) %>%

  )

)

    limits = c(0, 2*pi),

    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(

  ) +

    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.position = "top",

  )
```

#cell phase polar histogram
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
})

load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_object_celltype_use.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_infer_scRhythm_phase.Rdata")

out_dir <- "outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/cell_phase_polar"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

phase_df <- obj_use@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    theta_pred = as.numeric(res_phase_liver$theta_pred),
    ZT_pred = ((theta_pred %% (2 * pi)) / (2 * pi)) * 24
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(celltype %in% c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(theta_pred))

dplyr::count(phase_df, celltype)


celltype_pal <- c(
  "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",
  "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"

)
plot_cell_phase_polar <- function(df_one, celltype_name, fill_col, out_dir, n_bin = 24) {
  
  breaks_theta <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_bin + 1)
  mids_theta <- (breaks_theta[-1] + breaks_theta[-length(breaks_theta)]) / 2
  width_theta <- 2 * pi / n_bin
  
  hist_res <- hist(df_one$theta_pred, breaks = breaks_theta, plot = FALSE)
  
  plot_df <- tibble::tibble(
    theta_mid = mids_theta,
    freq = hist_res$counts,
    prop = hist_res$counts / sum(hist_res$counts)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      label = dplyr::case_when(
        freq > 0 ~ as.character(freq),
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    )
  
  ymax_use <- max(plot_df$prop)
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = theta_mid, y = prop)) +
    geom_col(
      width = width_theta * 0.95,
      fill = fill_col,
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(y = prop + ymax_use * 0.03, label = label),
      size = 2.5,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    coord_polar(start = 0, direction = 1, clip = "off") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 2 * pi),
      breaks = seq(0, 2 * pi - 2 * pi / 8, length.out = 8),
      labels = c("0:00", "3:00", "6:00", "9:00", "12:00", "15:00", "18:00", "21:00")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, ymax_use * 1.22),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(celltype_name),
      subtitle = paste0("Total N = ", nrow(df_one)),
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey80"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey88"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0("cell_phase_polar_", celltype_name, ".pdf")),
    p, width = 4, height = 4
  )
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0("cell_phase_polar_", celltype_name, ".png")),
    p, width = 4, height = 4, dpi = 300
  )
  
  p
}

p_pv <- phase_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(celltype == "Hep.PV") %>%
  plot_cell_phase_polar(
    celltype_name = "Hep.PV",
    fill_col = celltype_pal["Hep.PV"],
    out_dir = out_dir,
    n_bin = 24
  )

p_cv <- phase_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(celltype == "Hep.CV") %>%
  plot_cell_phase_polar(
    celltype_name = "Hep.CV",
    fill_col = celltype_pal["Hep.CV"],
    out_dir = out_dir,
    n_bin = 24
  )

p_pv
p_cv
#other 
celltype_pal <- c(
  "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",
  "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"

)

plot_cell_phase_rose <- function(df_one,
                                 celltype_name,
                                 fill_col,
                                 out_dir,
                                 n_bin = 24,
                                 rmax_fix = NULL) {
  
  # 1) histogram
  breaks_theta <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_bin + 1)
  mids_theta <- (breaks_theta[-1] + breaks_theta[-length(breaks_theta)]) / 2
  width_theta <- 2 * pi / n_bin
  
  h <- hist(df_one$theta_pred, breaks = breaks_theta, plot = FALSE)
  
  plot_df <- tibble::tibble(
    theta_mid = mids_theta,
    count = h$counts,
    prop = h$counts / sum(h$counts)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      label = dplyr::case_when(
        count > 0 ~ as.character(count),
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    )
  
  # 2) radius range
  ymax_use <- c(max(plot_df$prop), 1e-6) %>% max()
  ymax_use <- c(ymax_use, rmax_fix) %>% max(na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # 3) text location for total N
  label_df <- tibble::tibble(
    x = 0.35,
    y = ymax_use * 0.88,
    label = paste0("N = ", nrow(df_one))
  )
  
  # 4) plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = theta_mid, y = prop)) +
    geom_col(
      width = width_theta * 0.94,
      fill = fill_col,
      alpha = 0.9,
      colour = "white",
      linewidth = 0.25
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(y = prop + ymax_use * 0.035, label = label),
      size = 3.0,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = label_df$x,
      y = label_df$y,
      label = label_df$label,
      size = 4.8,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    coord_polar(start = 0, direction = 1, clip = "off") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 2 * pi),
      breaks = seq(0, 2 * pi - 2 * pi / 8, length.out = 8),
      labels = c("0:00", "3:00", "6:00", "9:00", "12:00", "15:00", "18:00", "21:00")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(-ymax_use * 0.22, ymax_use * 1.18),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = celltype_name,
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey80"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey88"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 17),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0("rose_", celltype_name, ".pdf")),
    p, width = 4, height = 4
  )
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0("rose_", celltype_name, ".png")),
    p, width = 4, height =4 , dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(p)
}
# 统一半径范围，方便比较两个 celltype
get_max_prop <- function(theta_vec, n_bin = 24) {
  breaks_theta <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_bin + 1)
  h <- hist(theta_vec, breaks = breaks_theta, plot = FALSE)
  max(h$counts / sum(h$counts))
}

rmax_all <- phase_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(celltype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    max_prop = get_max_prop(theta_pred, n_bin = 24),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(max_prop) %>%
  max()

p_pv <- phase_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(celltype == "Hep.PV") %>%
  plot_cell_phase_rose(
    celltype_name = "Hep.PV",
    fill_col = celltype_pal["Hep.PV"],
    out_dir = out_dir,
    n_bin = 24,
    rmax_fix = rmax_all
  )

p_cv <- phase_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(celltype == "Hep.CV") %>%
  plot_cell_phase_rose(
    celltype_name = "Hep.CV",
    fill_col = celltype_pal["Hep.CV"],
    out_dir = out_dir,
    n_bin = 24,
    rmax_fix = rmax_all
  )
```

#celltype/module polar 
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(readr)
  library(scales)
  library(purrr)
  library(grid)
})


# 1. load results

load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_result_param_scRhythm_phase2.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/scCircadianliver_result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV.Rdata")

param_wide <- res_param_liver2$param_wide
module_result <- res2_module$module_result


# 2. basic maps

module_label_map <- c(
  "0" = "M0 Non-rhythmic",
  "1" = "M1 Stable Rhythm",
  "2" = "M2 Rhythm Gain",
  "3" = "M3 Rhythm Loss",
  "4" = "M4 Amp Enhanced",
  "5" = "M5 Amp Attenuated",
  "6" = "M6 Phase Advanced",
  "7" = "M7 Phase Delayed"
)

module_pal <- c(
  "M0 Non-rhythmic"   = "#BDBDBD",
  "M1 Stable Rhythm"  = "#AFC0D6",
  "M2 Rhythm Gain"    = "#EDC0A0",
  "M3 Rhythm Loss"    = "#7F9DBF",
  "M4 Amp Enhanced"   = "#DF8F79",
  "M5 Amp Attenuated" = "#E7EDF4",
  "M6 Phase Advanced" = "#FAEFD9",
  "M7 Phase Delayed"  = "#4973A8"
)

celltype_pal <- c(
  "Hep.PV" = "#E68613",
  "Hep.CV" = "#4DAF4A"
)


# 3. identify gene column

gene_col <- intersect(
  c("gene", "Gene", "GeneSymbol", "symbol", "features"),
  colnames(param_wide)
)

stopifnot(length(gene_col) >= 1)
gene_col <- gene_col[1]


# 4. convert param_wide -> long
#    assume columns like:
#    Phase_Hep.PV, Amplitude_Hep.PV, FDR_Hep.PV
#    Phase_Hep.CV, Amplitude_Hep.CV, FDR_Hep.CV

param_long_plot <- param_wide %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(gene = all_of(gene_col)) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    matches("^(Phase|Amplitude|FDR)_(Hep\\.PV|Hep\\.CV)$")
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene,
    names_to = c(".value", "celltype"),
    names_pattern = "^(Phase|Amplitude|FDR)_(Hep\\.PV|Hep\\.CV)$"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    phase_wrap = Phase %% (2 * pi)
  )


# 5. merge module info

module_df <- module_result %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(
    gene = gene,
    module_id = as.character(module_map),
    module_label = recode(as.character(module_map), !!!module_label_map)
  )

plot_df0 <- param_long_plot %>%
  left_join(module_df, by = "gene")


# 6. keep genes useful for plotting
#    这里我建议：至少一个 celltype 显著，且两个 celltype 都有 phase/amp

# 6. keep shared rhythmic genes between two celltypes
#    两个 celltype 都有参数、都显著、都有一定 amplitude

gene_keep_df <- plot_df0 %>%
  group_by(gene, module_id, module_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_celltype = sum(!is.na(Phase) & !is.na(Amplitude) & !is.na(FDR)),
    max_fdr = max(FDR, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_amp = min(Amplitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_amp = sum(Amplitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    keep_gene = n_celltype == 2 & max_fdr < 0.05 & min_amp > 0.10
  )

plot_df1 <- plot_df0 %>%
  inner_join(
    gene_keep_df %>% filter(keep_gene) %>% dplyr::select(gene, module_id, module_label),
    by = c("gene", "module_id", "module_label")
  )


# 7. global amplitude scaling
amp_cap <- quantile(plot_df1$Amplitude, probs = 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)

plot_df2 <- plot_df1 %>%
  mutate(
    amp_clip = pmin(Amplitude, amp_cap),
    radius = rescale(amp_clip, to = c(0.18, 0.95), from = c(0, amp_cap)),
    x = radius * sin(phase_wrap),
    y = radius * cos(phase_wrap)
  )


# 8. make pairwise table (one row per gene)
pair_df <- plot_df2 %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, celltype, phase_wrap, radius, x, y, Amplitude, FDR, module_id, module_label) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = celltype,
    values_from = c(phase_wrap, radius, x, y, Amplitude, FDR)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_phase = atan2(
      sin(phase_wrap_Hep.CV - phase_wrap_Hep.PV),
      cos(phase_wrap_Hep.CV - phase_wrap_Hep.PV)
    ),
    abs_delta_phase = abs(delta_phase),
    delta_amp = Amplitude_Hep.CV - Amplitude_Hep.PV,
    abs_delta_amp = abs(delta_amp),
    mean_amp = (Amplitude_Hep.PV + Amplitude_Hep.CV) / 2,
    sum_logfdr = -log10(FDR_Hep.PV + 1e-300) + -log10(FDR_Hep.CV + 1e-300)
  )


# 9. module-specific ranking score
#    不同 module 用不同 ranking，更符合 module 生物学定义

pair_df <- pair_df %>%
  group_by(module_id) %>%
  mutate(
    z_abs_delta_phase = as.numeric(scale(abs_delta_phase)),
    z_abs_delta_amp   = as.numeric(scale(abs_delta_amp)),
    z_mean_amp        = as.numeric(scale(mean_amp)),
    z_sum_logfdr      = as.numeric(scale(sum_logfdr))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    rank_score = case_when(
      module_id == "1" ~ z_mean_amp + z_sum_logfdr - z_abs_delta_phase - z_abs_delta_amp,
      module_id == "4" ~ z_abs_delta_amp + 0.5 * z_mean_amp + 0.5 * z_sum_logfdr - 0.5 * z_abs_delta_phase,
      module_id == "5" ~ z_abs_delta_amp + 0.5 * z_mean_amp + 0.5 * z_sum_logfdr - 0.5 * z_abs_delta_phase,
      module_id == "6" ~ z_abs_delta_phase + 0.5 * z_mean_amp + 0.5 * z_sum_logfdr,
      module_id == "7" ~ z_abs_delta_phase + 0.5 * z_mean_amp + 0.5 * z_sum_logfdr,
      TRUE             ~ z_mean_amp + 0.5 * z_sum_logfdr + 0.5 * z_abs_delta_phase + 0.5 * z_abs_delta_amp
    )
  )


# 10. choose top genes per module for plotting
#     推荐主图先 top30；补充图可以 top50
top_n_per_module <- 30

top_gene_df <- pair_df %>%
  group_by(module_id) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = rank_score, n = top_n_per_module, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, module_id, module_label, rank_score, abs_delta_phase, abs_delta_amp)


# 11. keep only top genes for plotting
plot_df_top <- plot_df2 %>%
  inner_join(
    top_gene_df %>% dplyr::select(gene, module_id),
    by = c("gene", "module_id")
  )

pair_df_top <- pair_df %>%
  inner_join(
    top_gene_df %>% dplyr::select(gene, module_id),
    by = c("gene", "module_id")
  )


# 12. helper: choose label points
#     从 top genes 里再挑 label_top_n 个标注
label_df <- plot_df_top %>%
  inner_join(
    top_gene_df %>%
      group_by(module_id) %>%
      slice_max(order_by = rank_score, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::select(gene, module_id),
    by = c("gene", "module_id")
  ) %>%
  group_by(gene, module_id) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = Amplitude, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_module_polar <- function(module_use,
                              label_top_n = 8,
                              line_alpha = 0.60,
                              point_size = 3.2) {

  df_sub <- plot_df_top %>%
    filter(module_id == module_use)

  pair_sub <- pair_df_top %>%
    filter(module_id == module_use)

  label_sub <- label_df %>%
    filter(
      module_id == module_use,
      gene %in% (
        pair_sub %>%
          slice_max(order_by = rank_score, n = label_top_n, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
          pull(gene)
      )
    )

  title_use <- unique(df_sub$module_label)

  ggplot() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey82", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey82", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_path(
      data = map_dfr(circle_df$r, ~ tibble(
        t = seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 400),
        x = .x * sin(t),
        y = .x * cos(t),
        r = .x
      )),
      aes(x = x, y = y, group = r),
      color = "grey82",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = angle_df,
      aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = xend, yend = yend),
      color = "grey84",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = pair_sub,
      aes(
        x = x_Hep.PV, y = y_Hep.PV,
        xend = x_Hep.CV, yend = y_Hep.CV
      ),
      color = alpha(module_pal[unique(pair_sub$module_label)], line_alpha),
      linewidth = 0.55,
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.08, "inches"), type = "closed")
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = df_sub,
      aes(x = x, y = y, fill = celltype),
      shape = 21,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.22,
      size = point_size
    ) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = label_sub,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = gene),
      size = 3.2,
      box.padding = 0.28,
      point.padding = 0.18,
      segment.color = "black",
      segment.size = 0.30,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      seed = 123
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = angle_df$lab_x, y = angle_df$lab_y,
             label = c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2"), size = 5.5) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.72, y = 0.02, label = "Amplitude", size = 4.6) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.58, y = 0.82, label = "Peak phase", angle = -50, size = 4.2) +
    coord_equal() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_pal) +
    labs(
      title = title_use,
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Shared rhythmic genes; top ", nrow(pair_sub),
        " by module-specific ranking | Arrow: Hep.PV \u2192 Hep.CV"
      )
    ) +
    theme_void(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11.5, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank()
    )
}

p_m4 <- plot_module_polar(module_use = "7", label_top_n = 8)
p_m4
```

#replay genelevel celltype/module polar
```{r}
# genelevel celltype/module polar
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(readr)
  library(scales)
  library(purrr)
  library(grid)
})

# 1. load updated results
load("outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/scCircadianliver_result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV.Rdata")

module_result <- res2_module$module_result

# 2. basic maps
module_label_map <- c(
  "0" = "M0 Non-rhythmic",
  "1" = "M1 Stable Rhythm",
  "2" = "M2 Rhythm Gain",
  "3" = "M3 Rhythm Loss",
  "4" = "M4 Amp Enhanced",
  "5" = "M5 Amp Attenuated",
  "6" = "M6 Phase Advanced",
  "7" = "M7 Phase Delayed"
)

module_pal <- c(
  "M0 Non-rhythmic"   = "#BDBDBD",
  "M1 Stable Rhythm"  = "#AFC0D6",
  "M2 Rhythm Gain"    = "#EDC0A0",
  "M3 Rhythm Loss"    = "#7F9DBF",
  "M4 Amp Enhanced"   = "#DF8F79",
  "M5 Amp Attenuated" = "#E7EDF4",
  "M6 Phase Advanced" = "#FAEFD9",
  "M7 Phase Delayed"  = "#4973A8"
)

celltype_pal <- c(
  "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",
  "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"
)

# 3. directly build long table from updated module_result
plot_df0 <- module_result %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(
    gene = gene,
    module_id = as.character(module_map),
    module_label = recode(as.character(module_map), !!!module_label_map),
    Phase_Hep.CV = as.numeric(phi_Hep.CV),
    Phase_Hep.PV = as.numeric(phi_Hep.PV),
    Amplitude_Hep.CV = as.numeric(A_Hep.CV),
    Amplitude_Hep.PV = as.numeric(A_Hep.PV),
    FDR_Hep.CV = as.numeric(q_Hep.CV),
    FDR_Hep.PV = as.numeric(q_Hep.PV)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Phase_Hep.CV, Phase_Hep.PV,
      Amplitude_Hep.CV, Amplitude_Hep.PV,
      FDR_Hep.CV, FDR_Hep.PV
    ),
    names_to = c(".value", "celltype"),
    names_pattern = "^(Phase|Amplitude|FDR)_(Hep\\.PV|Hep\\.CV)$"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    phase_wrap = ((Phase %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi)
  )

# 4. gene filtering
# shared modules: M1/M4/M5/M6/M7
# non-shared modules: M2/M3
gene_keep_df <- plot_df0 %>%
  group_by(gene, module_id, module_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_celltype = sum(!is.na(Phase) & !is.na(Amplitude) & !is.na(FDR)),
    fdr_pv = FDR[celltype == "Hep.PV"][1],
    fdr_cv = FDR[celltype == "Hep.CV"][1],
    amp_pv = Amplitude[celltype == "Hep.PV"][1],
    amp_cv = Amplitude[celltype == "Hep.CV"][1],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    both_sig = (fdr_pv < 0.05 & fdr_cv < 0.05),
    one_sig  = xor(fdr_pv < 0.05, fdr_cv < 0.05),
    min_amp  = pmin(amp_pv, amp_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_amp  = pmax(amp_pv, amp_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
    keep_gene = case_when(
      module_id %in% c("1", "4", "5", "6", "7") ~
        n_celltype == 2 & both_sig & min_amp > 0.10,
      module_id %in% c("2", "3") ~
        n_celltype >= 1 & one_sig & max_amp > 0.10,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

plot_df1 <- plot_df0 %>%
  inner_join(
    gene_keep_df %>%
      filter(keep_gene) %>%
      dplyr::select(gene, module_id, module_label),
    by = c("gene", "module_id", "module_label")
  )

# 5. global amplitude scaling
amp_cap <- quantile(plot_df1$Amplitude, probs = 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)

plot_df2 <- plot_df1 %>%
  mutate(
    sig_flag = FDR < 0.05,
    amp_clip = pmin(Amplitude, amp_cap),
    radius_raw = rescale(amp_clip, to = c(0.18, 0.95), from = c(0, amp_cap)),
    radius = case_when(
      module_id %in% c("2", "3") & !sig_flag ~ 0.12,
      TRUE ~ radius_raw
    ),
    x = radius * sin(phase_wrap),
    y = radius * cos(phase_wrap)
  )

# 6. make pairwise table
pair_df <- plot_df2 %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, celltype, phase_wrap, radius, x, y, Amplitude, FDR, sig_flag, module_id, module_label) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = celltype,
    values_from = c(phase_wrap, radius, x, y, Amplitude, FDR, sig_flag)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_phase = atan2(
      sin(phase_wrap_Hep.CV - phase_wrap_Hep.PV),
      cos(phase_wrap_Hep.CV - phase_wrap_Hep.PV)
    ),
    abs_delta_phase = abs(delta_phase),
    delta_amp = Amplitude_Hep.CV - Amplitude_Hep.PV,
    abs_delta_amp = abs(delta_amp),
    mean_amp = (Amplitude_Hep.PV + Amplitude_Hep.CV) / 2,
    max_amp = pmax(Amplitude_Hep.PV, Amplitude_Hep.CV, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_logfdr = -log10(FDR_Hep.PV + 1e-300) + -log10(FDR_Hep.CV + 1e-300)
  )

# 7. module-specific ranking score
pair_df <- pair_df %>%
  group_by(module_id) %>%
  mutate(
    z_abs_delta_phase = as.numeric(scale(abs_delta_phase)),
    z_abs_delta_amp   = as.numeric(scale(abs_delta_amp)),
    z_mean_amp        = as.numeric(scale(mean_amp)),
    z_max_amp         = as.numeric(scale(max_amp)),
    z_sum_logfdr      = as.numeric(scale(sum_logfdr))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    rank_score = case_when(
      module_id == "1" ~ z_mean_amp + z_sum_logfdr - z_abs_delta_phase - z_abs_delta_amp,
      module_id == "2" ~ z_max_amp,
      module_id == "3" ~ z_max_amp,
      module_id == "4" ~ z_abs_delta_amp + 0.5 * z_mean_amp + 0.5 * z_sum_logfdr - 0.5 * z_abs_delta_phase,
      module_id == "5" ~ z_abs_delta_amp + 0.5 * z_mean_amp + 0.5 * z_sum_logfdr - 0.5 * z_abs_delta_phase,
      module_id == "6" ~ z_abs_delta_phase + 0.5 * z_mean_amp + 0.5 * z_sum_logfdr,
      module_id == "7" ~ z_abs_delta_phase + 0.5 * z_mean_amp + 0.5 * z_sum_logfdr,
      TRUE ~ z_mean_amp
    )
  )

# 8. choose top genes per module
top_n_per_module <- 50

top_gene_df <- pair_df %>%
  group_by(module_id) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = rank_score, n = top_n_per_module, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, module_id, module_label, rank_score, abs_delta_phase, abs_delta_amp)

# 9. keep only top genes for plotting
plot_df_top <- plot_df2 %>%
  inner_join(
    top_gene_df %>% dplyr::select(gene, module_id),
    by = c("gene", "module_id")
  )

pair_df_top <- pair_df %>%
  inner_join(
    top_gene_df %>% dplyr::select(gene, module_id),
    by = c("gene", "module_id")
  )

# 10. background for polar frame
circle_df <- tibble(
  r = c(0.18, 0.36, 0.54, 0.72, 0.95)
)

angle_df <- tibble(
  angle = c(0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2),
  xend = 0.98 * sin(angle),
  yend = 0.98 * cos(angle),
  lab_x = 1.16 * sin(angle),
  lab_y = 1.16 * cos(angle)
)

# 11. amplitude tick labels
amp_breaks_raw <- pretty(c(0, amp_cap), n = 4)
amp_breaks_raw <- amp_breaks_raw[amp_breaks_raw >= 0]
amp_breaks_raw <- unique(amp_breaks_raw)
amp_breaks_raw <- amp_breaks_raw[amp_breaks_raw <= amp_cap]

amp_tick_df <- tibble(
  amp_raw = amp_breaks_raw,
  r = rescale(
    pmin(amp_breaks_raw, amp_cap),
    to = c(0.18, 0.95),
    from = c(0, amp_cap)
  ),
  x = r,
  y = 0,
  label = format(round(amp_raw, 2), nsmall = 2)
)

amp_legend_vals <- amp_breaks_raw[amp_breaks_raw > 0]
amp_legend_vals <- sort(unique(amp_legend_vals))
amp_legend_vals <- amp_legend_vals[c(1, ceiling(length(amp_legend_vals) / 2), length(amp_legend_vals))]

amp_legend_sizes <- rescale(
  pmin(amp_legend_vals, amp_cap),
  to = c(2.2, 6.2),
  from = c(0, amp_cap)
)

# 12. plotting function
plot_module_polar <- function(module_use,
                              line_alpha = 0.65,
                              point_size_range = c(3.8, 8.2)) {

  df_sub <- plot_df_top %>%
    filter(module_id == module_use)

  pair_sub <- pair_df_top %>%
    filter(module_id == module_use)

  title_use <- unique(df_sub$module_label)

  circle_path_df <- map_dfr(circle_df$r, ~ tibble(
    t = seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 400),
    x = .x * sin(t),
    y = .x * cos(t),
    r = .x
  ))

  is_gain_loss <- module_use %in% c("2", "3")

  ggplot() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey84", linewidth = 0.32) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey84", linewidth = 0.32) +

    geom_path(
      data = circle_path_df,
      aes(x = x, y = y, group = r),
      color = "grey82",
      linewidth = 0.38
    ) +

    geom_segment(
      data = angle_df,
      aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = xend, yend = yend),
      color = "grey85",
      linewidth = 0.32
    ) +

    geom_segment(
      data = pair_sub %>% filter(!is_gain_loss),
      aes(
        x = x_Hep.PV, y = y_Hep.PV,
        xend = x_Hep.CV, yend = y_Hep.CV
      ),
      color = scales::alpha("grey55", line_alpha),
      linewidth = 0.50
    ) +

    # Hep.CV significant = 蓝色实心
    geom_point(
      data = df_sub %>% filter(celltype == "Hep.CV", sig_flag),
      aes(x = x, y = y, size = Amplitude),
      shape = 21,
      fill = celltype_pal["Hep.CV"],
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.24,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +

    # Hep.PV significant = 橙色空心
    geom_point(
      data = df_sub %>% filter(celltype == "Hep.PV", sig_flag),
      aes(x = x, y = y, size = Amplitude),
      shape = 1,
      color = celltype_pal["Hep.PV"],
      stroke = 0.95,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +

    annotate(
      "text",
      x = angle_df$lab_x,
      y = angle_df$lab_y,
      label = c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2"),
      size = 4.8,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +

    geom_segment(
      data = amp_tick_df,
      aes(x = x, y = y - 0.015, xend = x, yend = y + 0.015),
      linewidth = 0.30,
      color = "grey35"
    ) +

    geom_text(
      data = amp_tick_df,
      aes(x = x + 0.04, y = y, label = label),
      size = 3.1,
      hjust = 0,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +

    annotate("text", x = 0.78, y = 0.06, label = "Amplitude", size = 3.8, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text", x = 0.54, y = 0.84, label = "Peak phase", angle = -50, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +

    coord_equal(xlim = c(-1.18, 1.55), ylim = c(-1.15, 1.18), clip = "off") +

    scale_size_continuous(
      range = point_size_range,
      guide = "none"
    ) +

    labs(title = title_use) +

    theme_void(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 22, 8, 8)
    ) +

    # ---------- celltype legend ----------
    annotate("point", x = 1.08, y = 0.96, shape = 21, size = 4.6,
             fill = celltype_pal["Hep.CV"], color = "black", stroke = 0.24) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.15, y = 0.96, label = "Hep.CV", hjust = 0, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +

    annotate("point", x = 1.08, y = 0.84, shape = 1, size = 4.6,
             color = celltype_pal["Hep.PV"], stroke = 0.95) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.15, y = 0.84, label = "Hep.PV", hjust = 0, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +

    # ---------- global amplitude legend ----------
    annotate("text", x = 1.08, y = 0.58, label = "Amplitude", hjust = 0, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +

    annotate("point", x = 1.08, y = 0.49, shape = 16,
             size = amp_legend_sizes[1] + 0.6, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = 1.18, y = 0.49, label = amp_legend_vals[1], hjust = 0, size = 3.0) +

    annotate("point", x = 1.08, y = 0.39, shape = 16,
             size = amp_legend_sizes[min(2, length(amp_legend_sizes))] + 0.6, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = 1.18, y = 0.39, label = amp_legend_vals[min(2, length(amp_legend_vals))], hjust = 0, size = 3.0) +

    annotate("point", x = 1.08, y = 0.27, shape = 16,
             size = amp_legend_sizes[min(3, length(amp_legend_sizes))] + 0.6, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = 1.18, y = 0.27, label = amp_legend_vals[min(3, length(amp_legend_vals))], hjust = 0, size = 3.0)
}

# 13. output one by one with for loop
out_dir_plot <- "outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/module_polar_single"
dir.create(out_dir_plot, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

module_ids_use <- sort(unique(top_gene_df$module_id))

for (m in module_ids_use) {

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir_plot, paste0("module_", m, "_polar_single.png")),
    plot = p_now,
    width = 7,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

p_m2
```
