#genelevel celltype/module polar
```{r}
#celltype/module polar 
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(readr)
  library(scales)
  library(purrr)
  library(grid)
})

# 1. load results
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_result_param_scRhythm_phase2.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/scCircadianliver_result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV.Rdata")

param_wide <- res_param_liver2$param_wide
module_result <- res2_module$module_result

# 2. basic maps
module_label_map <- c(
  "0" = "M0 Non-rhythmic",
  "1" = "M1 Stable Rhythm",
  "2" = "M2 Rhythm Gain",
  "3" = "M3 Rhythm Loss",
  "4" = "M4 Amp Enhanced",
  "5" = "M5 Amp Attenuated",
  "6" = "M6 Phase Advanced",
  "7" = "M7 Phase Delayed"
)

module_pal <- c(
  "M0 Non-rhythmic"   = "#BDBDBD",
  "M1 Stable Rhythm"  = "#AFC0D6",
  "M2 Rhythm Gain"    = "#EDC0A0",
  "M3 Rhythm Loss"    = "#7F9DBF",
  "M4 Amp Enhanced"   = "#DF8F79",
  "M5 Amp Attenuated" = "#E7EDF4",
  "M6 Phase Advanced" = "#FAEFD9",
  "M7 Phase Delayed"  = "#4973A8"
)

celltype_pal <- c(
  "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",
  "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"
)

# 3. identify gene column
gene_col <- intersect(
  c("gene", "Gene", "GeneSymbol", "symbol", "features"),
  colnames(param_wide)
)
stopifnot(length(gene_col) >= 1)
gene_col <- gene_col[1]

# 4. convert param_wide -> long
param_long_plot <- param_wide %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(gene = all_of(gene_col)) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    matches("^(Phase|Amplitude|FDR)_(Hep\\.PV|Hep\\.CV)$")
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene,
    names_to = c(".value", "celltype"),
    names_pattern = "^(Phase|Amplitude|FDR)_(Hep\\.PV|Hep\\.CV)$"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    phase_wrap = Phase %% (2 * pi)
  )

# 5. merge module info
module_df <- module_result %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(
    gene = gene,
    module_id = as.character(module_map),
    module_label = recode(as.character(module_map), !!!module_label_map)
  )

plot_df0 <- param_long_plot %>%
  left_join(module_df, by = "gene")

# 6. gene filtering:
# shared modules: M1/M4/M5/M6/M7
# non-shared modules: M2/M3
gene_keep_df <- plot_df0 %>%
  group_by(gene, module_id, module_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_celltype = sum(!is.na(Phase) & !is.na(Amplitude) & !is.na(FDR)),
    fdr_pv = FDR[celltype == "Hep.PV"][1],
    fdr_cv = FDR[celltype == "Hep.CV"][1],
    amp_pv = Amplitude[celltype == "Hep.PV"][1],
    amp_cv = Amplitude[celltype == "Hep.CV"][1],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    both_sig = (fdr_pv < 0.05 & fdr_cv < 0.05),
    one_sig  = xor(fdr_pv < 0.05, fdr_cv < 0.05),
    min_amp  = pmin(amp_pv, amp_cv),
    max_amp  = pmax(amp_pv, amp_cv),
    keep_gene = case_when(
      module_id %in% c("1", "4", "5", "6", "7") ~
        n_celltype == 2 & both_sig & min_amp > 0.10,
      module_id %in% c("2", "3") ~
        n_celltype == 2 & one_sig & max_amp > 0.10,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

plot_df1 <- plot_df0 %>%
  inner_join(
    gene_keep_df %>%
      filter(keep_gene) %>%
      dplyr::select(gene, module_id, module_label),
    by = c("gene", "module_id", "module_label")
  )

# 7. global amplitude scaling
amp_cap <- quantile(plot_df1$Amplitude, probs = 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)

plot_df2 <- plot_df1 %>%
  mutate(
    sig_flag = FDR < 0.05,
    amp_clip = pmin(Amplitude, amp_cap),
    radius_raw = rescale(amp_clip, to = c(0.18, 0.95), from = c(0, amp_cap)),
    radius = case_when(
      module_id %in% c("2", "3") & !sig_flag ~ 0.12,
      TRUE ~ radius_raw
    ),
    x = radius * sin(phase_wrap),
    y = radius * cos(phase_wrap)
  )

# 8. make pairwise table (one row per gene)
pair_df <- plot_df2 %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, celltype, phase_wrap, radius, x, y, Amplitude, FDR, sig_flag, module_id, module_label) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = celltype,
    values_from = c(phase_wrap, radius, x, y, Amplitude, FDR, sig_flag)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_phase = atan2(
      sin(phase_wrap_Hep.CV - phase_wrap_Hep.PV),
      cos(phase_wrap_Hep.CV - phase_wrap_Hep.PV)
    ),
    abs_delta_phase = abs(delta_phase),
    delta_amp = Amplitude_Hep.CV - Amplitude_Hep.PV,
    abs_delta_amp = abs(delta_amp),
    mean_amp = (Amplitude_Hep.PV + Amplitude_Hep.CV) / 2,
    max_amp = pmax(Amplitude_Hep.PV, Amplitude_Hep.CV),
    sum_logfdr = -log10(FDR_Hep.PV + 1e-300) + -log10(FDR_Hep.CV + 1e-300)
  )

# 9. module-specific ranking score
pair_df <- pair_df %>%
  group_by(module_id) %>%
  mutate(
    z_abs_delta_phase = as.numeric(scale(abs_delta_phase)),
    z_abs_delta_amp   = as.numeric(scale(abs_delta_amp)),
    z_mean_amp        = as.numeric(scale(mean_amp)),
    z_max_amp         = as.numeric(scale(max_amp)),
    z_sum_logfdr      = as.numeric(scale(sum_logfdr))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    rank_score = case_when(
      module_id == "1" ~ z_mean_amp + z_sum_logfdr - z_abs_delta_phase - z_abs_delta_amp,
      module_id == "2" ~ z_max_amp + 0.8 * z_abs_delta_phase + 0.5 * z_abs_delta_amp,
      module_id == "3" ~ z_max_amp + 0.8 * z_abs_delta_phase + 0.5 * z_abs_delta_amp,
      module_id == "4" ~ z_abs_delta_amp + 0.5 * z_mean_amp + 0.5 * z_sum_logfdr - 0.5 * z_abs_delta_phase,
      module_id == "5" ~ z_abs_delta_amp + 0.5 * z_mean_amp + 0.5 * z_sum_logfdr - 0.5 * z_abs_delta_phase,
      module_id == "6" ~ z_abs_delta_phase + 0.5 * z_mean_amp + 0.5 * z_sum_logfdr,
      module_id == "7" ~ z_abs_delta_phase + 0.5 * z_mean_amp + 0.5 * z_sum_logfdr,
      TRUE ~ z_mean_amp
    )
  )

# 10. choose top genes per module
top_n_per_module <- 50

top_gene_df <- pair_df %>%
  group_by(module_id) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = rank_score, n = top_n_per_module, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, module_id, module_label, rank_score, abs_delta_phase, abs_delta_amp)

# 11. keep only top genes for plotting
plot_df_top <- plot_df2 %>%
  inner_join(
    top_gene_df %>% dplyr::select(gene, module_id),
    by = c("gene", "module_id")
  )

pair_df_top <- pair_df %>%
  inner_join(
    top_gene_df %>% dplyr::select(gene, module_id),
    by = c("gene", "module_id")
  )


# 13. background for polar frame
circle_df <- tibble(
  r = c(0.18, 0.36, 0.54, 0.72, 0.95)
)

angle_df <- tibble(

  lab_y = 1.16 * cos(angle)

# 14. amplitude tick labels

amp_breaks_raw <- amp_breaks_raw[amp_breaks_raw >= 0]
amp_breaks_raw <- unique(amp_breaks_raw)
amp_breaks_raw <- amp_breaks_raw[amp_breaks_raw <= amp_cap]

amp_tick_df <- tibble(
```

#core clock phase polar panels
```{r}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(readr)
})

load("outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/scCircadianliver_result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV.Rdata")

module_result <- res2_module$module_result

# 1. 核心基因列表
core_clock <- c(
  "Arntl", "Clock", "Npas2", "Cry1", "Cry2",
  "Per1", "Per2", "Per3", "Nr1d1", "Nr1d2",
  "Dbp", "Tef", "Nfil3", "Ciart"
)

# 2. 直接从 module_result 取更新后的 phase/amplitude/fdr
param_core <- module_result %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    gene_std = tools::toTitleCase(tolower(gene))
  ) %>%
  filter(gene_std %in% core_clock) %>%
  transmute(
    gene = gene_std,
    Phase_Hep.CV = as.numeric(phi_Hep.CV),
    Phase_Hep.PV = as.numeric(phi_Hep.PV),
    Amplitude_Hep.CV = as.numeric(A_Hep.CV),
    Amplitude_Hep.PV = as.numeric(A_Hep.PV),
    FDR_Hep.CV = as.numeric(q_Hep.CV),
    FDR_Hep.PV = as.numeric(q_Hep.PV)
  )

# 3. 转成长表
core_long <- param_core %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene,
    names_to = c(".value", "celltype"),
    names_pattern = "^(Phase|Amplitude|FDR)_(Hep\\.PV|Hep\\.CV)$"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    phase_wrap = ((Phase %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi),
    phase_hour = (phase_wrap / (2 * pi)) * 24,
    sig_flag = FDR < 0.05
  )

# 4. 只保留两个 celltype 都存在的核心基因
core_keep <- core_long %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(
    n_ct = sum(!is.na(Phase)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_ct == 2) %>%
  pull(gene)

core_long2 <- core_long %>%
  filter(gene %in% core_keep)

# 5. 排序：按 Hep.PV 相位排序，方便看
gene_order <- core_long2 %>%
  filter(celltype == "Hep.CV") %>%
  arrange(phase_hour) %>%
  pull(gene)

core_long2$gene <- factor(core_long2$gene, levels = gene_order)

# 6. 颜色
celltype_pal <- c(
  "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",
  "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"
)

# 7. 每个 gene 一个小 polar panel
plot_core_gene_panel <- function(gene_use) {
  
  df_sub <- core_long2 %>%
    filter(gene == gene_use) %>%
    mutate(
      point_x = phase_wrap,
      point_y = 0.92
    )
  
  # 轻微 jitter，避免两个点完全重合时看不见
  if (nrow(df_sub) == 2) {
    df_sub <- df_sub %>%
      arrange(celltype) %>%
      mutate(
        point_x = point_x + c(-0.035, 0.035)
      )
  }
  
  # 外圈圆
  circle_df <- tibble(
    theta = seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 400),
    r = 0.92
  )
  
  # 手工时间标签
  label_df <- tibble(
    theta = c(0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2),
    r = c(1.06, 1.06, 1.06, 1.06),
    lab = c("0", "6", "12", "18 ")
  )
  
  ggplot() +
    # 先画点
    geom_point(
      data = df_sub,
      aes(x = point_x, y = point_y, fill = celltype),
      shape = 21,
      size = 5.8,
      stroke = 0.20,
      color = "black",
      alpha = 0.75
    ) +
    
    # 再画外圈圆，让圆圈压在点上层
    geom_path(
      data = circle_df,
      aes(x = theta, y = r),
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.50
    ) +
    
    # 手工时间标签
    geom_text(
      data = label_df,
      aes(x = theta, y = r, label = lab),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 3.2,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_pal) +
    
    coord_polar(theta = "x", start = 0, direction = 1, clip = "off") +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 2*pi),
      breaks = NULL,
      labels = NULL
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.10)) +
    
    labs(title = gene_use) +
    
    theme_void(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 11),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    )
}
# 8. 批量生成小图
plot_list <- lapply(levels(core_long2$gene), plot_core_gene_panel)

# 9. 拼图
ncol_use <- 7
p_core_clock <- wrap_plots(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = ncol_use)

# 10. 单独做 legend
legend_df <- tibble(
  x = c(1, 2),
  y = c(1, 1),
  celltype = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV")
)

p_legend <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = legend_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y, fill = celltype),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5.6,
    stroke = 0.20,
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_pal) +
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = 0.72, label = "Hep.CV", size = 3.4) +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = 0.72, label = "Hep.PV", size = 3.4) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.5, 2.5), ylim = c(0.5, 1.25), clip = "off") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
p_final <- p_core_clock / p_legend + plot_layout(heights = c(12, 1.2))

p_final

# 11. 保存
out_dir <- "outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/core_clock_polar"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "core_clock_phase_similarity_panels.pdf"),
  p_final,
  width = 8,
  height = 3
)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "core_clock_phase_similarity_panels.png"),
  p_final,
  width = 8,
  height = 3,
  dpi = 300
)
```

#core gene level curve
```{r}
rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(Matrix)
  library(ggplot2)
})

load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_object_celltype_use.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_infer_scRhythm_phase.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_countmat.Rdata")

DefaultAssay(obj_use) <- "RNA"

# 1. helper
wrap_phase <- function(x) {
  ((as.numeric(x) %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi)
}

# 2. core clock genes
core_clock <- c(
  "Arntl", "Clock", "Npas2", "Cry1", "Cry2",
  "Per1", "Per2", "Per3", "Nr1d1", "Nr1d2",
  "Dbp", "Tef", "Nfil3", "Ciart"
)

# 3. expression matrix
expr_mat <- GetAssayData(obj_use, assay = "RNA", layer  = "data")
genes_use <- intersect(core_clock, rownames(expr_mat))
length(genes_use)
genes_use

# 4. metadata
theta_pred_vec <- as.numeric(res_phase_liver$theta_pred)
names(theta_pred_vec) <- colnames(count_mat)

meta_plot <- obj_use@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    theta_pred = theta_pred_vec[cell]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    celltype %in% c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"),
    is.finite(theta_pred)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    theta_pred = wrap_phase(theta_pred),
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
  )

# 5. gene-wise z-score, then average across core clock genes
expr_sub <- expr_mat[genes_use, meta_plot$cell, drop = FALSE]
expr_sub <- as.matrix(expr_sub)

expr_z <- t(scale(t(expr_sub)))
expr_z[is.na(expr_z)] <- 0

core_score <- colMeans(expr_z)

plot_df <- meta_plot %>%
  mutate(
    core_clock_score = core_score[cell]
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(core_clock_score))

# 6. colors
celltype_pal <- c(
  "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",
  "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"
)

# 7. plot
p_core_curve <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = theta_pred, y = core_clock_score, color = celltype)) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.12,
    size = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    se = TRUE,
    method = "loess",
    span = 0.35,
    linewidth = 1.25
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = celltype_pal, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 2*pi),
    breaks = c(0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2, 2*pi),
    labels = c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2", "2π"),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Core clock gene-set rhythm",
    x = expression("Predicted phase " * phi),
    y = "Core clock score"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

p_core_curve

# 8. save
out_dir <- "outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/gene_set_curve"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "core_clock_gene_set_curve_by_celltype.pdf"),
  p_core_curve,
  width = 6.8,
  height = 4.8
)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "core_clock_gene_set_curve_by_celltype.png"),
  p_core_curve,
  width = 6.8,
  height = 4.8,
  dpi = 300
)


# single-gene dual rhythm curve by celltype
rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_object_celltype_use.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_infer_scRhythm_phase.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_countmat.Rdata")

DefaultAssay(obj_use) <- "RNA"

# 1. helper
wrap_phase <- function(x) {
  ((as.numeric(x) %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi)
}

# 2. fixed color rule
celltype_pal <- c(
  "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",  # blue
  "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"   # orange
)

# 3. metadata
theta_pred_vec <- as.numeric(res_phase_liver$theta_pred)
names(theta_pred_vec) <- colnames(count_mat)

meta_plot <- obj_use@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    theta_pred = theta_pred_vec[cell]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    celltype %in% c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"),
    is.finite(theta_pred)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    theta_pred = wrap_phase(theta_pred),
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
  )

# 4. plotting function
plot_gene_dual_curve <- function(gene_use,
                                 assay_slot = "data",
                                 point_alpha = 0.12,
                                 point_size = 0.8,
                                 smooth_span = 0.35,
                                 add_points = TRUE) {
  
  expr_mat <- GetAssayData(obj_use, assay = "RNA", layer= assay_slot)
  
  if (!(gene_use %in% rownames(expr_mat))) {
    stop(paste0("Gene not found in expression matrix: ", gene_use))
  }
  
  gene_expr <- as.numeric(expr_mat[gene_use, meta_plot$cell])
  
  plot_df <- meta_plot %>%
    mutate(expr = gene_expr) %>%
    filter(is.finite(expr))
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = theta_pred, y = expr, color = celltype))
  
  if (add_points) {
    p <- p +
      geom_point(
        alpha = point_alpha,
        size = point_size
      )
  }
  
  p <- p +
    geom_smooth(
      se = TRUE,
      method = "loess",
      span = smooth_span,
      linewidth = 1.25
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = celltype_pal, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 2*pi),
      breaks = c(0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2, 2*pi),
      labels = c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2", "2π"),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = gene_use,
      x = expression("Predicted phase " * phi),
      y = paste0(gene_use, " expression")
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
    )
  
  return(p)
}
p_per2 <- plot_gene_dual_curve("Per2")
p_per2
p_arntl <- plot_gene_dual_curve("Arntl")
p_arntl
out_dir <- "outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/gene_dual_curve"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

p_per2 <- plot_gene_dual_curve("Per2")

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "Per2_dual_curve_by_celltype.pdf"),
  p_per2,
  width = 4,
  height = 4.6
)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "Per2_dual_curve_by_celltype.png"),
  p_per2,
  width = 4,
  height = 4.6,
  dpi = 300
)

# 2. fixed color rule

  "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"   # orange
)

# 3. metadata
theta_pred_vec <- as.numeric(res_phase_liver$theta_pred)
names(theta_pred_vec) <- colnames(count_mat)

meta_plot <- obj_use@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    theta_pred = theta_pred_vec[cell]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    celltype %in% c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"),
    is.finite(theta_pred)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    theta_pred = wrap_phase(theta_pred),
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
  )

# 4. 先对单基因做 smooth，输出平滑后的曲线数据
smooth_gene_curve_df <- function(gene_use,
                                 assay_slot = "data",
                                 span = 0.35,
                                 n_grid = 200,
                                 extend_cycle = TRUE) {
  
  expr_mat <- GetAssayData(obj_use, assay = "RNA", layer = assay_slot)
  
  if (!(gene_use %in% rownames(expr_mat))) {
    stop(paste0("Gene not found in expression matrix: ", gene_use))
  }
  
  gene_expr <- as.numeric(expr_mat[gene_use, meta_plot$cell])
  
  plot_df <- meta_plot %>%
    mutate(expr = gene_expr) %>%
    filter(is.finite(expr))
  
  theta_grid <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_grid)
  
  smooth_list <- lapply(levels(plot_df$celltype), function(ct) {
    
    df_ct <- plot_df %>%
      filter(celltype == ct) %>%
      select(theta_pred, expr)
    
    # 为了处理周期边界，把 [0, 2pi] 扩成三段
    if (extend_cycle) {
      df_fit <- bind_rows(
        df_ct %>% mutate(theta_fit = theta_pred - 2 * pi),
        df_ct %>% mutate(theta_fit = theta_pred),
        df_ct %>% mutate(theta_fit = theta_pred + 2 * pi)
      )
    } else {
      df_fit <- df_ct %>% mutate(theta_fit = theta_pred)
    }
    
    # loess 拟合
    fit_obj <- loess(
      expr ~ theta_fit,
      data = df_fit,
      span = span,
      degree = 2,
      family = "gaussian",
      surface = "direct"
    )
    
    pred_df <- tibble(
      theta_pred = theta_grid,
      expr_smooth = as.numeric(
        predict(fit_obj, newdata = tibble(theta_fit = theta_grid))
      ),
      celltype = ct
    )
    
    pred_df
  })
  
  smooth_df <- bind_rows(smooth_list) %>%
    mutate(
      celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
    )
  
  list(
    raw_df = plot_df,
    smooth_df = smooth_df
  )
}

# 5. 再画图：原始点 + 先smooth后的曲线
plot_gene_dual_curve_smooth <- function(gene_use,
                                        assay_slot = "data",
                                        point_alpha = 0.10,
                                        point_size = 0.7,
                                        line_width = 1.4,
                                        span = 0.35,
                                        n_grid = 200,
                                        add_points = TRUE,
                                        add_smooth = TRUE) {
  
  res_smooth <- smooth_gene_curve_df(
    gene_use = gene_use,
    assay_slot = assay_slot,
    span = span,
    n_grid = n_grid,
    extend_cycle = TRUE
  )
  
  plot_df <- res_smooth$raw_df
  smooth_df <- res_smooth$smooth_df
  
  p <- ggplot()
  
  if (add_points) {
    p <- p +
      geom_point(
        data = plot_df,
        aes(x = theta_pred, y = expr, color = celltype),
        alpha = point_alpha,
        size = point_size
      )
  }
  
  if (add_smooth) {
    p <- p +
      geom_line(
        data = smooth_df,
        aes(x = theta_pred, y = expr_smooth, color = celltype),
        linewidth = line_width
      )
  }
  
  p <- p +
    scale_color_manual(values = celltype_pal, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 2 * pi),
      breaks = c(0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2, 2*pi),
      labels = c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2", "2π"),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = gene_use,
      x = expression("Predicted phase " * phi),
      y = paste0(gene_use, " expression")
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# 6. test
p_per2 <- plot_gene_dual_curve_smooth("Per2")
p_per2

p_arntl <- plot_gene_dual_curve_smooth("Arntl")
p_arntl

  p_per2,
  width = 4.2,
  height = 4.8,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_object_celltype_use.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_infer_scRhythm_phase.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_countmat.Rdata")

DefaultAssay(obj_use) <- "RNA"

# 1. helper
wrap_phase <- function(x) {
  ((as.numeric(x) %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi)
}

# 2. fixed color rule
celltype_pal <- c(
  "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",  # blue
  "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"   # orange
)

# 3. metadata
theta_pred_vec <- as.numeric(res_phase_liver$theta_pred)
names(theta_pred_vec) <- colnames(count_mat)

meta_plot <- obj_use@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    theta_pred = theta_pred_vec[cell]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    celltype %in% c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"),
    is.finite(theta_pred)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    theta_pred = wrap_phase(theta_pred),
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
  )

# 4. plotting function
plot_gene_dual_cos_curve <- function(gene_use,
                                     assay_slot = "data",
                                     point_alpha = 0.14,
                                     point_size = 0.9,
                                     line_width = 1.35,
                                     n_grid = 300) {
  
  expr_mat <- GetAssayData(obj_use, assay = "RNA", layer = assay_slot)
  stopifnot(gene_use %in% rownames(expr_mat))
  
  gene_expr <- as.numeric(expr_mat[gene_use, meta_plot$cell])
  
  plot_df <- meta_plot %>%
    mutate(expr = gene_expr) %>%
    filter(is.finite(expr))
  
  # harmonic regression in each celltype: expr ~ cos(theta) + sin(theta)
  fit_df <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(celltype) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      dat <- .x
      fit <- lm(expr ~ cos(theta_pred) + sin(theta_pred), data = dat)
      grid <- tibble(theta_pred = seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = n_grid))
      tibble(
        theta_pred = grid$theta_pred,
        expr_fit = predict(fit, newdata = grid)
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  ggplot() +
    # CV: blue solid points
    geom_point(
      data = plot_df %>% filter(celltype == "Hep.CV"),
      aes(x = theta_pred, y = expr),
      color = celltype_pal["Hep.CV"],
      alpha = point_alpha,
      size = point_size
    ) +
    # PV: orange hollow points
    geom_point(
      data = plot_df %>% filter(celltype == "Hep.PV"),
      aes(x = theta_pred, y = expr),
      shape = 1,
      color = celltype_pal["Hep.PV"],
      alpha = point_alpha + 0.05,
      size = point_size,
      stroke = 0.55
    ) +
    # CV cosine fit
    geom_line(
      data = fit_df %>% filter(celltype == "Hep.CV"),
      aes(x = theta_pred, y = expr_fit),
      color = celltype_pal["Hep.CV"],
      linewidth = line_width
    ) +
    # PV cosine fit
    geom_line(
      data = fit_df %>% filter(celltype == "Hep.PV"),
      aes(x = theta_pred, y = expr_fit),
      color = celltype_pal["Hep.PV"],
      linewidth = line_width
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 2*pi),
      breaks = c(0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2, 2*pi),
      labels = c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2", "2π"),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = gene_use,
      x = expression("Predicted phase " * phi),
      y = paste0(gene_use, " expression")
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
    ) +
    annotate("point", x = 0.25, y = max(plot_df$expr, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.98,
             shape = 16, size = 3.2, color = celltype_pal["Hep.CV"]) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.48, y = max(plot_df$expr, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.98,
             label = "Hep.CV", hjust = 0, size = 4.0) +
    annotate("point", x = 0.25, y = max(plot_df$expr, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.90,
             shape = 1, size = 3.2, color = celltype_pal["Hep.PV"], stroke = 0.9) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.48, y = max(plot_df$expr, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.90,
             label = "Hep.PV", hjust = 0, size = 4.0)
}

# 5. examples
p_per2  <- plot_gene_dual_cos_curve("Per2")
p_arntl <- plot_gene_dual_cos_curve("Arntl")

p_per2
p_arntl

)
```

```{r}
# 4. 计算表达检测率和平均表达
expr_mat <- GetAssayData(obj_use, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")

expr_long <- tibble(cell = colnames(expr_mat)) %>%
  left_join(
    obj_use@meta.data %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
      select(cell, celltype),
    by = "cell"
  ) %>%
  filter(celltype %in% c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))

genes_common <- intersect(rownames(expr_mat), module_df$gene)

expr_sub <- as.matrix(expr_mat[genes_common, expr_long$cell, drop = FALSE])

gene_expr_summary <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    gene = rownames(expr_sub),
    mean_expr_Hep.CV = rowMeans(expr_sub[, expr_long$celltype == "Hep.CV", drop = FALSE]),
    pct_nonzero_Hep.CV = rowMeans(expr_sub[, expr_long$celltype == "Hep.CV", drop = FALSE] > 0)
  ),
  tibble(
    gene = rownames(expr_sub),
    mean_expr_Hep.PV = rowMeans(expr_sub[, expr_long$celltype == "Hep.PV", drop = FALSE]),
    pct_nonzero_Hep.PV = rowMeans(expr_sub[, expr_long$celltype == "Hep.PV", drop = FALSE] > 0)
  )
) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_expr_Hep.CV = max(mean_expr_Hep.CV, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_nonzero_Hep.CV = max(pct_nonzero_Hep.CV, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_expr_Hep.PV = max(mean_expr_Hep.PV, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_nonzero_Hep.PV = max(pct_nonzero_Hep.PV, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# 5. 直接从 module_result 构建 module-aware pair_df
pair_df <- module_result %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(
    gene = gene,
    module_id = as.character(module_map),
    module_label = recode(as.character(module_map), !!!module_label_map),
    q_Hep.CV = as.numeric(q_Hep.CV),
    q_Hep.PV = as.numeric(q_Hep.PV),
    A_Hep.CV = as.numeric(A_Hep.CV),
    A_Hep.PV = as.numeric(A_Hep.PV),
    phi_Hep.CV = as.numeric(phi_Hep.CV),
    phi_Hep.PV = as.numeric(phi_Hep.PV)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    phase_wrap_Hep.CV = ((phi_Hep.CV %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi),
    phase_wrap_Hep.PV = ((phi_Hep.PV %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi),
    delta_phase = atan2(
      sin(phase_wrap_Hep.CV - phase_wrap_Hep.PV),
      cos(phase_wrap_Hep.CV - phase_wrap_Hep.PV)
    ),
    abs_delta_phase = abs(delta_phase),
    delta_amp = A_Hep.CV - A_Hep.PV,
    abs_delta_amp = abs(delta_amp),
    mean_amp = (A_Hep.CV + A_Hep.PV) / 2,
    max_amp = pmax(A_Hep.CV, A_Hep.PV, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_logfdr = -log10(q_Hep.CV + 1e-300) + -log10(q_Hep.PV + 1e-300)
  )
pair_df <- pair_df %>%
  group_by(module_id) %>%
  mutate(
    z_abs_delta_phase = as.numeric(scale(abs_delta_phase)),
    z_abs_delta_amp   = as.numeric(scale(abs_delta_amp)),
    z_mean_amp        = as.numeric(scale(mean_amp)),
    z_max_amp         = as.numeric(scale(max_amp)),
    z_sum_logfdr      = as.numeric(scale(sum_logfdr))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    rank_score = case_when(
      module_id == "1" ~ z_mean_amp + z_sum_logfdr - z_abs_delta_phase - z_abs_delta_amp,
      module_id == "2" ~ z_max_amp,
      module_id == "3" ~ z_max_amp,
      module_id == "4" ~ z_abs_delta_amp + 0.5 * z_mean_amp + 0.5 * z_sum_logfdr - 0.5 * z_abs_delta_phase,
      module_id == "5" ~ z_abs_delta_amp + 0.5 * z_mean_amp + 0.5 * z_sum_logfdr - 0.5 * z_abs_delta_phase,
      module_id == "6" ~ z_abs_delta_phase + 0.5 * z_mean_amp + 0.5 * z_sum_logfdr,
      module_id == "7" ~ z_abs_delta_phase + 0.5 * z_mean_amp + 0.5 * z_sum_logfdr,
      TRUE ~ z_mean_amp
    )
  )
# 5. 和 pair_df 合并，生成展示候选表
candidate_df <- pair_df %>%
  left_join(module_df, by = c("gene", "module_id", "module_label")) %>%
  left_join(gene_expr_summary, by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(
    max_mean_expr = pmax(mean_expr_Hep.CV, mean_expr_Hep.PV, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_pct_nonzero = pmax(pct_nonzero_Hep.CV, pct_nonzero_Hep.PV, na.rm = TRUE),
    drug_hit = gene %in% drug_genes
  ) %>%
  group_by(module_id) %>%
  mutate(
    z_max_mean_expr = as.numeric(scale(max_mean_expr)),
    z_max_pct_nonzero = as.numeric(scale(max_pct_nonzero))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    display_score = rank_score +
      0.8 * coalesce(z_max_mean_expr, 0) +
      0.8 * coalesce(z_max_pct_nonzero, 0) +
      1.0 * as.numeric(drug_hit)
  )

# 6. 生成每个 module 更适合展示的 top genes
display_top_df <- candidate_df %>%
  filter(
    max_pct_nonzero >= 0.05,
    max_mean_expr >= 0.02
  ) %>%
  group_by(module_id, module_label) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = display_score, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(module_id, desc(display_score))

display_top_df %>%
  select(
    gene, module_id, module_label,
    rank_score, display_score,
    max_mean_expr, max_pct_nonzero,
    drug_hit
  )

# 7. 单独看 drug_metabolism genes 在每个 module 的候选情况
drug_display_df <- display_top_df %>%
  filter(drug_hit) %>%
  arrange(module_id, desc(display_score))

drug_display_df

drug_full_df <- pair_df %>%
  left_join(module_df, by = c("gene", "module_id", "module_label")) %>%
  left_join(gene_expr_summary, by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(
    max_mean_expr = pmax(mean_expr_Hep.CV, mean_expr_Hep.PV, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_pct_nonzero = pmax(pct_nonzero_Hep.CV, pct_nonzero_Hep.PV, na.rm = TRUE),
    drug_hit = gene %in% drug_genes
  ) %>%
  filter(drug_hit) %>%
  arrange(module_id, desc(rank_score))
```

```{r}
  pct_nonzero_Hep.CV = rowMeans(expr_sub[, expr_long$celltype == "Hep.CV", drop = FALSE] > 0),
  mean_expr_Hep.PV = rowMeans(expr_sub[, expr_long$celltype == "Hep.PV", drop = FALSE]),
  pct_nonzero_Hep.PV = rowMeans(expr_sub[, expr_long$celltype == "Hep.PV", drop = FALSE] > 0)

# build drug_full_df directly from updated module_result

  as_tibble() %>%

    gene = gene,
    module_id = as.character(module_map),
    module_label = recode(as.character(module_map), !!!module_label_map),
    q_Hep.CV = as.numeric(q_Hep.CV),
    q_Hep.PV = as.numeric(q_Hep.PV),
    A_Hep.CV = as.numeric(A_Hep.CV),
    A_Hep.PV = as.numeric(A_Hep.PV),
    phi_Hep.CV = as.numeric(phi_Hep.CV),
    phi_Hep.PV = as.numeric(phi_Hep.PV)
  ) %>%
  left_join(gene_expr_summary, by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(
    phase_wrap_Hep.CV = ((phi_Hep.CV %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi),
    phase_wrap_Hep.PV = ((phi_Hep.PV %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi),
    delta_phase = atan2(
      sin(phase_wrap_Hep.CV - phase_wrap_Hep.PV),
      cos(phase_wrap_Hep.CV - phase_wrap_Hep.PV)
    ),
    abs_delta_phase = abs(delta_phase),
    delta_amp = A_Hep.CV - A_Hep.PV,
    abs_delta_amp = abs(delta_amp),
    mean_amp = (A_Hep.CV + A_Hep.PV) / 2,
    max_amp = pmax(A_Hep.CV, A_Hep.PV, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_logfdr = -log10(q_Hep.CV + 1e-300) + -log10(q_Hep.PV + 1e-300),
    max_mean_expr = pmax(mean_expr_Hep.CV, mean_expr_Hep.PV, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_pct_nonzero = pmax(pct_nonzero_Hep.CV, pct_nonzero_Hep.PV, na.rm = TRUE),
    drug_hit = gene %in% drug_genes
  ) %>%
  filter(drug_hit)

    z_max_mean_expr = as.numeric(scale(max_mean_expr)),
    z_max_pct_nonzero = as.numeric(scale(max_pct_nonzero))
  ) %>%
```

# focus genes MAGIC cos
```{r}

rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(Matrix)
  library(readr)
  library(Rmagic)
  library(ggplot2)
})


# 0. load data
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_object_celltype_use.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_infer_scRhythm_phase.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/scCircadianliver_result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV.Rdata")

DefaultAssay(obj_use) <- "RNA"
module_result <- res2_module$module_result

expr_data <- GetAssayData(
  obj_use,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "data"
)

theta_pred_vec <- as.numeric(res_phase_liver$theta_pred)
names(theta_pred_vec) <- colnames(obj_use)

cell_meta <- obj_use@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    theta_pred = theta_pred_vec[cell]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    celltype %in% c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"),
    is.finite(theta_pred)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
  )


# 1. use your real focus gene list here

focus_genes_final <- c("Abcg5","Acly", "Akr1d1","Ap1ar","Arntl","Ass1", "Bhlhe41","Bmyc","Cd36","Cdkn1a","Cdo1", "Clock","Crp","Csad", "Cyp2e1","Cyp2j13", "Dmgdh","Egr1", "Elovl3","Fads2","Gamt", "Gls2", "Gnmt", "Got1","Gstm5","Hjurp","Hmgcs2","Ivd","Lgr5", "Map3k7","Nr0b2","Nr1d1","Pck1", "Pcna", "Pdha1","Per2", "Por","Rdh19","Rdh5", "Sds","Slco1b2","Snai1","Sox4", "Tnfrsf23", "Traf2"
) %>%
  unique() %>% 
  sort()        # 按字母顺序排序

# 2. module map

module_label_map <- c(
  "0" = "M0 Non-rhythmic",
  "1" = "M1 Stable Rhythm",
  "2" = "M2 Rhythm Gain",
  "3" = "M3 Rhythm Loss",
  "4" = "M4 Amp Enhanced",
  "5" = "M5 Amp Attenuated",
  "6" = "M6 Phase Advanced",
  "7" = "M7 Phase Delayed"
)

module_df <- module_result %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(
    gene = gene,
    module_id = as.character(module_map),
    module_label = recode(as.character(module_map), !!!module_label_map)
  )


# 3. split cells by celltype once

cell_meta_cv <- cell_meta %>%
  filter(celltype == "Hep.CV") %>%
  arrange(theta_pred)

cell_meta_pv <- cell_meta %>%
  filter(celltype == "Hep.PV") %>%
  arrange(theta_pred)

expr_cv <- expr_data[, cell_meta_cv$cell, drop = FALSE]
expr_pv <- expr_data[, cell_meta_pv$cell, drop = FALSE]

magic_input_cv <- t(as.matrix(expr_cv))
magic_input_pv <- t(as.matrix(expr_pv))

celltype_pal <- c(
  "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",
  "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"
)

theta_grid <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 300)

out_dir <- "outputs/liver/MAGIC_RESULT_phase2/drug_focus_gene_curves"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


# 4. loop over genes

for (gene_use in focus_genes_final) {
  
  message("Running: ", gene_use)
  
  gene_in_cv <- gene_use %in% colnames(magic_input_cv)
  gene_in_pv <- gene_use %in% colnames(magic_input_pv)
  
  if (!(gene_in_cv && gene_in_pv)) {
    message("Skip gene not found in MAGIC input: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  
  data_MAGIC_cv <- tryCatch(
    magic(magic_input_cv, genes = gene_use),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  data_MAGIC_pv <- tryCatch(
    magic(magic_input_pv, genes = gene_use),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(data_MAGIC_cv) || is.null(data_MAGIC_pv)) {
    message("Skip gene due to MAGIC failure: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  
  plot_df_magic_cv <- cell_meta_cv %>%
    mutate(expr_magic = as.numeric(data_MAGIC_cv$result[, gene_use]))
  
  plot_df_magic_pv <- cell_meta_pv %>%
    mutate(expr_magic = as.numeric(data_MAGIC_pv$result[, gene_use]))
  
  module_info <- module_df %>%
    filter(gene == gene_use) %>%
    distinct(gene, module_id, module_label)
  
  module_id_use <- module_info$module_id[1]
  module_label_use <- module_info$module_label[1]
  
  active_map <- c(
    "0" = "both",
    "1" = "both",
    "2" = "Hep.PV",
    "3" = "Hep.CV",
    "4" = "both",
    "5" = "both",
    "6" = "both",
    "7" = "both"
  )
  
  active_mode <- active_map[module_id_use]
  
  plot_df_magic <- bind_rows(
    plot_df_magic_cv %>% mutate(source_keep = "Hep.CV"),
    plot_df_magic_pv %>% mutate(source_keep = "Hep.PV")
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(expr_magic)) %>%
    filter(
      source_keep %in% c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV")[c(active_mode == "both", active_mode == "both")] |
        source_keep == active_mode
    )
  
  # 上面那句等价于：
  # both -> 保留两侧
  # Hep.PV -> 只保留 Hep.PV
  # Hep.CV -> 只保留 Hep.CV
  
  if (nrow(plot_df_magic) == 0) {
    message("Skip gene due to empty plotting df: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  
  cosinor_df <- plot_df_magic %>%
    group_by(celltype) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      df_ct <- .x %>%
        dplyr::select(theta_pred, expr_magic) %>%
        filter(is.finite(theta_pred), is.finite(expr_magic))
      
      if (nrow(df_ct) < 10 || sd(df_ct$expr_magic) == 0) {
        return(tibble())
      }
      
      fit <- tryCatch(
        lm(expr_magic ~ cos(theta_pred) + sin(theta_pred), data = df_ct),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      
      if (is.null(fit)) {
        return(tibble())
      }
      
      pred <- tryCatch(
        predict(fit, newdata = tibble(theta_pred = theta_grid), se.fit = TRUE),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      
      if (is.null(pred)) {
        return(tibble())
      }
      
      tibble(
        theta_pred = theta_grid,
        expr_fit = as.numeric(pred$fit),
        expr_lower = as.numeric(pred$fit - pred$se.fit),
        expr_upper = as.numeric(pred$fit + pred$se.fit)
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  if (nrow(cosinor_df) == 0) {
    message("Skip gene due to empty cosinor df: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  
  p_magic_dual <- ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = cosinor_df,
      aes(
        x = theta_pred,
        ymin = expr_lower,
        ymax = expr_upper,
        fill = celltype
      ),
      alpha = 0.18,
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = cosinor_df,
      aes(x = theta_pred, y = expr_fit, color = celltype),
      linewidth = 4
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = celltype_pal, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_pal, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 2*pi),
      breaks = c(0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2, 2*pi),
      labels = c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2", "2π"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.04))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = gene_use,
      x = expression("Predicted phase " * phi),
      y = "Normalized Expression"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 45),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 32, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 32, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 27),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 27),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 25),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 10)
    )
  
  print(p_magic_dual)
  
  file_stub <- paste0(
    "M", module_id_use, "_",
    gsub("[[:space:]]+", "_", module_label_use), "_",
    gene_use, "_MAGIC_cosinor"
  )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_stub, ".pdf")),
    p_magic_dual,
    width = 5,
    height = 5.7
  )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_stub, ".png")),
    p_magic_dual,
    width = 5,
    height = 5.7,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```

#amplitude density 
```{r}
# gene-level amplitude density by current liver modules
rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr)
})

# 0. load current liver results
load("outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/scCircadianliver_result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV.Rdata")

module_result <- res2_module$module_result

plot_dir <- "outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/AMP_DENSITY_BY_MODULE"
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 1. maps
module_label_map <- c(
  "0" = "M0 Non-rhythmic",
  "1" = "M1 Stable Rhythm",
  "2" = "M2 Rhythm Gain",
  "3" = "M3 Rhythm Loss",
  "4" = "M4 Amp Enhanced",
  "5" = "M5 Amp Attenuated",
  "6" = "M6 Phase Advanced",
  "7" = "M7 Phase Delayed"
)

group_colors <- c(
  "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",
  "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"
)

# 2. 从 module_result 直接取已经按 module 逻辑处理后的 amplitude
scrhythm_df <- module_result %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(
    gene = as.character(gene),
    module_id = as.integer(module_map),
    amp_Hep.CV = as.numeric(A_Hep.CV),
    amp_Hep.PV = as.numeric(A_Hep.PV)
  )

# 3. helper: one module -> long
make_amp_long_self <- function(method_df, id_col, target_id) {
  
  out <- method_df %>%
    filter(.data[[id_col]] == target_id) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(amp_Hep.CV, amp_Hep.PV),
      names_to = "Group",
      values_to = "Amplitude"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Group = stringr::str_remove(Group, "^amp_"),
      Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV")),
      Amplitude = as.numeric(Amplitude)
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(Amplitude))
  
  out
}

# 4. helper: draw amp density
draw_amp_density <- function(plot_df, title_text) {
  
  ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = Amplitude, color = Group, fill = Group)
  ) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.18, linewidth = 1.2, adjust = 1.1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0.25,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "red",
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 4)) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(0, 0.25, 1, 2, 3, 4),
      labels = c("0", "0.25", "1", "2", "3", "4")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = "Amplitude",
      y = "Density",
      color = "Group",
      fill = "Group"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12)
    )
}

# 5. run all modules
module_ids <- sort(unique(na.omit(scrhythm_df$module_id)))

for (m in module_ids) {
  
  message("Running module ", m)
  
  sc_long <- make_amp_long_self(
    method_df = scrhythm_df,
    id_col = "module_id",
    target_id = m
  )
  
  readr::write_tsv(
    sc_long,
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0(m, "_amp_long.tsv"))
  )
  
  title_text <- paste0(
    module_label_map[as.character(m)],
    " - Amplitude Density"
  )
  
  p_sc <- draw_amp_density(sc_long, title_text)
  
  print(p_sc)
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0("scRhythmBayes_M", m, "_amp_density.pdf")),
    p_sc, width = 6, height = 5
  )
  ggsave(
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0("scRhythmBayes_M", m, "_amp_density.png")),
    p_sc, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300
  )
  
  rm(sc_long, p_sc)
  gc()
}

# 6. overall amplitude density
amp_all_long <- scrhythm_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(amp_Hep.CV, amp_Hep.PV),
    names_to = "Group",
    values_to = "Amplitude"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = stringr::str_remove(Group, "^amp_"),
```

```{r}
# gene-level phase density by current liver modules
rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr)
})

# 0. load current liver results
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_result_param_scRhythm_phase2.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/scCircadianliver_result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV.Rdata")

param_wide <- res_param_liver2$param_wide
module_result <- res2_module$module_result

plot_dir <- "outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/PHASE_DENSITY_BY_MODULE"
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 1. maps
module_label_map <- c(
  "0" = "M0 Non-rhythmic",
  "1" = "M1 Stable Rhythm",
  "2" = "M2 Rhythm Gain",
  "3" = "M3 Rhythm Loss",
  "4" = "M4 Amp Enhanced",
  "5" = "M5 Amp Attenuated",
  "6" = "M6 Phase Advanced",
  "7" = "M7 Phase Delayed"
)

group_colors <- c(
  "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",
  "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"
)

# 2. gene column
gene_col <- intersect(
  c("gene", "Gene", "GeneSymbol", "symbol", "features"),
  colnames(param_wide)
)
stopifnot(length(gene_col) >= 1)
gene_col <- gene_col[1]

# 3. build scRhythmBayes df from current liver results
scrhythm_df <- param_wide %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(gene = all_of(gene_col)) %>%
  transmute(
    gene = as.character(gene),
    phase_Hep.CV = (((as.numeric(Phase_Hep.CV) %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi)) / (2 * pi) * 24,
    phase_Hep.PV = (((as.numeric(Phase_Hep.PV) %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi)) / (2 * pi) * 24
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    module_result %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      select(gene, module_map),
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    gene = gene,
    module_id = as.integer(module_map),
    phase_Hep.CV = phase_Hep.CV,
    phase_Hep.PV = phase_Hep.PV
  )

# 4. helper: one module -> long
make_phase_long_self <- function(method_df, id_col, target_id) {
  
  out <- method_df %>%
    filter(.data[[id_col]] == target_id) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(phase_Hep.CV, phase_Hep.PV),
      names_to = "Group",
      values_to = "Phase_hour"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Group = stringr::str_remove(Group, "^phase_"),
      Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV")),
      Phase_hour = as.numeric(Phase_hour)
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(Phase_hour))
  
  out
}

# 5. helper: draw phase density
draw_phase_density <- function(plot_df, title_text) {
  
  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = Phase_hour, color = Group, fill = Group)
  ) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.18, linewidth = 1.2, adjust = 1.1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 24),
      breaks = c(0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = "Phase (hour)",
      y = "Density",
      color = "Group",
      fill = "Group"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12)
    )
  
  p
}

# 6. run all modules
module_ids <- sort(unique(na.omit(scrhythm_df$module_id)))

for (m in module_ids) {
  
  message("Running module ", m)
  
  sc_long <- make_phase_long_self(
    method_df = scrhythm_df,
    id_col = "module_id",
    target_id = m
  )
  
  readr::write_tsv(
    sc_long,
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0("scRhythmBayes_M", m, "_phase_long.tsv"))
  )
  
  title_text <- paste0(
    "scRhythmBayes ",
    module_label_map[as.character(m)],
    " - Phase Density"
  )
  
  p_sc <- draw_phase_density(
    sc_long,
    title_text
  )
  
  print(p_sc)
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0("scRhythmBayes_M", m, "_phase_density.pdf")),
    p_sc, width = 6, height = 5
  )
  ggsave(
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0("scRhythmBayes_M", m, "_phase_density.png")),
    p_sc, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300
  )
  
  rm(sc_long, p_sc)
  gc()
}

# 7. overall phase density
phase_all_long <- scrhythm_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(phase_Hep.CV, phase_Hep.PV),
    names_to = "Group",
    values_to = "Phase_hour"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = stringr::str_remove(Group, "^phase_"),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV")),
    Phase_hour = as.numeric(Phase_hour)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(Phase_hour))

p_all <- draw_phase_density(
  phase_all_long,
  "All genes - Phase Density"
)

print(p_all)

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "All_genes_phase_density.pdf"),
  p_all, width = 6, height = 5
)
ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "All_genes_phase_density.png"),
  p_all, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
# 4. helper
# 方向与你现在确认的一样：统计 >= threshold 的基因数
make_phase_cumulative_df <- function(values_1, values_2, thresholds, label_1, label_2) {
  
  d1 <- tibble(
    Phase_hour = thresholds,
    Cumulative.Count = sapply(thresholds, function(thresh) {
      sum(values_1 >= thresh, na.rm = TRUE)
    }),
    Group = label_1
  )
  
  d2 <- tibble(
    Phase_hour = thresholds,
    Cumulative.Count = sapply(thresholds, function(thresh) {
      sum(values_2 >= thresh, na.rm = TRUE)
    }),
    Group = label_2
  )
  
  bind_rows(d1, d2) %>%
    mutate(
      log10.Cumulative.Count = log10(Cumulative.Count + 1)
    )
}
```

```{r}
# 4. helper
make_amp_cumulative_df <- function(values_1, values_2, label_1, label_2,
                                   step = 0.01, x_cap = 4) {
  
  thresholds <- seq(0, x_cap, by = step)
  
  d1 <- tibble(
    Amplitude = thresholds,
    Cumulative.Count = sapply(thresholds, function(thresh) {
      sum(values_1 >= thresh, na.rm = TRUE)
    }),
    Group = label_1
  )
  
  d2 <- tibble(
    Amplitude = thresholds,
    Cumulative.Count = sapply(thresholds, function(thresh) {
      sum(values_2 >= thresh, na.rm = TRUE)
    }),
    Group = label_2
  )
  
  bind_rows(d1, d2) %>%
    mutate(
      Cumulative.Count = replace(Cumulative.Count, Amplitude == 0, 0),
      log10.Cumulative.Count = suppressWarnings(log10(Cumulative.Count))
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(log10.Cumulative.Count), log10.Cumulative.Count > 0)
}
```

```{r}
# rebuild matrix for MAGIC input
rm(list = ls()); gc()

#install.packages("external/Rmagic-master", repos = NULL, type = "source")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(Matrix)
  library(readr)
  library(Rmagic)
})

load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_object_celltype_use.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_infer_scRhythm_phase.Rdata")

DefaultAssay(obj_use) <- "RNA"

expr_data <- GetAssayData(
  obj_use,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "data"
)

dim(expr_data)

theta_pred_vec <- as.numeric(res_phase_liver$theta_pred)
names(theta_pred_vec) <- colnames(obj_use)

cell_meta <- obj_use@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    theta_pred = theta_pred_vec[cell]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    celltype %in% c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"),
    is.finite(theta_pred)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(celltype, theta_pred)

head(cell_meta)
table(cell_meta$celltype)


cell_order <- cell_meta$cell

stopifnot(all(cell_order %in% colnames(expr_data)))

expr_data_ordered <- expr_data[, cell_order, drop = FALSE]

dim(expr_data_ordered)
magic_input <- t(as.matrix(expr_data_ordered))
dim(magic_input)
"Tnfrsf23" %in% colnames(magic_input)
# run MAGIC
data_MAGIC <- magic(magic_input, genes=c("Crp"))
library(viridis)

gene_use <- "Crp"

plot_df_magic <- cell_meta %>%
  mutate(
    expr_magic = as.numeric(data_MAGIC$result[, gene_use])
  )

library(ggplot2)

celltype_pal <- c(
  "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",
  "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"
)

p_magic <- ggplot(plot_df_magic) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = theta_pred, y = expr_magic, color = celltype),
    size = 0.9,
    alpha = 0.35
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = celltype_pal) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 2*pi),
    breaks = c(0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2, 2*pi),
    labels = c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2", "2π")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(gene_use, " (MAGIC)"),
    x = expression("Predicted phase " * phi),
    y = "MAGIC expression",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

p_magic

plot_df_bin <- plot_df_magic %>%
  mutate(
    theta_bin = cut(
      theta_pred,
      breaks = seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 25),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      labels = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(celltype, theta_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    theta_mid = mean(theta_pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    expr_mean = mean(expr_magic, na.rm = TRUE),
    expr_se = sd(expr_magic, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(theta_mid), is.finite(expr_mean))

# 7. colors
celltype_pal <- c(
  "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",
  "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"
)

# 8. plot dual curve
p_magic_dual <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = plot_df_magic,
    aes(x = theta_pred, y = expr_magic, color = celltype),
    size = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = plot_df_bin,
    aes(
      x = theta_mid,
      ymin = expr_mean - expr_se,
      ymax = expr_mean + expr_se,
      fill = celltype
    ),
    alpha = 0.18,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = plot_df_bin,
    aes(x = theta_mid, y = expr_mean, color = celltype),
    linewidth = 1.3
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = celltype_pal, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_pal, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 2*pi),
    breaks = c(0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2, 2*pi),
    labels = c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2", "2π"),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(gene_use, " (MAGIC)"),
    x = expression("Predicted phase " * phi),
    y = "MAGIC expression"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

p_magic_dual

out_dir <- "outputs/liver/MAGIC_RESULT_phase2"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, paste0(gene_use, "_MAGIC_dual_curve.pdf")),
  p_magic_dual,
  width = 4.5,
  height = 4.8
)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, paste0(gene_use, "_MAGIC_dual_curve.png")),
  p_magic_dual,
  width = 4.5,
  height = 4.8,
  dpi = 300
)
saveRDS(
  expr_data_ordered,
  file = file.path(out_dir, "obj_use_RNA_data_HepCV_HepPV_ordered_by_theta.rds")
)

write_tsv(
  cell_meta,
  file.path(out_dir, "obj_use_cell_order_HepCV_HepPV_by_theta.tsv")
)
```

#gene cosine
```{r}
# gene
rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(Matrix)
  library(readr)
  library(Rmagic)
  library(ggplot2)
})

load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_object_celltype_use.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_infer_scRhythm_phase.Rdata")

DefaultAssay(obj_use) <- "RNA"

expr_data <- GetAssayData(
  obj_use,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "data"
)

theta_pred_vec <- as.numeric(res_phase_liver$theta_pred)
names(theta_pred_vec) <- colnames(obj_use)

cell_meta <- obj_use@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    theta_pred = theta_pred_vec[cell]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    celltype %in% c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"),
    is.finite(theta_pred)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
  )

gene_use <- "Crp"


# 1. split by celltype and run MAGIC separately

cell_meta_cv <- cell_meta %>%
  filter(celltype == "Hep.CV") %>%
  arrange(theta_pred)

cell_meta_pv <- cell_meta %>%
  filter(celltype == "Hep.PV") %>%
  arrange(theta_pred)

expr_cv <- expr_data[, cell_meta_cv$cell, drop = FALSE]
expr_pv <- expr_data[, cell_meta_pv$cell, drop = FALSE]

magic_input_cv <- t(as.matrix(expr_cv))
magic_input_pv <- t(as.matrix(expr_pv))

data_MAGIC_cv <- magic(magic_input_cv, genes = gene_use)
data_MAGIC_pv <- magic(magic_input_pv, genes = gene_use)


# 2. merge MAGIC results back

plot_df_magic_cv <- cell_meta_cv %>%
  mutate(
    expr_magic = as.numeric(data_MAGIC_cv$result[, gene_use])
  )

plot_df_magic_pv <- cell_meta_pv %>%
  mutate(
    expr_magic = as.numeric(data_MAGIC_pv$result[, gene_use])
  )

plot_df_magic <- bind_rows(plot_df_magic_cv, plot_df_magic_pv) %>%
  mutate(
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
  )


# 3. bin theta and draw dual curve

theta_grid <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 300)

cosinor_df <- plot_df_magic %>%
  group_by(celltype) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    df_ct <- .x %>%
      dplyr::select(theta_pred, expr_magic) %>%
      dplyr::filter(is.finite(theta_pred), is.finite(expr_magic))
    
    fit <- lm(
      expr_magic ~ cos(theta_pred) + sin(theta_pred),
      data = df_ct
    )
    
    new_df <- tibble(theta_pred = theta_grid)
    pred <- predict(fit, newdata = new_df, se.fit = TRUE)
    
    tibble(
      theta_pred = theta_grid,
      expr_fit = as.numeric(pred$fit),
      expr_lower = as.numeric(pred$fit - pred$se.fit),
      expr_upper = as.numeric(pred$fit + pred$se.fit)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

celltype_pal <- c(
  "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",
  "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"
)


# 4. plot only cosinor curves

p_magic_dual <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = cosinor_df,
    aes(
      x = theta_pred,
      ymin = expr_lower,
      ymax = expr_upper,
      fill = celltype
    ),
    alpha = 0.18,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = cosinor_df,
    aes(x = theta_pred, y = expr_fit, color = celltype),
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = celltype_pal, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_pal, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 2*pi),
    breaks = c(0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2, 2*pi),
    labels = c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2", "2π"),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(gene_use, " (MAGIC + cosinor)"),
    x = expression("Predicted phase " * phi),
    y = "MAGIC expression"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

p_magic_dual
out_dir <- "outputs/liver/MAGIC_RESULT_phase2"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, paste0(gene_use, "_MAGIC_dual_curve_by_celltype.pdf")),
  p_magic_dual,
  width = 4.5,
  height = 4.8
)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, paste0(gene_use, "_MAGIC_dual_curve_by_celltype.png")),
  p_magic_dual,
  width = 4.5,
  height = 4.8,
  dpi = 300
)
```

#gene cos
```{r}
# batch gene cosine using module_result parameters
# MAGIC within celltype + direct cosine equation from module_result

rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(Matrix)
  library(readr)
  library(Rmagic)
  library(ggplot2)
})


# 0. load data

load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_object_celltype_use.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_infer_scRhythm_phase.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/scCircadianliver_result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV.Rdata")

DefaultAssay(obj_use) <- "RNA"
module_result <- res2_module$module_result

expr_data <- GetAssayData(
  obj_use,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "data"
)

theta_pred_vec <- as.numeric(res_phase_liver$theta_pred)
names(theta_pred_vec) <- colnames(obj_use)

cell_meta <- obj_use@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    theta_pred = theta_pred_vec[cell]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    celltype %in% c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"),
    is.finite(theta_pred)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
  )


# 1. focus genes

focus_genes_final <- c(
  genes_small_modules,
  m1_focus_genes
) %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort()

# 2. split by celltype once

cell_meta_cv <- cell_meta %>%
  filter(celltype == "Hep.CV") %>%
  arrange(theta_pred)

cell_meta_pv <- cell_meta %>%
  filter(celltype == "Hep.PV") %>%
  arrange(theta_pred)

expr_cv <- expr_data[, cell_meta_cv$cell, drop = FALSE]
expr_pv <- expr_data[, cell_meta_pv$cell, drop = FALSE]

magic_input_cv <- t(as.matrix(expr_cv))
magic_input_pv <- t(as.matrix(expr_pv))


# 3. colors and output

celltype_pal <- c(
  "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",
  "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"
)

theta_grid <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 300)

out_dir <- "outputs/liver/MAGIC_RESULT_phase2/moduleResult_curve_batch"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


# 4. loop over genes

for (gene_use in focus_genes_final) {
  
  message("Running: ", gene_use)
  
  gene_in_cv <- gene_use %in% colnames(magic_input_cv)
  gene_in_pv <- gene_use %in% colnames(magic_input_pv)
  
  if (!(gene_in_cv && gene_in_pv)) {
    message("Skip gene not found in MAGIC input: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  

  # 4.1 run MAGIC separately

  data_MAGIC_cv <- tryCatch(
    magic(magic_input_cv, genes = gene_use),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  data_MAGIC_pv <- tryCatch(
    magic(magic_input_pv, genes = gene_use),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(data_MAGIC_cv) || is.null(data_MAGIC_pv)) {
    message("Skip gene due to MAGIC failure: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  

  # 4.2 merge MAGIC results back

  plot_df_magic_cv <- cell_meta_cv %>%
    mutate(
      expr_magic = as.numeric(data_MAGIC_cv$result[, gene_use])
    )
  
  plot_df_magic_pv <- cell_meta_pv %>%
    mutate(
      expr_magic = as.numeric(data_MAGIC_pv$result[, gene_use])
    )
  
  plot_df_magic <- bind_rows(plot_df_magic_cv, plot_df_magic_pv) %>%
    mutate(
      celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(expr_magic))
  
  if (nrow(plot_df_magic) == 0) {
    message("Skip gene due to empty MAGIC df: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  

  # 4.3 get module_result params

  gene_param <- module_result %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    filter(gene == gene_use) %>%
    transmute(
      gene = gene,
      module_id = as.character(module_map),
      q_Hep.CV = as.numeric(q_Hep.CV),
      q_Hep.PV = as.numeric(q_Hep.PV),
      A_Hep.CV = as.numeric(A_Hep.CV),
      A_Hep.PV = as.numeric(A_Hep.PV),
      phi_Hep.CV = as.numeric(phi_Hep.CV),
      phi_Hep.PV = as.numeric(phi_Hep.PV)
    )
  
  if (nrow(gene_param) != 1) {
    message("Skip gene due to missing or duplicated module_result row: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  

  # 4.4 MAGIC mesor

  mesor_df <- plot_df_magic %>%
    group_by(celltype) %>%
    summarise(
      mesor_magic = mean(expr_magic, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  

  # 4.5 direct cosine equation
  #     one side can be NA, that is okay

  cosinor_df <- bind_rows(
    tibble(
      celltype = "Hep.CV",
      theta_pred = theta_grid,
      mesor = mesor_df$mesor_magic[mesor_df$celltype == "Hep.CV"],
      amp = gene_param$A_Hep.CV,
      phase = gene_param$phi_Hep.CV,
      q = gene_param$q_Hep.CV
    ),
    tibble(
      celltype = "Hep.PV",
      theta_pred = theta_grid,
      mesor = mesor_df$mesor_magic[mesor_df$celltype == "Hep.PV"],
      amp = gene_param$A_Hep.PV,
      phase = gene_param$phi_Hep.PV,
      q = gene_param$q_Hep.PV
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      expr_fit = mesor + amp * cos(theta_pred - phase)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(expr_fit),
      is.finite(amp),
      is.finite(phase)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
    )
  
  if (nrow(cosinor_df) == 0) {
    message("Skip gene due to empty cosine df: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  

  # 4.6 plot

  p_magic_dual <- ggplot()+
    geom_line(
      data = cosinor_df,
      aes(x = theta_pred, y = expr_fit, color = celltype),
      linewidth = 1.6
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = celltype_pal, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 2*pi),
      breaks = c(0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2, 2*pi),
      labels = c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2", "2π"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.04))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = gene_use,
      x = expression("Predicted phase " * phi),
      y = "MAGIC expression"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 18, 10, 10)
    )
  
  print(p_magic_dual)
  

  # 4.7 save

  module_id_use <- gene_param$module_id[1]
  
  file_stub <- paste0(
    "M", module_id_use, "_",
    gene_use, "_MAGIC_moduleResult_curve"
  )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_stub, ".pdf")),
    p_magic_dual,
    width = 4.5,
    height = 4.8
  )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_stub, ".png")),
    p_magic_dual,
    width = 4.5,
    height = 4.8,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```

```{r}
    ),
    tibble(
      celltype = "Hep.PV",
      theta_pred = theta_grid,
      mesor = mesor_df$mesor_magic[mesor_df$celltype == "Hep.PV"],
      amp = gene_param$A_Hep.PV,
      phase = gene_param$phi_Hep.PV,
      q = gene_param$q_Hep.PV
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      expr_fit = mesor + amp * cos(theta_pred - phase)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(expr_fit),
      is.finite(amp),
      is.finite(phase)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
    )
  
  if (nrow(cosinor_df) == 0) {
    message("Skip gene due to empty cosine df: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  

  # 4.6 plot

  p_magic_dual <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = plot_df_magic,
      aes(x = theta_pred, y = expr_magic, color = celltype),
      alpha = 0.10,
      size = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = cosinor_df,
      aes(x = theta_pred, y = expr_fit, color = celltype),
      linewidth = 1.6
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = celltype_pal, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 2*pi),
      breaks = c(0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2, 2*pi),
      labels = c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2", "2π"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.04))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = gene_use,
      x = expression("Predicted phase " * phi),
      y = "MAGIC expression"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 18, 10, 10)
    )
  
  print(p_magic_dual)
  

  # 4.7 save

  module_id_use <- gene_param$module_id[1]
  
  file_stub <- paste0(
    "M", module_id_use, "_",
    gene_use, "_MAGIC_moduleResult_curve"
  )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_stub, ".pdf")),
    p_magic_dual,
    width = 4.5,
    height = 4.8
  )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_stub, ".png")),
    p_magic_dual,
    width = 4.5,
    height = 4.8,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```

```{r}
DefaultAssay(obj_use) <- "RNA"
module_result <- res2_module$module_result


# 1. basic info
expr_mat <- GetAssayData(obj_use, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")

cell_meta <- obj_use@meta.data %>%

    theta_wrap = ((theta_pred %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    celltype %in% c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"),
    is.finite(theta_wrap)
  )

module_label_map <- c(

  "M2 Rhythm Gain"    = "#EDC0A0",
  "M6 Phase Advanced" = "#FAEFD9",
  "M7 Phase Delayed"  = "#4973A8"
)

modules_use <- c("1", "2", "6", "7")


# 2. genes from the 4 modules

gene_meta <- module_result %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(
    gene = gene,
    module_id = as.character(module_map),
    module_label = recode(as.character(module_map), !!!module_label_map),
    phase_ref = as.numeric(phi_Hep.CV)
  ) %>%
  filter(module_id %in% modules_use)

genes_use <- intersect(gene_meta$gene, rownames(expr_mat))

gene_meta2 <- gene_meta %>%
  filter(gene %in% genes_use) %>%

    phase_wrap = ((phase_ref %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi)
  ) %>%
  arrange(module_id, phase_wrap)

gene_order <- gene_meta2$gene


# 3. helper functions

row_zscore <- function(mat) {
  z <- t(apply(mat, 1, function(x) {
    sx <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    out <- (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sx
    out[!is.finite(out)] <- 0
    out
  }))
  z <- as.matrix(z)
  rownames(z) <- rownames(mat)
  colnames(z) <- colnames(mat)
  z
}

smooth_one_group <- function(celltype_use, k = 8, n_grid = 60, min_cells = 20) {
  
  meta_sub <- cell_meta %>%
    filter(celltype == celltype_use) %>%
    arrange(theta_wrap)
  
  expr_sub <- expr_mat[gene_order, meta_sub$cell, drop = FALSE]
  expr_sub <- as.matrix(expr_sub)
  
  theta_grid <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_grid + 1)[-1]
  
  pred_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(expr_sub)), function(i) {
    
    dat <- tibble(
      expr = as.numeric(expr_sub[i, ]),
      theta = meta_sub$theta_wrap
    ) %>%
      filter(is.finite(expr), is.finite(theta))
    
    n_ok <- nrow(dat)
    n_theta_unique <- length(unique(dat$theta))
    expr_sd <- sd(dat$expr)
    
    keep_fit <- n_ok >= min_cells &
      n_theta_unique >= 6 &
      is.finite(expr_sd) &
      expr_sd > 0
    
    if (!keep_fit) {
      return(rep(NA_real_, length(theta_grid)))
    }
    
    k_use <- min(k, max(4, floor(n_theta_unique / 2)))
    
    fit <- tryCatch(
      mgcv::gam(
        expr ~ s(theta, bs = "cc", k = k_use),
        data = dat,
        method = "REML",
        knots = list(theta = c(0, 2 * pi))
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    
    if (is.null(fit)) {
      return(rep(NA_real_, length(theta_grid)))
    }
    
    pred <- tryCatch(
      predict(fit, newdata = tibble(theta = theta_grid)),
      error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(theta_grid))
    )
    
    pred
  })
  
  mat_smooth <- do.call(rbind, pred_list) %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  rownames(mat_smooth) <- gene_order
  colnames(mat_smooth) <- paste0("bin_", seq_len(ncol(mat_smooth)))
  
  keep_gene <- rowSums(is.finite(mat_smooth)) == ncol(mat_smooth)
  mat_smooth <- mat_smooth[keep_gene, , drop = FALSE]
  
  list(
    mat_raw = mat_smooth,
    mat_z = row_zscore(mat_smooth),
    theta_grid = theta_grid,
    keep_genes = rownames(mat_smooth)
  )
}

# 4. smooth CV and PV separately
res_cv <- smooth_one_group("Hep.CV", k = 8, n_grid = 60)
res_pv <- smooth_one_group("Hep.PV", k = 8, n_grid = 60)

col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(

top_ha_cv <- HeatmapAnnotation(

)

top_ha_pv <- HeatmapAnnotation(

  ),

)

# pretty x-axis labels
col_at <- c(1, 15, 30, 45, 60)
col_lab <- c("0", "6", "12", "18", "24")


# 5. CV heatmap

ht_cv <- Heatmap(
  mat_cv,
  name = "z-score",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_side = "right",
```

```{r}
focus_genes_final <- module_result %>%

    phase_ref = case_when(
      as.character(module_map) == "2" ~ as.numeric(phi_Hep.PV),
      as.character(module_map) == "3" ~ as.numeric(phi_Hep.CV),
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(phi_Hep.CV)
    )
  ) %>%

  gene %in% focus_genes_final,

) %>%

  ) %>%

gene_order <- gene_meta2$gene

row_zscore <- function(mat) {
  z <- t(apply(mat, 1, function(x) {
    sdx <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    out <- (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sdx
    out[!is.finite(out)] <- 0
    out
  }))
  z <- as.matrix(z)
  rownames(z) <- rownames(mat)
  colnames(z) <- colnames(mat)
  z[!is.finite(z)] <- 0
  z
}

make_phase_cat_from_theta <- function(theta_grid) {
  zt_grid <- (theta_grid / (2 * pi) * 24) %% 24
  phase_cat <- floor((zt_grid - 2) / 4) * 4 + 2
  phase_cat <- phase_cat %% 24
  factor(phase_cat, levels = c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22))
}

cyclic_smooth_matrix <- function(expr_sub, theta_sub, k = 8, n_grid = 60) {
  expr_sub <- as.matrix(expr_sub)
  theta_use <- wrap_phase(theta_sub)
  theta_grid <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_grid + 1)[-1]
  
  pred_list <- furrr::future_map(
    seq_len(nrow(expr_sub)),
    function(i) {
      dat <- data.frame(
        expr = as.numeric(expr_sub[i, ]),
        theta = theta_use
      )
      
      fit <- try(
        mgcv::gam(
          expr ~ s(theta, bs = "cc", k = k),
          data = dat,
          method = "REML",
          knots = list(theta = c(0, 2 * pi))
        ),
        silent = TRUE
      )
      
      pred <- rep(NA_real_, length(theta_grid))
      pred[seq_along(pred)] <- tryCatch(
        predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(theta = theta_grid)),
        error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(theta_grid))
      )
      pred
    },
    .options = furrr::furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
  )
  
  smoothed_mat <- do.call(rbind, pred_list)
  smoothed_mat <- as.matrix(smoothed_mat)
  
  rownames(smoothed_mat) <- rownames(expr_sub)
  colnames(smoothed_mat) <- paste0("Theta_", seq_len(ncol(smoothed_mat)))
  
  keep <- complete.cases(smoothed_mat)
  smoothed_mat <- smoothed_mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  
  list(
    mat_raw = smoothed_mat,
    mat_z = row_zscore(smoothed_mat),
    theta_grid = theta_grid,
    keep_genes = rownames(smoothed_mat)
  )
}


build_top_annotation <- function(theta_grid, group_name) {
  phase_cat <- make_phase_cat_from_theta(theta_grid)
  group_cat <- factor(rep(group_name, length(theta_grid)), levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
  
  anno_df <- data.frame(
    phase = phase_cat,
    group = group_cat,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  
  colnames(anno_df) <- c("Cell phase", "Group")
  
  HeatmapAnnotation(
    df = anno_df,
    col = list(
      `Cell phase` = c(
        "2"  = "#000000",
        "6"  = "#000000",
        "10" = "#F5F5F5",
        "14" = "#F5F5F5",
        "18" = "#F5F5F5",
        "22" = "#000000"
      ),
      Group = c(
        "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",
        "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"
      )
    ),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE,
    show_legend = TRUE,
    annotation_legend_param = list(
      `Cell phase` = list(
        title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 18, fontface = "bold"),
        labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 16),
        grid_width = unit(0.5, "cm"),
        grid_height = unit(0.5, "cm")
      ),
      Group = list(
        title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 18, fontface = "bold"),
        labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 16),
        grid_width = unit(0.5, "cm"),
        grid_height = unit(0.5, "cm")
      )
    ),
    simple_anno_size = unit(2, "cm"),
    annotation_height = unit(c(1.3, 1.3), "cm"),
    gap = unit(0, "mm"),
    border = FALSE,
    gp = gpar(col = NA, lwd = 0)
  )
}

add_phase_separators <- function(theta_grid, anno_name = "Cell phase", lwd = 1.4) {
  phase_num <- as.character(make_phase_cat_from_theta(theta_grid))
  boundary_idx <- which(phase_num[-1] != phase_num[-length(phase_num)])
  x_pos <- boundary_idx / pmax(length(phase_num), 1)
  
  decorate_annotation(anno_name, {
    for (xline in x_pos) {
      grid::grid.lines(
        x = unit(c(xline, xline), "npc"),
        y = unit(c(0, 1), "npc"),
        gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = lwd)
      )
    }
  })
}
```

```{r}
make_phase_long_self <- function(method_df, target_id) {
  method_df %>%
    filter(module_id == target_id) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(phase_Hep.CV, phase_Hep.PV),
      names_to = "Group",
      values_to = "Phase_hour"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Group = stringr::str_remove(Group, "^phase_"),
      Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV")),
      Phase_hour = as.numeric(Phase_hour),
      Module = module_label_map[as.character(target_id)],
      Module = factor(
        Module,
        levels = c(
          "M1 Stable Rhythm",
          "M2 Rhythm Gain",
          "M6 Phase Advanced",
          "M7 Phase Delayed"
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(Phase_hour))
}

draw_phase_density <- function(plot_df) {
  
  module_now <- unique(as.character(plot_df$Module))
  
  ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = Phase_hour, color = Group, fill = Group)
  ) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.18, linewidth = 2, adjust = 1.1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colors, name = "Group") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors, name = "Group") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 24),
      breaks = c(0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Drug genes phase density",
      subtitle = module_now,
      x = "Phase (hour)",
      y = "Density",
      color = "Group",
      fill = "Group"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 28),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 22),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 15),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 15)
    )
}

for (m in c(1, 2, 6, 7)) {

    p_sc, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300
  )
}
```
