```{r}
# 3. helper

row_zscore <- function(mat) {
  z <- t(apply(mat, 1, function(x) {
    sdx <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    out <- (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sdx
    out[!is.finite(out)] <- 0
    out
  }))
  z <- as.matrix(z)
  rownames(z) <- rownames(mat)
  colnames(z) <- colnames(mat)
  z[!is.finite(z)] <- 0
  z
}

make_phase_cat_from_theta <- function(theta_grid) {
  zt_grid <- (theta_grid / (2 * pi) * 24) %% 24
  phase_cat <- floor((zt_grid - 2) / 4) * 4 + 2
  phase_cat <- phase_cat %% 24
  factor(phase_cat, levels = c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22))
}

# 完全沿用你之前热图里的 smooth 逻辑
cyclic_smooth_matrix <- function(expr_sub, theta_sub, k = 8, n_grid = 60) {
  expr_sub <- as.matrix(expr_sub)
  theta_use <- wrap_phase(theta_sub)
  theta_grid <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_grid + 1)[-1]
  
  pred_list <- furrr::future_map(
    seq_len(nrow(expr_sub)),
    function(i) {
      dat <- data.frame(
        expr = as.numeric(expr_sub[i, ]),
        theta = theta_use
      )
      
      fit <- try(
        mgcv::gam(
          expr ~ s(theta, bs = "cc", k = k),
          data = dat,
          method = "REML",
          knots = list(theta = c(0, 2 * pi))
        ),
        silent = TRUE
      )
      
      pred <- rep(NA_real_, length(theta_grid))
      pred[seq_along(pred)] <- tryCatch(
        predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(theta = theta_grid)),
        error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(theta_grid))
      )
      pred
    },
    .options = furrr::furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
  )
  
  smoothed_mat <- do.call(rbind, pred_list)
  smoothed_mat <- as.matrix(smoothed_mat)
  
  rownames(smoothed_mat) <- rownames(expr_sub)
  colnames(smoothed_mat) <- paste0("Theta_", seq_len(ncol(smoothed_mat)))
  
  keep <- complete.cases(smoothed_mat)
  smoothed_mat <- smoothed_mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  
  list(
    mat_raw = smoothed_mat,
    mat_z = row_zscore(smoothed_mat),
    theta_grid = theta_grid,
    keep_genes = rownames(smoothed_mat)
  )
}

build_top_annotation <- function(theta_grid, group_name) {
  phase_cat <- make_phase_cat_from_theta(theta_grid)
  group_cat <- factor(rep(group_name, length(theta_grid)), levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
  
  anno_df <- data.frame(
    phase = phase_cat,
    group = group_cat,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  
  colnames(anno_df) <- c("Cell phase", "Group")
  
  HeatmapAnnotation(
    df = anno_df,
    col = list(
      `Cell phase` = c(
        "2"  = "#000000",
        "6"  = "#000000",
        "10" = "#F5F5F5",
        "14" = "#F5F5F5",
        "18" = "#F5F5F5",
        "22" = "#000000"
      ),
      Group = c(
        "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",
        "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"
      )
    ),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE,
    show_legend = TRUE,
    annotation_legend_param = list(
      `Cell phase` = list(
        title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold"),
        labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 11),
        grid_width = unit(0.5, "cm"),
        grid_height = unit(0.5, "cm")
      ),
      Group = list(
        title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold"),
        labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 11),
        grid_width = unit(0.5, "cm"),
        grid_height = unit(0.5, "cm")
      )
    ),
    simple_anno_size = unit(0.6, "cm"),
    gap = unit(0, "mm"),
    border = FALSE,
    gp = gpar(col = NA, lwd = 0)
  )
}

add_phase_separators <- function(theta_grid, anno_name = "Cell phase", lwd = 1.4) {
  phase_num <- as.character(make_phase_cat_from_theta(theta_grid))
  boundary_idx <- which(phase_num[-1] != phase_num[-length(phase_num)])
  x_pos <- boundary_idx / pmax(length(phase_num), 1)
  
  decorate_annotation(anno_name, {
    for (xline in x_pos) {
      grid::grid.lines(
        x = unit(c(xline, xline), "npc"),
        y = unit(c(0, 1), "npc"),
        gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = lwd)
      )
    }
  })
}

col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  seq(-2, 2, length.out = 25),
  colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Blues"))(25)
)


# 4. smooth Hep.CV

meta_cv <- cell_meta %>%
  mutate(theta_pred_use = wrap_phase(theta_pred)) %>%
  filter(celltype == "Hep.CV") %>%
  arrange(theta_pred_use)

obj_cv <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = expr_mat[gene_order, meta_cv$cell, drop = FALSE]
)

obj_cv <- NormalizeData(
  object = obj_cv,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = 10000,
  verbose = FALSE
)

obj_cv <- ScaleData(
  object = obj_cv,
  features = gene_order,
  verbose = FALSE
)

mat_cv0 <- GetAssayData(obj_cv, assay = "RNA", layer = "scale.data")
mat_cv0 <- mat_cv0[gene_order, meta_cv$cell, drop = FALSE]

res_cv <- cyclic_smooth_matrix(
  expr_sub = mat_cv0,
  theta_sub = meta_cv$theta_pred_use,
  k = 8,
  n_grid = 60
)


# 5. smooth Hep.PV

meta_pv <- cell_meta %>%
  mutate(theta_pred_use = wrap_phase(theta_pred)) %>%
  filter(celltype == "Hep.PV") %>%
  arrange(theta_pred_use)

obj_pv <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = expr_mat[gene_order, meta_pv$cell, drop = FALSE]
)

obj_pv <- NormalizeData(
  object = obj_pv,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = 10000,
  verbose = FALSE
)

obj_pv <- ScaleData(
  object = obj_pv,
  features = gene_order,
  verbose = FALSE
)

mat_pv0 <- GetAssayData(obj_pv, assay = "RNA", layer = "scale.data")
mat_pv0 <- mat_pv0[gene_order, meta_pv$cell, drop = FALSE]

res_pv <- cyclic_smooth_matrix(
  expr_sub = mat_pv0,
  theta_sub = meta_pv$theta_pred_use,
  k = 8,
  n_grid = 60
)


# 6. keep genes common to both celltypes

common_genes <- intersect(res_cv$keep_genes, res_pv$keep_genes)

gene_meta3 <- gene_meta2 %>%
  filter(gene %in% common_genes)

gene_order2 <- gene_meta3$gene

mat_cv <- res_cv$mat_z[gene_order2, , drop = FALSE]
mat_pv <- res_pv$mat_z[gene_order2, , drop = FALSE]

# 分块标题只显示 M1/M2/M6/M7
row_split_factor <- factor(
  gene_meta3$module_id,
  levels = c("1", "2", "6", "7"),
  labels = c("M1", "M2", "M6", "M7")
)

# 左侧颜色条仍然用长标签映射颜色，但不显示文字
row_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  Module = factor(
    gene_meta3$module_label,
    levels = c("M1 Stable Rhythm", "M2 Rhythm Gain", "M6 Phase Advanced", "M7 Phase Delayed")
  ),
  col = list(Module = module_pal),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  simple_anno_size = unit(7, "mm"),
  gp = gpar(col = NA)
)

top_ha_cv <- build_top_annotation(res_cv$theta_grid, "Hep.CV")
top_ha_pv <- build_top_annotation(res_pv$theta_grid, "Hep.PV")


# 7. two heatmaps

ht_cv <- Heatmap(
  mat_cv,
  name = "z-score",
  col = col_fun,
  top_annotation = top_ha_cv,
  left_annotation = row_ha,
  row_split = row_split_factor,
  row_gap = unit(5, "mm"),
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_side = "right",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 15,fontface = "bold"),
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  use_raster = TRUE,
  raster_quality = 4,
  border = FALSE,
  rect_gp = gpar(col = NA, lwd = 0),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "z-score",
    title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 22, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 20)
  ),
  column_title = "Hep.CV",
  column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 30, fontface = "bold"),
  row_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 20, fontface = "bold")
)

ht_pv <- Heatmap(
  mat_pv,
  name = "z-score",
  col = col_fun,
  top_annotation = top_ha_pv,
  left_annotation = row_ha,
  row_split = row_split_factor,
  row_gap = unit(5, "mm"),
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_side = "right",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 15,fontface = "bold"),
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  use_raster = TRUE,
  raster_quality = 4,
  border = FALSE,
  rect_gp = gpar(col = NA, lwd = 0),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "z-score",
    title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 22, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 20)
  ),
  column_title = "Hep.PV",
  column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 30, fontface = "bold"),
  row_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 20, fontface = "bold")
)

ht_cv
ht_pv


# 8. draw and save

out_dir <- "outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/module1267_focus_heatmap"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

pdf(file.path(out_dir, "module1267_focus_HepCV_heatmap.pdf"), width = 8, height = 11)
draw(ht_cv, merge_legends = TRUE)
add_phase_separators(res_cv$theta_grid, anno_name = "Cell phase", lwd = 1.4)
dev.off()

png(file.path(out_dir, "module1267_focus_HepCV_heatmap.png"), width = 1800, height = 2400, res = 220)
draw(ht_cv, merge_legends = TRUE)

pdf(file.path(out_dir, "module1267_focus_HepPV_heatmap.pdf"), width = 8, height = 11)
```

#sankey
```{r}
# module -> gene sigmoid plot using CCPlotR::cc_sigmoid
#devtools::install_github("Sarah145/CCPlotR")
#BiocManager::install("CCPlotR")
#install.packages("external/CCPlotR-main", repos = NULL, type = "source")


rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(CCPlotR)
  library(ggplot2)
})


# 0. load data

load("outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/scCircadianliver_result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV.Rdata")
module_result <- res2_module$module_result

# 这里沿用你已经筛好的基因
focus_genes_final <- c(
  genes_small_modules,
  m1_focus_genes
) %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort()


# 1. module label map

module_label_map <- c(
  "1" = "M1",
  "2" = "M2",
  "6" = "M6",
  "7" = "M7"
)

module_col_map <- c(
  "Modules" = "#8F8F8F",
  "Genes"   = "#8F8F8F"
)


# 2. build module-gene table from updated module_result
#    注意：这里只保留 1/2/6/7 和 focus genes

sigmoid_df0 <- module_result %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(
    gene = gene,
    module_id = as.character(module_map),
    module_short = recode(as.character(module_map), !!!module_label_map),
    q_Hep.CV = as.numeric(q_Hep.CV),
    q_Hep.PV = as.numeric(q_Hep.PV),
    A_Hep.CV = as.numeric(A_Hep.CV),
    A_Hep.PV = as.numeric(A_Hep.PV),
    phi_Hep.CV = as.numeric(phi_Hep.CV),
    phi_Hep.PV = as.numeric(phi_Hep.PV)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    gene %in% focus_genes_final,
    module_id %in% c("1", "2", "6", "7")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_phase = atan2(
      sin(phi_Hep.CV - phi_Hep.PV),
      cos(phi_Hep.CV - phi_Hep.PV)
    ),
    abs_delta_phase = abs(delta_phase),
    mean_amp = (A_Hep.CV + A_Hep.PV) / 2,
    max_amp = pmax(A_Hep.CV, A_Hep.PV, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_logfdr = -log10(q_Hep.CV + 1e-300) + -log10(q_Hep.PV + 1e-300)
  )


# 3. define score for plotting
#    这里只是为了排序/展示，不是统计检验

sigmoid_df1 <- sigmoid_df0 %>%
  group_by(module_id) %>%
  mutate(
    z_mean_amp = as.numeric(scale(mean_amp)),
    z_max_amp = as.numeric(scale(max_amp)),
    z_abs_delta_phase = as.numeric(scale(abs_delta_phase)),
    z_sum_logfdr = as.numeric(scale(sum_logfdr))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    plot_score = case_when(
      module_id == "1" ~ 1.2 * z_mean_amp + 1.0 * z_sum_logfdr,
      module_id == "2" ~ 1.0 * z_max_amp + 1.0 * z_sum_logfdr,
      module_id == "6" ~ 0.8 * z_mean_amp + 1.0 * z_abs_delta_phase + 0.8 * z_sum_logfdr,
      module_id == "7" ~ 0.8 * z_mean_amp + 1.0 * z_abs_delta_phase + 0.8 * z_sum_logfdr,
      TRUE ~ z_max_amp
    )
  )


# 4. build CCPlotR input
#    左侧 = module, 右侧 = gene

cc_df <- sigmoid_df1 %>%
  transmute(
    source = "Modules",
    target = "Genes",
    ligand = factor(module_short, levels = c("M1", "M2", "M6", "M7")),
    receptor = gene,
    score = plot_score
  ) %>%
  arrange(ligand, desc(score))

cc_df


# 5. plot

p_sigmoid <- cc_sigmoid(
  cc_df = cc_df,
  n_top_ints = nrow(cc_df),
  colours = module_col_map
) +
  labs(
    title = "Module-to-gene sigmoid plot"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16)
  )

p_sigmoid


# 6. save

out_dir <- "outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/module_gene_sigmoid"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "module_gene_sigmoid.pdf"),
  p_sigmoid,
  width = 7.5,
  height = 10
)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "module_gene_sigmoid.png"),
  p_sigmoid,
  width = 7.5,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)

write_tsv(
  cc_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "module_gene_sigmoid_input.tsv")
)
```

#sankey
```{r}
# module -> gene sankey / alluvial
rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggalluvial)
  library(scales)
})


# 0. load data

load("outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/scCircadianliver_result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV.Rdata")
module_result <- res2_module$module_result

focus_genes_final <- c(
  genes_small_modules,
  m1_focus_genes
) %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort()


# 1. module map

module_label_map <- c(
  "1" = "M1",
  "2" = "M2",
  "6" = "M6",
  "7" = "M7"
)

module_pal <- c(
  "M1" = "#BFDFD2",
  "M2" = "#ECB66C",
  "M6" = "#EA9E58",
  "M7" = "#4198AC"
)


# 2. build module-gene table

plot_df0 <- module_result %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(
    gene = gene,
    module_id = as.character(module_map),
    module = recode(as.character(module_map), !!!module_label_map),
    q_Hep.CV = as.numeric(q_Hep.CV),
    q_Hep.PV = as.numeric(q_Hep.PV),
    A_Hep.CV = as.numeric(A_Hep.CV),
    A_Hep.PV = as.numeric(A_Hep.PV),
    phi_Hep.CV = as.numeric(phi_Hep.CV),
    phi_Hep.PV = as.numeric(phi_Hep.PV)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    gene %in% focus_genes_final,
    module_id %in% c("1", "2", "6", "7")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_phase = atan2(
      sin(phi_Hep.CV - phi_Hep.PV),
      cos(phi_Hep.CV - phi_Hep.PV)
    ),
    abs_delta_phase = abs(delta_phase),
    mean_amp = (A_Hep.CV + A_Hep.PV) / 2,
    max_amp = pmax(A_Hep.CV, A_Hep.PV, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_logfdr = -log10(q_Hep.CV + 1e-300) + -log10(q_Hep.PV + 1e-300)
  )


# 3. define plotting score

plot_df1 <- plot_df0 %>%
  group_by(module_id) %>%
  mutate(
    z_mean_amp = as.numeric(scale(mean_amp)),
    z_max_amp = as.numeric(scale(max_amp)),
    z_abs_delta_phase = as.numeric(scale(abs_delta_phase)),
    z_sum_logfdr = as.numeric(scale(sum_logfdr))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    plot_score = case_when(
      module_id == "1" ~ 1.2 * z_mean_amp + 1.0 * z_sum_logfdr,
      module_id == "2" ~ 1.0 * z_max_amp + 1.0 * z_sum_logfdr,
      module_id == "6" ~ 0.8 * z_mean_amp + 1.0 * z_abs_delta_phase + 0.8 * z_sum_logfdr,
      module_id == "7" ~ 0.8 * z_mean_amp + 1.0 * z_abs_delta_phase + 0.8 * z_sum_logfdr,
      TRUE ~ z_max_amp
    ),
    weight = rescale(plot_score, to = c(0.4, 2.2))
  )


# 4. order genes inside plot
#    每个 module 内按 score 排序，整体再拼起来

gene_order <- plot_df1 %>%
  arrange(module, desc(plot_score)) %>%
  pull(gene)

plot_df2 <- plot_df1 %>%
  mutate(
    module = factor(module, levels = c("M1", "M2", "M6", "M7")),
    gene = factor(gene, levels = rev(unique(gene_order)))
  )


# 5. sankey / alluvial plot

p_sankey <- ggplot(
  plot_df2,
  aes(axis1 = module, axis2 = gene, y = weight)
) +
  ggalluvial::geom_alluvium(
    aes(fill = module),
    width = 0.22,
    alpha = 0.75,
    knot.pos = 0.35
  ) +
  ggalluvial::geom_stratum(
    width = 0.22,
    fill = "grey75",
    color = NA
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(label = after_stat(stratum)),
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("Module", "Gene"),
    expand = c(0.12, 0.12)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = module_pal) +
  labs(
    title = "Module-to-gene sankey plot",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
p_sankey


# 6. save

out_dir <- "outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/module_gene_sankey"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "module_gene_sankey.pdf"),
  p_sankey,
  width = 9,
  height = 12,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "module_gene_sankey.png"),
  p_sankey,
  width = 9,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

write_tsv(
  plot_df2 %>%
    mutate(gene = as.character(gene), module = as.character(module)),
  file.path(out_dir, "module_gene_sankey_input.tsv")
)
```

```{r}
module_result <- res2_module$module_result

# 1. define story genes
gpcr_core_genes <- c("Chrm3", "S1pr2", "Prkca", "Mapk3", "Adcy9", "Pde2a", "Trio")

#drug_core_genes <- c("Por", "Cyp2e1", "Cyp2j13", "Gstm5", "Slco1b2", "Akr1d1", "Abcg5", "Pck1")
drug_core_genes <- c(
  "Abcg5", "Acly", "Akr1d1", "Ap1ar", "Arntl", "Ass1", "Bhlhe41",
  "Bmyc", "Cd36", "Cdkn1a", "Cdo1", "Clock", "Crp", "Csad",
  "Cyp2e1", "Cyp2j13", "Dmgdh", "Egr1", "Elovl3", "Fads2", "Gamt",
  "Gls2", "Gnmt", "Got1", "Gstm5", "Hjurp", "Hmgcs2", "Ivd",
  "Lgr5", "Map3k7", "Nr0b2", "Nr1d1", "Pck1", "Pcna", "Pdha1",
  "Per2", "Por", "Rdh19", "Rdh5", "Sds", "Slco1b2", "Snai1",
  "Sox4", "Tnfrsf23", "Traf2"
)
module_label_short <- c(
  "1" = "M1",
  "2" = "M2",
  "6" = "M6",
  "7" = "M7"
)

# 2. extract module assignment
module_df <- module_result %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(
    gene = gene,
    module_id = as.character(module_map),
    module = recode(as.character(module_map), !!!module_label_short)
  ) %>%
  filter(module_id %in% c("1", "2", "6", "7"))

# 3. left side: GPCR -> module
left_df <- module_df %>%
  filter(gene %in% gpcr_core_genes) %>%
  transmute(
    left_node = gene,
    mid_node = module,
    weight = 1
  )

# 4. right side: module -> drug
right_df <- module_df %>%
  filter(gene %in% drug_core_genes) %>%
  transmute(
    mid_node = module,
    right_node = gene,
    weight = 1
  )

# 5. build sankey long table
edge_left <- left_df %>%
  mutate(edge_id = row_number()) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(left_node, mid_node),
    names_to = "stage_type",
    values_to = "node"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stage = case_when(
      stage_type == "left_node" ~ "GPCR downstream signalling",
      stage_type == "mid_node"  ~ "Rhythmic module"
    ),
    connector = case_when(
      stage_type == "left_node" ~ "from",
      stage_type == "mid_node"  ~ "to"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(weight, edge_id, connector, node, stage)

edge_right <- right_df %>%
  mutate(edge_id = row_number() + max(edge_left$edge_id)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mid_node, right_node),
    names_to = "stage_type",
    values_to = "node"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stage = case_when(
      stage_type == "mid_node"   ~ "Rhythmic module",
      stage_type == "right_node" ~ "Drug metabolism"
    ),
    connector = case_when(
      stage_type == "mid_node"   ~ "from",
      stage_type == "right_node" ~ "to"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(weight, edge_id, connector, node, stage)

sankey_df <- bind_rows(edge_left, edge_right) %>%
  mutate(
    stage = factor(
      stage,
      levels = c("GPCR downstream signalling", "Rhythmic module", "Drug metabolism")
    )
  )
node_col_map <- c(
  setNames(rep("#7BC0CD", length(gpcr_core_genes)), gpcr_core_genes),
  c("M1" = "#BFDFD2", "M2" = "#ECB66C", "M6" = "#EA9E58", "M7" = "#4198AC"),
  setNames(rep("#ED8D5A", length(drug_core_genes)), drug_core_genes)
)
# 7. positions
pos <- position_sankey(order = "ascending", v_space = 0.12)
pos_text <- position_sankey(order = "ascending", v_space = 0.12, nudge_x = 0.04)

# 8. plot
p_sankey <- ggplot(
  sankey_df,
  aes(
    x = stage,
    y = weight,
    group = node,
    connector = connector,
    edge_id = edge_id
  )
) +
  geom_sankeynode(
    aes(fill = node),
    position = pos,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_sankeyedge(
    aes(fill = node),
    position = pos,
    show.legend = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = node),
    stat = "sankeynode",
    position = pos_text,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = node_col_map) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("GPCR downstream signalling", "Rhythmic module", "Drug metabolism"),
    expand = expansion(add = c(0.45, 0.45)),
    position = "top"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(0.8, 1.0, 0.5, 1.0, unit = "cm"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold", size = 20)
  )

p_sankey
out_dir <- "outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/sankey_plot"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "sankey_full_gpcr_module_drug.pdf"),
  p_sankey,
  width = 13,
  height = 12
)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "sankey_full_gpcr_module_drug.png"),
  p_sankey,
  width = 13,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 300
)
```

#cell phase flower
```{r}
# liver full-celltype cell phase flower
rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
})

# 0. paths
base_dir <- "outputs/liver"
phase_file <- file.path(base_dir, "scCircadianliver_fullcelltype_phase.Rdata")
obj_file   <- file.path(base_dir, "scCircadianliver_fullcelltype_object.Rdata")

out_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "scCircadianliver_fullcelltype_flower")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 1. load
load(phase_file)   # res_phase_liver_global
load(obj_file)     # obj_use

# 2. helper
wrap_phase <- function(x) {
  ((as.numeric(x) %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi)
}

hour_to_rad <- function(h) {
  (h %% 24) / 24 * 2 * pi
}

sanitize_tag <- function(x) {
  gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x)
}

circ_density_df <- function(theta_vec, zt_name, n_grid = 720, bw = 0.35) {
  
  theta_vec <- as.numeric(theta_vec)
  theta_vec <- theta_vec[is.finite(theta_vec)]
  theta_vec <- wrap_phase(theta_vec)
  
  theta_ext <- c(theta_vec - 2 * pi, theta_vec, theta_vec + 2 * pi)
  
  dens <- stats::density(
    theta_ext,
    from = 0,
    to = 2 * pi,
    n = n_grid,
    bw = bw
  )
  
  tibble::tibble(
    theta = dens$x,
    density = dens$y,
    ZT_group = zt_name
  )
}

make_ring_df_one <- function(zt_values) {
  
  zt_values <- sort(unique(as.numeric(zt_values)))
  zt_values <- zt_values[is.finite(zt_values)]
  
  zt_ext <- c(zt_values[length(zt_values)] - 24, zt_values, zt_values[1] + 24)
  mids <- (zt_ext[-length(zt_ext)] + zt_ext[-1]) / 2
  lefts <- mids[-length(mids)]
  rights <- mids[-1]
  
  purrr::map2_dfr(lefts, rights, function(l, r) {
    tibble::tibble(hour_raw = seq(l, r, length.out = 240))
  }) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      seg_id = rep(seq_along(zt_values), each = 240),
      hour = hour_raw %% 24,
      theta = hour_to_rad(hour),
      ZT_group = factor(
        paste0("ZT", stringr::str_pad(zt_values[seg_id], 2, pad = "0")),
        levels = paste0("ZT", stringr::str_pad(zt_values, 2, pad = "0"))
      ),
      r0 = 0.98,
      r1 = 1.18
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(theta, ZT_group, r0, r1)
}

# 3. fixed plot pieces
circle_df <- tibble::tibble(
  theta = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 500),
  r = 2.05
)

major_tick_hours <- c(0, 6, 12, 18)
minor_tick_hours <- c(3, 9, 15, 21)

major_tick_df <- tibble::tibble(
  hour = major_tick_hours,
  theta = hour_to_rad(hour)
)

minor_tick_df <- tibble::tibble(
  hour = minor_tick_hours,
  theta = hour_to_rad(hour)
)

label_df_major <- tibble::tibble(
  hour = major_tick_hours,
  theta = hour_to_rad(hour),
  r = 2.18,
  lab = paste0(major_tick_hours, "h")
)

label_df_minor <- tibble::tibble(
  hour = minor_tick_hours,
  theta = hour_to_rad(hour),
  r = 2.11,
  lab = paste0(minor_tick_hours, "h")
)

# liver ZT color map
zt_cols <- c(
  "ZT02" = "#D97B93",
  "ZT06" = "#F08A72",
  "ZT10" = "#F3B36A",
  "ZT14" = "#A9D17A",
  "ZT18" = "#7FC4A5",
  "ZT22" = "#7E79BF"
)

# 4. prepare metadata
theta_pred_vec <- setNames(
  as.numeric(res_phase_liver_global$theta_pred),
  res_phase_liver_global$cell
)

meta_plot_all <- obj_use@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    ZT_raw = as.character(ZT),
    ZT_num = readr::parse_number(ZT_raw),
    ZT_num = ((ZT_num %% 24) + 24) %% 24,
    theta_pred = theta_pred_vec[cell]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(ZT_num),
    is.finite(theta_pred),
    !is.na(celltype)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    theta_pred = wrap_phase(theta_pred)
  )

celltype_df <- meta_plot_all %>%
  dplyr::count(celltype, name = "n_cells") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_cells))

readr::write_tsv(
  celltype_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "celltype_cellnumber.tsv")
)

# 5. one-celltype plotting function
plot_one_celltype_flower <- function(celltype_use, meta_plot_all, out_dir, bw = 0.35) {
  
  celltype_tag <- sanitize_tag(celltype_use)
  
  meta_plot <- meta_plot_all %>%
    dplyr::filter(celltype == celltype_use)
  
  zt_levels_num <- sort(unique(meta_plot$ZT_num))
  zt_labels <- paste0("ZT", stringr::str_pad(zt_levels_num, 2, pad = "0"))
  
  meta_plot <- meta_plot %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      ZT_group = factor(
        paste0("ZT", stringr::str_pad(ZT_num, 2, pad = "0")),
        levels = zt_labels
      )
    )
  
  density_input <- meta_plot %>%
    dplyr::group_by(ZT_group) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      theta_list = list(theta_pred),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  density_df <- purrr::map2_dfr(
    density_input$ZT_group,
    density_input$theta_list,
    function(zt_lab, th_vec) {
      circ_density_df(
        theta_vec = unlist(th_vec),
        zt_name = as.character(zt_lab),
        n_grid = 720,
        bw = bw
      )
    }
  ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(ZT_group) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      density_scaled = density / max(density, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      r_inner = 1.10,
      r_outer = 1.10 + density_scaled * 0.95,
      ZT_group = factor(ZT_group, levels = zt_labels)
    )
  
  ring_df <- make_ring_df_one(zt_values = zt_levels_num)
  zt_cols_use <- zt_cols[names(zt_cols) %in% zt_labels]
  
  n_df <- tibble::tibble(
    x = 0,
    y = 0.45,
    lab = paste0("n = ", nrow(meta_plot))
  )
  
  p_one <- ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = density_df,
      aes(
        x = theta,
        ymin = r_inner,
        ymax = r_outer,
        group = ZT_group,
        fill = ZT_group
      ),
      alpha = 0.35,
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = ring_df,
      aes(
        x = theta,
        ymin = r0,
        ymax = r1,
        fill = ZT_group
      ),
      alpha = 0.95,
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_path(
      data = circle_df,
      aes(x = theta, y = r),
      color = "grey45",
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = major_tick_df,
      aes(x = theta, xend = theta, y = 0, yend = 2.05),
      color = "grey75",
      linewidth = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = minor_tick_df,
      aes(x = theta, xend = theta, y = 1.93, yend = 2.05),
      color = "grey45",
      linewidth = 0.45
    ) +
    annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
      ymin = 0, ymax = 0.92,
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = label_df_major,
      aes(x = theta, y = r, label = lab),
      size = 4.8,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "grey20"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = label_df_minor,
      aes(x = theta, y = r, label = lab),
      size = 3.6,
      color = "grey35"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = n_df,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab),
      size = 4.8,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "grey20"
    ) +
    coord_polar(start = 0, direction = 1, clip = "off") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = zt_cols_use,
      name = "ZT"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2 * pi)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 2.20)) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.margin = margin(20, 30, 20, 20)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(celltype_use, " Predicted Cell Phase")
    )
  
  print(p_one)
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(celltype_tag, "_flower_plot.png")),
    plot = p_one,
    width = 7.2,
    height = 6.2,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(celltype_tag, "_flower_plot.pdf")),
    plot = p_one,
    width = 7.2,
    height = 6.2
  )
  
  summary_df <- meta_plot %>%
    dplyr::count(ZT_group, name = "n_cells")
  
  readr::write_tsv(
    summary_df,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(celltype_tag, "_flower_plot_cellcount.tsv"))
  )
}

# 6. run all celltypes
for (i in seq_len(nrow(celltype_df))) {
  
  celltype_use <- celltype_df$celltype[i]
  message("Plotting flower: ", celltype_use)
  
  plot_one_celltype_flower(
    celltype_use = celltype_use,
    meta_plot_all = meta_plot_all,
    out_dir = out_dir,
    bw = 0.35
  )
  
  gc()
}
```

#STEP2A
```{r}
# liver Step2A: per-celltype gene rhythmic feature extraction
rm(list = ls()); gc()

options(future.globals.maxSize = Inf)
options(future.wait.timeout = 60 * 60)
options(parallelly.makeNodePSOCK.timeout = 60 * 10)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(qs)
})

source("../R/infer_gene_param.R")

out_dir_phase <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase"
out_dir_param <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/per_celltype_param"
dir.create(out_dir_param, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

load(file.path(out_dir_phase, "scLiver_full_object.Rdata"))               # scliver
load(file.path(out_dir_phase, "scLiver_full_countmat.Rdata"))             # count_mat
load(file.path(out_dir_phase, "scLiver_full_infer_scRhythm_phase.Rdata")) # res_phase_global

DefaultAssay(scliver) <- "RNA"

meta_df <- scliver@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    group = as.character(group),
    ZT_num = readr::parse_number(as.character(ZT)),
    ZT_num = ((ZT_num %% 24) + 24) %% 24
  )

theta_pred_vec <- setNames(as.numeric(res_phase_global$theta_pred), res_phase_global$cell)
r_cell_vec     <- setNames(as.numeric(res_phase_global$r_cell), res_phase_global$cell)

cells_now <- colnames(count_mat)

theta_pred_all <- as.numeric(theta_pred_vec[cells_now])
r_cell_all     <- as.numeric(r_cell_vec[cells_now])

stopifnot(length(theta_pred_all) == ncol(count_mat))
stopifnot(length(r_cell_all) == ncol(count_mat))
stopifnot(identical(cells_now, colnames(scliver)))

celltype_df <- meta_df %>%
  dplyr::count(celltype, name = "n_cells") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_cells))

readr::write_tsv(
  celltype_df,
  file.path(out_dir_param, "celltype_cellnumber.tsv")
)

run_info <- vector("list", nrow(celltype_df))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(celltype_df))) {

  celltype_use <- celltype_df$celltype[i]
  celltype_tag <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", celltype_use)

  message("Running param for celltype: ", celltype_use)

  cells_use <- meta_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(celltype == celltype_use) %>%
    dplyr::pull(cell)

  idx_use <- match(cells_use, cells_now)

  count_mat_sub <- count_mat[, idx_use, drop = FALSE]
  theta_sub <- theta_pred_all[idx_use]
  r_sub <- r_cell_all[idx_use]
  meta_sub <- meta_df %>%
    dplyr::slice(match(cells_use, cell))

  stopifnot(ncol(count_mat_sub) == length(theta_sub))
  stopifnot(ncol(count_mat_sub) == length(r_sub))
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(count_mat_sub), cells_use))
  stopifnot(identical(meta_sub$cell, cells_use))

  res_param <- infer_gene_param(
    count = count_mat_sub,
    metadata = meta_sub,
    theta_pred = theta_sub,
    r_cell = r_sub,
    strata_by = "celltype",
    ZT_by = "ZT_num",
    B = 50,
    setseed = 20260318,
    sample_by = "group"
  )

  save(
    res_param,
    file = file.path(out_dir_param, paste0(celltype_tag, "_infer_scRhythm_param.Rdata"))
  )

  readr::write_tsv(
    res_param$param_long,
    file.path(out_dir_param, paste0(celltype_tag, "_param_long.tsv"))
  )

  readr::write_tsv(
    res_param$param_wide,
    file.path(out_dir_param, paste0(celltype_tag, "_param_wide.tsv"))
  )

  readr::write_tsv(
    res_param$bootstrap_res,
    file.path(out_dir_param, paste0(celltype_tag, "_bootstrap.tsv"))
  )

  run_info[[i]] <- tibble::tibble(
    celltype = celltype_use,
    n_cells = ncol(count_mat_sub),
    n_genes = nrow(count_mat_sub),
    mean_r_cell = mean(r_sub, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_r_cell = median(r_sub, na.rm = TRUE),
    status = "done"
  )

  rm(cells_use, idx_use, count_mat_sub, theta_sub, r_sub, meta_sub, res_param)
  gc()
}

run_info_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(run_info)

readr::write_tsv(
  run_info_df,
  file.path(out_dir_param, "per_celltype_param_run_summary.tsv")
)
```

#correlation
```{r}
# load
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_fullcelltype_object.Rdata")   # obj_use
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_fullcelltype_phase.Rdata")    # res_phase_liver_global

# 1. merge metadata + phase
phase_df <- res_phase_liver_global %>%
  dplyr::select(cell, Rbar, r_cell)

meta_df <- obj_use@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::select(cell, nCount_RNA, nFeature_RNA, ZT, celltype)

plot_df <- phase_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(meta_df, by = "cell") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    nCount_RNA = as.numeric(nCount_RNA),
    Rbar = as.numeric(Rbar),
    r_cell = as.numeric(r_cell)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(nCount_RNA),
    is.finite(Rbar),
    is.finite(r_cell)
  )

# 2. correlations
cor_spear_rbar <- cor.test(plot_df$nCount_RNA, plot_df$Rbar, method = "spearman")
cor_pear_rbar  <- cor.test(plot_df$nCount_RNA, plot_df$Rbar, method = "pearson")

cor_spear_rcell <- cor.test(plot_df$nCount_RNA, plot_df$r_cell, method = "spearman")
cor_pear_rcell  <- cor.test(plot_df$nCount_RNA, plot_df$r_cell, method = "pearson")

# 3. label text
lab_rbar <- paste0(
  "Spearman \u03c1 = ", sprintf("%.3f", unname(cor_spear_rbar$estimate)),
  "\nPearson r = ", sprintf("%.3f", unname(cor_pear_rbar$estimate))
)

lab_rcell <- paste0(
  "Spearman \u03c1 = ", sprintf("%.3f", unname(cor_spear_rcell$estimate)),
  "\nPearson r = ", sprintf("%.3f", unname(cor_pear_rcell$estimate))
)

# 4. output dir
out_dir <- "outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_fullcelltype_phase_correlation"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 5. plot: nCount_RNA vs Rbar
p_rbar <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = nCount_RNA, y = Rbar)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1.2, color = "#D97B93") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = Inf,
    label = lab_rbar,
    hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Relationship between nCount_RNA and Rbar",
    x = "nCount_RNA",
    y = "Rbar"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_rbar)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "nCount_RNA_vs_Rbar.pdf"),
  p_rbar,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 5.2
)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "nCount_RNA_vs_Rbar.png"),
  p_rbar,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 5.2,
  dpi = 300
)

# 6. optional: nCount_RNA vs r_cell
p_rcell <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = nCount_RNA, y = r_cell)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1.2, color = "#7FC4A5") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = Inf,
    label = lab_rcell,
    hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Relationship between nCount_RNA and r_cell",
    x = "nCount_RNA",
    y = "r_cell"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_rcell)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "nCount_RNA_vs_r_cell.pdf"),
  p_rcell,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 5.2
)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "nCount_RNA_vs_r_cell.png"),
  p_rcell,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 5.2,
  dpi = 300
)

# 7. save correlation table
cor_df <- tibble::tibble(
  metric = c("Rbar", "Rbar", "r_cell", "r_cell"),
  method = c("spearman", "pearson", "spearman", "pearson"),
  estimate = c(
    unname(cor_spear_rbar$estimate),
    unname(cor_pear_rbar$estimate),
    unname(cor_spear_rcell$estimate),
    unname(cor_pear_rcell$estimate)
  ),
  p_value = c(
    cor_spear_rbar$p.value,
    cor_pear_rbar$p.value,
    cor_spear_rcell$p.value,
    cor_pear_rcell$p.value
  )
)

readr::write_tsv(
  cor_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "nCount_RNA_phase_confidence_correlation.tsv")
)
```

#module
```{r}
rm(list = ls()); gc()

options(future.globals.maxSize = Inf)
options(future.wait.timeout = 60 * 60)
options(parallelly.makeNodePSOCK.timeout = 60 * 10)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(qs)
  library(purrr)
})

source("../R/infer_gene_param.R")
source("../R/infer_rhythm_module.R")


# 0. paths

root_dir <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase"
out_dir_pair <- file.path(root_dir, "pairwise_module_all_pairs")
dir.create(out_dir_pair, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


# 1. load global results

load(file.path(root_dir, "scLiver_full_object.Rdata"))               # scliver
load(file.path(root_dir, "scLiver_full_countmat.Rdata"))             # count_mat
load(file.path(root_dir, "scLiver_full_infer_scRhythm_phase.Rdata")) # res_phase_global

DefaultAssay(scliver) <- "RNA"

meta_df <- scliver@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    group = as.character(group),
    ZT_num = readr::parse_number(as.character(ZT)),
    ZT_num = ((ZT_num %% 24) + 24) %% 24
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(celltype))

cells_now <- colnames(count_mat)

theta_pred_vec <- setNames(
  as.numeric(res_phase_global$theta_pred),
  res_phase_global$cell
)

r_cell_vec <- setNames(
  as.numeric(res_phase_global$r_cell),
  res_phase_global$cell
)

theta_pred_all <- as.numeric(theta_pred_vec[cells_now])
r_cell_all     <- as.numeric(r_cell_vec[cells_now])

stopifnot(length(theta_pred_all) == ncol(count_mat))
stopifnot(length(r_cell_all) == ncol(count_mat))
stopifnot(identical(cells_now, colnames(scliver)))


# 2. all pair combinations

celltype_df <- meta_df %>%
  dplyr::count(celltype, name = "n_cells") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_cells))

celltypes_all <- celltype_df$celltype

pair_mat <- t(utils::combn(celltypes_all, 2))

pair_df <- tibble::tibble(
  celltype_1 = pair_mat[, 1],
  celltype_2 = pair_mat[, 2]
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pair_tag = paste0(
      gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", celltype_1),
      "_vs_",
      gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", celltype_2)
    )
  )

readr::write_tsv(
  pair_df,
  file.path(out_dir_pair, "all_celltype_pairs.tsv")
)


# 3. run one pair

run_one_pair <- function(ct1, ct2, pair_tag) {
  
  pair_dir <- file.path(out_dir_pair, pair_tag)
  dir.create(pair_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  param_rdata_file <- file.path(pair_dir, paste0(pair_tag, "_infer_scRhythm_param.Rdata"))
  param_long_file  <- file.path(pair_dir, paste0(pair_tag, "_param_long.tsv"))
  param_wide_file  <- file.path(pair_dir, paste0(pair_tag, "_param_wide.tsv"))
  boot_file        <- file.path(pair_dir, paste0(pair_tag, "_bootstrap.tsv"))
  module_rdata_file <- file.path(pair_dir, paste0(pair_tag, "_infer_scRhythm_module.Rdata"))
  module_tsv_file   <- file.path(pair_dir, paste0(pair_tag, "_module_result.tsv"))
  
  done_flag <- file.exists(param_rdata_file) &
    file.exists(param_long_file) &
    file.exists(param_wide_file) &
    file.exists(boot_file) &
    file.exists(module_rdata_file) &
    file.exists(module_tsv_file)
  
  message("Running pair: ", ct1, " vs ", ct2)
  
  cells_use <- meta_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(celltype %in% c(ct1, ct2)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(cell)
  
  idx_use <- match(cells_use, cells_now)
  
  count_mat_sub <- count_mat[, idx_use, drop = FALSE]
  theta_sub <- theta_pred_all[idx_use]
  r_sub <- r_cell_all[idx_use]
  
  meta_sub <- meta_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(cell %in% cells_use) %>%
    dplyr::slice(match(cells_use, cell))
  
  condition_sub <- meta_sub$celltype
  celltype_sub  <- rep("pairwise_compare", length(cells_use))
  
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(count_mat_sub), cells_use))
  stopifnot(length(theta_sub) == ncol(count_mat_sub))
  stopifnot(length(r_sub) == ncol(count_mat_sub))
  stopifnot(length(condition_sub) == ncol(count_mat_sub))
  
  res_param <- done_flag * 0
  
  done_res <- done_flag %>%
    as.logical()
  
  res_out <- list()
  
  res_out$run_status <- c("rerun", "skip_existing")[done_res + 1]
  
  res_param <- c(list(NULL), list({
    infer_gene_param(
      count = count_mat_sub,
      metadata = meta_sub,
      theta_pred = theta_sub,
      r_cell = r_sub,
      strata_by = "celltype",
      ZT_by = "ZT_num",
      B = 50,
      setseed = 20260318,
      sample_by = "group"
    )
  }))[[done_res + 1]]
  
  loaded_param <- c(list({
    load(param_rdata_file)
    res_param
  }), list(NULL))[[done_res + 1]]
  
  res_param_final <- c(list(res_param), list(loaded_param))[[done_res + 1]]
  
  save_switch <- c(FALSE, TRUE)[done_res + 1]
  
  invisible(
    save_switch |
      {
        save(
          res_param_final,
          file = param_rdata_file
        )
        
        readr::write_tsv(
          res_param_final$param_long,
          param_long_file
        )
        
        readr::write_tsv(
          res_param_final$param_wide,
          param_wide_file
        )
        
        readr::write_tsv(
          res_param_final$bootstrap_res,
          boot_file
        )
        
        FALSE
      }
  )
  
  module_done_flag <- file.exists(module_rdata_file) & file.exists(module_tsv_file)
  
  res_module <- c(list(NULL), list({
    infer_rhythm_module(
      param_wide = res_param_final$param_wide,
      compare_by = "celltype",
      group1 = ct1,
      group2 = ct2,
      out_dir = pair_dir
    )
  }))[[module_done_flag + 1]]
  
  loaded_module <- c(list({
    load(module_rdata_file)
    res_module_pair
  }), list(NULL))[[module_done_flag + 1]]
  
  res_module_final <- c(list(res_module), list(loaded_module))[[module_done_flag + 1]]
  
  invisible(
    c(FALSE, TRUE)[module_done_flag + 1] |
      {
        res_module_pair <- res_module_final
        
        save(
          res_module_pair,
          file = module_rdata_file
        )
        
        readr::write_tsv(
          res_module_pair$module_result,
          module_tsv_file
        )
        
        FALSE
      }
  )
  
  module_count_df <- res_module_final$module_result %>%
    dplyr::count(module_map, name = "n_gene") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      module_map = as.character(module_map)
    )
  
  readr::write_tsv(
    module_count_df,
    file.path(pair_dir, paste0(pair_tag, "_module_count.tsv"))
  )
  
  tibble::tibble(
    pair_tag = pair_tag,
    celltype_1 = ct1,
    celltype_2 = ct2,
    n_cells_total = length(cells_use),
    n_cells_ct1 = sum(condition_sub == ct1),
    n_cells_ct2 = sum(condition_sub == ct2),
    n_genes = nrow(count_mat_sub),
    mean_r_cell = mean(r_sub, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_r_cell = median(r_sub, na.rm = TRUE),
    status = "done"
  )
}


# 4. batch run all pairs
pair_summary_list <- purrr::pmap(
  list(
    ct1 = pair_df$celltype_1,
    ct2 = pair_df$celltype_2,
    pair_tag = pair_df$pair_tag
  ),
  run_one_pair
)

pair_run_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(pair_summary_list)

readr::write_tsv(
  pair_run_summary,
  file.path(out_dir_pair, "pair_run_summary.tsv")
)
```

```{r}
)

  ) +

)

)

)

)
```

```{r}
  library(qs)
  library(Seurat)

  library(tibble)

})

# 1. source function
source("support/legacy/liver_block_m3_heatmap.R")

# 2. load object + phase result
scliver <- qread("data/scCircadianLiver-RNAonly.qs")
DefaultAssay(scliver) <- "RNA"

load("outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/scLiver_full_infer_scRhythm_phase.Rdata")

# 3. expression matrix
count_mat <- GetAssayData(
  scliver,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "counts"
)

# 4. cell metadata
cell_meta <- scliver@meta.data
cell_meta$celltype <- as.character(cell_meta$celltype)
cell_meta$theta_pred <- as.numeric(res_phase_global$theta_pred)
rownames(cell_meta) <- colnames(scliver)

# 5. OVR result
ovr_df <- readr::read_tsv(
  "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/OVR_group1_group2/Liver_group1_vs_group2_all.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

out_dir <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase"

res_full_ht <- build_scRhythm_OVR_fullmatrix_heatmap(
  expr_mat = count_mat,
  cell_meta = cell_meta,
  ovr_df = ovr_df,
  out_dir = out_dir,
  celltype_col = "celltype",
  theta_col = "theta_pred",
  gene_col = "gene",
  target_col = "TargetCellType",
  phase_col = "Phase_group1",
  flag_col = "Module3_flag",
  n_grid = 60,
  k = 8
)
saveRDS(
  res_full_ht,
  file = file.path(out_dir, "res_full_ht_M3.rds")
)

pdf(
  file.path(out_dir, "M3_fullmatrix_heatmap.pdf"),
  width = 16,
  height = 12
)
plot(res_full_ht)
dev.off()

png(
  file.path(out_dir, "M3_fullmatrix_heatmap.png"),
  width = 3200,
  height = 2400,
  res = 220
)
plot(res_full_ht)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(org.Mm.eg.db)
  library(ReactomePA)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr)
  library(grid)
})

# 0. input/output
infile <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/OVR_group1_group2/Liver_group1_vs_group2_all.tsv"
out_dir <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/OVR_group1_group2/Reactome_M3_by_celltype"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 1. read data
ovr_all <- readr::read_tsv(
  infile,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TargetCellType = as.character(TargetCellType),
    gene = as.character(gene)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(TargetCellType),
    !is.na(gene),
    gene != ""
  )

# celltype order: by M3 gene count
celltype_order <- ovr_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(Module3_flag) %>%
  dplyr::count(TargetCellType, name = "n_M3") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_M3)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(TargetCellType) %>%
  unique()

# 2. helper: SYMBOL -> ENTREZ
symbol_to_entrez <- function(gene_vec) {
  
  gene_vec <- unique(as.character(gene_vec))
  gene_vec <- gene_vec[!is.na(gene_vec)]
  gene_vec <- gene_vec[gene_vec != ""]
  
  if (length(gene_vec) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(SYMBOL = character(0), ENTREZID = character(0)))
  }
  
  out <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(
      clusterProfiler::bitr(
        gene_vec,
        fromType = "SYMBOL",
        toType = "ENTREZID",
        OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db
      )
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      tibble::tibble(SYMBOL = character(0), ENTREZID = character(0))
    }
  )
  
  out %>%
    dplyr::distinct(SYMBOL, ENTREZID)
}

# 3. run Reactome for one celltype
run_one_celltype_reactome <- function(ct_use) {
  
  message("Running Reactome for: ", ct_use)
  
  df_ct <- ovr_all %>%
    dplyr::filter(TargetCellType == ct_use)
  
  genes_fg_symbol <- df_ct %>%
    dplyr::filter(Module3_flag) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
    unique() %>%
    sort()
  
  genes_bg_symbol <- df_ct %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
    unique() %>%
    sort()
  
  fg_map <- symbol_to_entrez(genes_fg_symbol)
  bg_map <- symbol_to_entrez(genes_bg_symbol)
  
  genes_fg_entrez <- unique(fg_map$ENTREZID)
  genes_bg_entrez <- unique(bg_map$ENTREZID)
  
  stat_df <- tibble::tibble(
    TargetCellType = ct_use,
    n_fg_symbol = length(genes_fg_symbol),
    n_bg_symbol = length(genes_bg_symbol),
    n_fg_entrez = length(genes_fg_entrez),
    n_bg_entrez = length(genes_bg_entrez)
  )
  
  readr::write_tsv(
    stat_df,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", ct_use), "_gene_stat.tsv"))
  )
  
  if (length(genes_fg_entrez) < 10 || length(genes_bg_entrez) < 10) {
    summary_df <- tibble::tibble(
      TargetCellType = ct_use,
      n_fg_symbol = length(genes_fg_symbol),
      n_bg_symbol = length(genes_bg_symbol),
      n_fg_entrez = length(genes_fg_entrez),
      n_bg_entrez = length(genes_bg_entrez),
      n_terms_raw_p_lt_0_05 = 0,
      n_terms_padj_lt_0_05 = 0,
      status = "too_few_genes"
    )
    
    return(list(
      stat = stat_df,
      summary = summary_df,
      reactome = tibble::tibble()
    ))
  }
  
  ego_rt <- tryCatch(
    ReactomePA::enrichPathway(
      gene = genes_fg_entrez,
      organism = "mouse",
      pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      qvalueCutoff = 0.20,
      universe = genes_bg_entrez,
      readable = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(ego_rt)) {
    summary_df <- tibble::tibble(
      TargetCellType = ct_use,
      n_fg_symbol = length(genes_fg_symbol),
      n_bg_symbol = length(genes_bg_symbol),
      n_fg_entrez = length(genes_fg_entrez),
      n_bg_entrez = length(genes_bg_entrez),
      n_terms_raw_p_lt_0_05 = 0,
      n_terms_padj_lt_0_05 = 0,
      status = "enrichPathway_failed"
    )
    
    return(list(
      stat = stat_df,
      summary = summary_df,
      reactome = tibble::tibble()
    ))
  }
  
  res_rt <- ego_rt@result %>%
    tibble::as_tibble()
  
  if (nrow(res_rt) == 0) {
    summary_df <- tibble::tibble(
      TargetCellType = ct_use,
      n_fg_symbol = length(genes_fg_symbol),
      n_bg_symbol = length(genes_bg_symbol),
      n_fg_entrez = length(genes_fg_entrez),
      n_bg_entrez = length(genes_bg_entrez),
      n_terms_raw_p_lt_0_05 = 0,
      n_terms_padj_lt_0_05 = 0,
      status = "no_terms"
    )
    
    return(list(
      stat = stat_df,
      summary = summary_df,
      reactome = tibble::tibble()
    ))
  }
  
  res_rt <- res_rt %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      TargetCellType = ct_use
    )
  
  readr::write_tsv(
    res_rt,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", ct_use), "_Reactome_full.tsv"))
  )
  
  summary_df <- tibble::tibble(
    TargetCellType = ct_use,
    n_fg_symbol = length(genes_fg_symbol),
    n_bg_symbol = length(genes_bg_symbol),
    n_fg_entrez = length(genes_fg_entrez),
    n_bg_entrez = length(genes_bg_entrez),
    n_terms_raw_p_lt_0_05 = sum(res_rt$pvalue < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_terms_padj_lt_0_05 = sum(res_rt$p.adjust < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    status = "ok"
  )
  
  list(
    stat = stat_df,
    summary = summary_df,
    reactome = res_rt
  )
}

# 4. run all
res_list <- lapply(celltype_order, run_one_celltype_reactome)
names(res_list) <- celltype_order

stat_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(res_list, `[[`, "stat"))
summary_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(res_list, `[[`, "summary"))
reactome_all_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(res_list, `[[`, "reactome"))

readr::write_tsv(
  stat_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "Reactome_celltype_gene_stat_all.tsv")
)

readr::write_tsv(
  summary_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "Reactome_celltype_summary.tsv")
)

readr::write_tsv(
  reactome_all_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "Reactome_celltype_all.tsv")
)

# 5. build top5 summary plot table
use_pathway <- reactome_all_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(TargetCellType) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p.adjust, dplyr::desc(Count), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype_show = TargetCellType,
    neglog10_p = -log10(pvalue),
    Description_wrapped = Description
  )

readr::write_tsv(
  use_pathway,
  file.path(out_dir, "Reactome_celltype_top5_for_plot.tsv")
)

if (nrow(use_pathway) == 0) {
  message("No significant Reactome pathways found for plotting.")
} else {
  
  # 6. colors

  celltype_pal <- c(
  "Hep.PV" = "#E84D33",
  "Hep.CV" = "#55B3CF",
  "Kupffer cells" = "#455A8B",
  "Fibroblasts" = "#9ED3C9",
  "Endothelial" = "#13A88E",
  "Lymphocytes" = "#F29C7E",
  "Cholangiocytes" = "#6A78A8"
)

  # remove the last celltype from plotting
  celltype_plot_order <- setdiff(celltype_order, "Cholangiocytes")
  
  use_pathway <- use_pathway %>%
    dplyr::filter(celltype_show %in% celltype_plot_order) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      celltype_show = factor(celltype_show, levels = celltype_plot_order)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(celltype_show, p.adjust, dplyr::desc(Count)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Description_wrapped = as.character(Description_wrapped),
      y_show_chr = make.unique(Description_wrapped),
      y_show = factor(y_show_chr, levels = rev(y_show_chr))
    )
  
  width <- 0.55
  xaxis_max <- max(use_pathway$neglog10_p, na.rm = TRUE) + 1
  
  rect.data <- use_pathway %>%
    dplyr::count(celltype_show, name = "n", .drop = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(celltype_show)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      xmin = -3.2 * width,
      xmax = -2.0 * width,
      ymax = cumsum(n),
      ymin = dplyr::lag(ymax, default = 0) + 0.8,
      ymax = ymax + 0.6
    )
  
  p_celltype_all <- use_pathway %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = neglog10_p, y = y_show, fill = celltype_show)) +
    geom_col(
      width = 1,
      alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(x = 0.08, y = y_show, label = Description_wrapped),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = 5.2,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(x = -width, y = y_show, size = Count),
      shape = 21,
      stroke = 0.6,
      fill = "white",
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(x = -width, y = y_show, label = Count),
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = 4.0,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "Count",
      range = c(4.5, 12)
    ) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax,
        ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax,
        fill = celltype_show
      ),
      data = rect.data,
      alpha = 0.5,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        x = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
        y = (ymin + ymax) / 2,
        label = celltype_show
      ),
      data = rect.data,
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 4.2,
      fontface = "bold",
      angle = 90
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = xaxis_max, yend = 0),
      linewidth = 1.2,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      x = expression(-log[10](pvalue)),
      y = NULL,
      title = "Top enriched Reactome pathways across liver cell types"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "Cell type",
      values = celltype_pal[celltype_plot_order]
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, xaxis_max, by = 2),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
    ) +

      axis.text.y = element_blank(),

      plot.margin = margin(15, 20, 40, 20)
    )
  
  print(p_celltype_all)
  
  ggsave(

    plot = p_celltype_all,

  ggsave(

    plot = p_celltype_all,

  )
}
```

```{r}
# 5. cyclic smooth helper

fit_one_gene_one_celltype <- function(df_sub, n_grid = 300, k = 8) {
  
  theta_grid_hour <- seq(0, 24, length.out = n_grid)
  
  fit <- try(
    mgcv::gam(
      expr ~ s(theta_hour, bs = "cc", k = k),
      data = df_sub,
      method = "REML",
      knots = list(theta_hour = c(0, 24))
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  
  pred <- tryCatch(
    stats::predict(
      fit,
      newdata = data.frame(theta_hour = theta_grid_hour)
    ),
    error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(theta_grid_hour))
  )
  
  tibble::tibble(
    theta_hour = theta_grid_hour,
    theta_pred = theta_grid_hour / 24 * 2 * pi,
    expr_fit = pred
  )
}
```

#cell phase distribution
```{r}
# cell phase density by celltype, one plot per celltype
rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(qs)
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
})

# 0. load current correct data
scliver <- qread("data/scCircadianLiver-RNAonly.qs")
DefaultAssay(scliver) <- "RNA"

load("outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/scLiver_full_infer_scRhythm_phase.Rdata")

# 1. helper
wrap_phase <- function(x) {
  ((as.numeric(x) %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi)
}

# 2. fixed colors
celltype_pal <- c(
  "Hep.PV" = "#E84D33",
  "Hep.CV" = "#55B3CF",
  "Kupffer cells" = "#455A8B",
  "Fibroblasts" = "#9ED3C9",
  "Endothelial" = "#13A88E",
  "Lymphocytes" = "#F29C7E",
  "Cholangiocytes" = "#6A78A8"
)

celltype_levels <- c(
  "Hep.PV",
  "Hep.CV",
  "Kupffer cells",
  "Fibroblasts",
  "Endothelial",
  "Lymphocytes",
  "Cholangiocytes"
)

# 3. metadata
meta_plot <- scliver@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    theta_pred = as.numeric(res_phase_global$theta_pred)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    celltype %in% celltype_levels,
    is.finite(theta_pred)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    theta_pred = wrap_phase(theta_pred),
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = celltype_levels)
  )

out_dir <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/cell_phase_density_split"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# 4. save cell counts
cell_count_df <- meta_plot %>%
  dplyr::count(celltype, name = "n_cells")

readr::write_tsv(
  cell_count_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "cell_count_by_celltype.tsv")
)

# 5. circular density helper
circ_density_df <- function(theta_vec, group_name, n_grid = 720, bw = 0.35) {
  
  theta_vec <- as.numeric(theta_vec)
  theta_vec <- theta_vec[is.finite(theta_vec)]
  theta_vec <- wrap_phase(theta_vec)
  
  theta_ext <- c(theta_vec - 2 * pi, theta_vec, theta_vec + 2 * pi)
  
  dens <- stats::density(
    theta_ext,
    from = 0,
    to = 2 * pi,
    n = n_grid,
    bw = bw
  )
  
  tibble::tibble(
    theta = dens$x,
    density = dens$y,
    celltype = group_name
  )
}

# 6. build all density dfs
density_list <- lapply(celltype_levels, function(ct_use) {
  circ_density_df(
    theta_vec = meta_plot$theta_pred[meta_plot$celltype == ct_use],
    group_name = ct_use,
    n_grid = 720,
    bw = 0.35
  )
})
names(density_list) <- celltype_levels

density_df_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(density_list)

readr::write_tsv(
  density_df_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "cell_phase_density_all_celltypes.tsv")
)

# 7. plot each celltype separately
for (ct_use in celltype_levels) {
  
  message("Plotting: ", ct_use)
  
  df_plot <- density_list[[ct_use]] %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      celltype = ct_use
    )
  
  n_cell_now <- cell_count_df$n_cells[cell_count_df$celltype == ct_use][1]
  
  p_phase_density <- ggplot(
    df_plot,
    aes(x = theta, y = density)
  ) +
    geom_line(
      color = unname(celltype_pal[ct_use]),
      linewidth = 4
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
  limits = c(0, 2 * pi),
  breaks = c(0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2, 2*pi),
  labels = c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2", "2π"),
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))
) +
    labs(
      title = "Cell Phase distribution",
      subtitle = paste0(ct_use, " (n = ", n_cell_now, ")"),
      x = expression("Predicted phase " * phi),
      y = "Cell density"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 25),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15)
    )
  
  print(p_phase_density)
  
  file_tag <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", ct_use)
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_tag, "_cell_phase_density.pdf")),
    p_phase_density,
    width = 6.8,
    height = 4.8
  )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_tag, "_cell_phase_density.png")),
    p_phase_density,
    width = 6.8,
    height = 4.8,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
# 8. save legend table
legend_df <- tibble::tibble(
  celltype = celltype_levels,
  color = unname(celltype_pal[celltype_levels])
)

readr::write_tsv(
  legend_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "celltype_color_legend.tsv")
)
```

#findallmarker
```{r}
rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(qs)
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# 1. load object
scliver <- qread("data/scCircadianLiver-RNAonly.qs")
DefaultAssay(scliver) <- "RNA"

out_dir <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/FindAllMarkers_celltype"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 2. celltype order by cell number
celltype_levels <- scliver@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(celltype, name = "n_cells") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_cells), celltype) %>%
  dplyr::pull(celltype)

scliver$celltype <- factor(
  as.character(scliver$celltype),
  levels = celltype_levels
)

Idents(scliver) <- "celltype"

# 3. normalize + find markers
scliver <- NormalizeData(
  object = scliver,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = 10000,
  verbose = FALSE
)

markers_all <- FindAllMarkers(
  object = scliver,
  assay = "RNA",
  group.by = "celltype",
  logfc.threshold = 1,
  test.use = "wilcox",
  slot = "data",
  only.pos = TRUE
)

markers_all <- markers_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cluster = factor(cluster, levels = celltype_levels)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(cluster, p_val_adj, dplyr::desc(avg_log2FC))

readr::write_tsv(
  markers_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "FindAllMarkers_all.tsv")
)

# 4. choose top markers for heatmap
markers_top5 <- markers_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    p_val_adj < 0.05,
    avg_log2FC > 1
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p_val_adj, dplyr::desc(avg_log2FC), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

readr::write_tsv(
  markers_top5,
  file.path(out_dir, "FindAllMarkers_top5_for_heatmap.tsv")
)

heatmap_features <- markers_top5 %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
  unique()

# 5. scale only selected genes
scliver <- ScaleData(
  object = scliver,
  features = heatmap_features,
  verbose = FALSE
)

# 6. fixed color mapping by celltype name
celltype_pal_npg <- c(
  "Hep.PV" = "#E84D33",
  "Hep.CV" = "#55B3CF",
  "Kupffer cells" = "#455A8B",
  "Fibroblasts" = "#9ED3C9",
  "Endothelial" = "#13A88E",
  "Lymphocytes" = "#F29C7E",
  "Cholangiocytes" = "#6A78A8"
)

p_heatmap <- DoHeatmap(
  object = scliver,
  features = heatmap_features,
  group.by = "celltype",
  group.bar = TRUE,
  group.colors = celltype_pal_npg,
  disp.min = -2.5,
  disp.max = 2.5,
  slot = "scale.data",
  assay = "RNA",
  label = FALSE,
  size = 5.5,
  hjust = 0,
  angle = 45,
  raster = TRUE,
  draw.lines = TRUE,
  group.bar.height = 0.03,
  combine = TRUE
) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdYlBu"))
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      face = "italic",
      size = 10
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 16
    )
  )

print(p_heatmap)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "DoHeatmap_celltype_top5markers.pdf"),
  plot = p_heatmap,
  width = 12,
  height = 8
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "DoHeatmap_celltype_top5markers.png"),
  plot = p_heatmap,
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)
```

#marker venn
```{r}

findall_path <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/FindAllMarkers_celltype/FindAllMarkers_all.tsv"
ovr_path <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/OVR_group1_group2/Liver_group1_vs_group2_all.tsv"

out_dir <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/OVR_vs_FindAllMarkers_VENN"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


# 1. read data

markers_all <- readr::read_tsv(
  findall_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cluster = as.character(cluster),
    gene = as.character(gene)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(cluster),
    !is.na(gene),
    gene != ""
  )

ovr_all <- readr::read_tsv(
  ovr_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TargetCellType = as.character(TargetCellType),
    gene = as.character(gene)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(TargetCellType),
    !is.na(gene),
    gene != ""
  )

celltype_levels <- c(
  "Hep.PV",
  "Hep.CV",
  "Kupffer cells",
  "Fibroblasts",
  "Endothelial",
  "Lymphocytes",
  "Cholangiocytes"
)


# 2. define significant gene sets

# FindAllMarkers markers: follow your current rule
markers_sig <- markers_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    p_val_adj < 0.05,
    avg_log2FC > 1
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(cluster, gene)

# OVR markers: Module3_flag
ovr_sig <- ovr_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(Module3_flag) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(TargetCellType, gene)


# 3. summary table

summary_list <- vector("list", length(celltype_levels))
names(summary_list) <- celltype_levels

for (i in seq_along(celltype_levels)) {
  
  ct_use <- celltype_levels[i]
  
  genes_findall <- markers_sig %>%
    dplyr::filter(cluster == ct_use) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
    unique() %>%
    sort()
  
  genes_ovr <- ovr_sig %>%
    dplyr::filter(TargetCellType == ct_use) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
    unique() %>%
    sort()
  
  genes_intersect <- intersect(genes_findall, genes_ovr)
  genes_union <- union(genes_findall, genes_ovr)
  genes_findall_only <- setdiff(genes_findall, genes_ovr)
  genes_ovr_only <- setdiff(genes_ovr, genes_findall)
  
  summary_list[[i]] <- tibble::tibble(
    celltype = ct_use,
    n_FindAllMarkers = length(genes_findall),
    n_OVR = length(genes_ovr),
    n_intersect = length(genes_intersect),
    n_union = length(genes_union),
    n_FindAllMarkers_only = length(genes_findall_only),
    n_OVR_only = length(genes_ovr_only),
    overlap_ratio_by_min = dplyr::if_else(
      pmin(length(genes_findall), length(genes_ovr)) > 0,
      length(genes_intersect) / pmin(length(genes_findall), length(genes_ovr)),
      NA_real_
    ),
    jaccard = dplyr::if_else(
      length(genes_union) > 0,
      length(genes_intersect) / length(genes_union),
      NA_real_
    )
  )
}

summary_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(summary_list)

readr::write_tsv(
  summary_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "OVR_vs_FindAllMarkers_overlap_summary.tsv")
)


# 4. save intersection gene tables

for (i in seq_along(celltype_levels)) {
  
  ct_use <- celltype_levels[i]
  ct_tag <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", ct_use)
  
  genes_findall <- markers_sig %>%
    dplyr::filter(cluster == ct_use) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
    unique() %>%
    sort()
  
  genes_ovr <- ovr_sig %>%
    dplyr::filter(TargetCellType == ct_use) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
    unique() %>%
    sort()
  
  gene_table <- tibble::tibble(
    gene = sort(unique(c(genes_findall, genes_ovr)))
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      in_FindAllMarkers = gene %in% genes_findall,
      in_OVR = gene %in% genes_ovr,
      gene_class = dplyr::case_when(
        in_FindAllMarkers & in_OVR ~ "Intersect",
        in_FindAllMarkers & !in_OVR ~ "FindAllMarkers_only",
        !in_FindAllMarkers & in_OVR ~ "OVR_only"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(gene_class, gene)
  
  readr::write_tsv(
    gene_table,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(ct_tag, "_gene_overlap_table.tsv"))
  )
}


# 5. venn colors

venn_fill_colors <- c(
      "FindAllMarkers" = "#E84D33",
      "OVR_Module3" = "#55B3CF"
)

# 6. draw venn for each celltype

for (i in seq_along(celltype_levels)) {
  
  ct_use <- celltype_levels[i]
  ct_tag <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", ct_use)
  
  genes_findall <- markers_sig %>%
    dplyr::filter(cluster == ct_use) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
    unique() %>%
    sort()
  
  genes_ovr <- ovr_sig %>%
    dplyr::filter(TargetCellType == ct_use) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
    unique() %>%
    sort()
  
  venn_list <- list(
    FindAllMarkers = genes_findall,
    OVR_Module3 = genes_ovr
  )
  
  p_venn <- ggvenn(
    data = venn_list,
    fill_color = venn_fill_colors,
    fill_alpha = 0.75,
    stroke_color = "white",
    stroke_size = 0.8,
    set_name_color = "black",
    set_name_size = 5,
    text_color = "black",
    text_size = 8,
    show_percentage = TRUE
  ) +
    labs(
      title = ct_use
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold",
        size = 25
      ),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )
  
  print(p_venn)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0(ct_tag, "_OVR_vs_FindAllMarkers_venn.pdf")),
    plot = p_venn,
    width = 6,
    height = 5
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0(ct_tag, "_OVR_vs_FindAllMarkers_venn.png")),
    plot = p_venn,
    width = 6,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 300
  )
}


# 7. combined barplot of overlap counts

plot_df <- summary_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = celltype_levels)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(n_FindAllMarkers, n_OVR, n_intersect),
    names_to = "set_type",
    values_to = "gene_count"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    set_type = factor(
      set_type,
      levels = c("n_FindAllMarkers", "n_OVR", "n_intersect"),

    )
  )

p_bar <- ggplot(

  )
) +

  ) +

  ) +

  ) +

print(p_bar)
print(p_bar)

ggsave(
```

#cell phase cos
```{r}
# cell-level phase circle by 7 celltypes
rm(list = ls()); gc()
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(qs)
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)

})

# 0. current correct data
scliver <- qread("data/scCircadianLiver-RNAonly.qs")
DefaultAssay(scliver) <- "RNA"

load("outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/scLiver_full_infer_scRhythm_phase.Rdata")

# 1. helper
wrap_phase <- function(x) {
  ((as.numeric(x) %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi)
}

# 2. celltype order and ZT colors
celltype_levels <- c(
  "Hep.PV",
  "Hep.CV",
  "Kupffer cells",
  "Fibroblasts",
  "Endothelial",
  "Lymphocytes",
  "Cholangiocytes"
)

zt6_pal <- c(
  "ZT2"  = "#D97B93",
  "ZT6"  = "#F08A72",
  "ZT10" = "#F3B36A",
  "ZT14" = "#A9D17A",
  "ZT18" = "#7FC4A5",
  "ZT22" = "#7E79BF"
)

# 3. build plotting dataframe
theta_pred_vec <- as.numeric(res_phase_global$theta_pred)
names(theta_pred_vec) <- res_phase_global$cell

cell_phase_df2 <- scliver@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    ZT_raw = as.character(ZT),
    ZT_num = readr::parse_number(ZT_raw),
    ZT_num = ((ZT_num %% 24) + 24) %% 24,
    theta_pred = theta_pred_vec[cell]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(celltype),
    celltype %in% celltype_levels,
    !is.na(theta_pred),
    ZT_num %in% c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    x = cos(theta_pred),
    y = sin(theta_pred),
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = celltype_levels),
    ZT_bin = factor(
      paste0("ZT", ZT_num),
      levels = c("ZT2", "ZT6", "ZT10", "ZT14", "ZT18", "ZT22")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(x), !is.na(y), !is.na(ZT_bin))

# optional count table
celltype_count_df <- cell_phase_df2 %>%
  dplyr::count(celltype, name = "n_cells")

# 4. circle and axis guides
circle_df <- tibble::tibble(
  t = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 500),
  x = cos(t),
  y = sin(t)
)

axis_df <- tibble::tibble(
  x = c(1.14, 0, -1.14, 0),
  y = c(0, 1.14, 0, -1.14),
  lab = c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2")
)

# 5. save dir
out_dir <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/cell_phase_circle_by_celltype_ZT"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

readr::write_tsv(
  celltype_count_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "cell_count_by_celltype.tsv")
)

readr::write_tsv(
  cell_phase_df2,
  file.path(out_dir, "cell_phase_circle_input.tsv")
)

# 6. one plot per celltype, colored by ZT
for (ct_use in celltype_levels) {
  
  message("Plotting: ", ct_use)
  
  df_plot <- cell_phase_df2 %>%
    dplyr::filter(celltype == ct_use)
  
  if (nrow(df_plot) == 0) next
  
  n_cell_now <- nrow(df_plot)
  
  p_ct <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_path(
      data = circle_df,
      aes(x = x, y = y),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "grey45",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey78", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey78", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = ZT_bin),
      size = 8,
      alpha = 0.4
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = zt6_pal,
      drop = FALSE,
      name = NULL
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = axis_df$x, y = axis_df$y, label = axis_df$lab,
      size = 5.0, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "segment",
      x = -1.00, y = -1.12, xend = -0.60, yend = -1.12,
      linewidth = 0.55,
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.12, "inches"))
    ) +
    annotate(
      "segment",
      x = -1.00, y = -1.12, xend = -1.00, yend = -0.72,
      linewidth = 0.55,
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.12, "inches"))
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = -0.56, y = -1.24,
      label = "Cos(φ)",
      size = 5.4, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = -1.16, y = -0.66,
      label = "Sin(φ)",
      angle = 90,
      size = 5.4, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    coord_equal(
      xlim = c(-1.28, 1.18),
      ylim = c(-1.28, 1.18),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Cell phase distribution",
      subtitle = paste0(ct_use, " (n = ", n_cell_now, ")"),
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.margin = margin(20, 30, 30, 35)
    )
  
  print(p_ct)
  
  file_tag <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", ct_use)
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_tag, "_cell_phase_circle_by_ZT.pdf")),
    p_ct,
    width = 4.5,
    height = 3.5
  )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_tag, "_cell_phase_circle_by_ZT.png")),
    p_ct,
    width = 4.5,
    height = 3.5,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```

#gene panel
```{r}
# core clock phase polar panels for 7 celltypes
rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(qs)
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(readr)
})

# 0. current correct data
scliver <- qread("data/scCircadianLiver-RNAonly.qs")
DefaultAssay(scliver) <- "RNA"

load("outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/scLiver_full_infer_scRhythm_phase.Rdata")

param_dir <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/per_celltype_param"

param_files <- list.files(
  path = param_dir,
  pattern = "_infer_scRhythm_param\\.Rdata$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

celltype_name_map <- c(
  "Hep PV" = "Hep.PV",
  "Hep CV" = "Hep.CV",
  "Kupffer cells" = "Kupffer cells",
  "Fibroblasts" = "Fibroblasts",
  "Endothelial" = "Endothelial",
  "Lymphocytes" = "Lymphocytes",
  "Cholangiocytes" = "Cholangiocytes"
)

param_long_list <- lapply(param_files, function(f) {
  
  load(f)
  
  celltype_now <- gsub("_infer_scRhythm_param\\.Rdata$", "", basename(f))
  celltype_now <- gsub("_", " ", celltype_now)
  celltype_now <- dplyr::recode(celltype_now, !!!celltype_name_map)
  
  res_param$param_long %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      celltype_source = celltype_now
    )
})

param_long_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(param_long_list)
# 1. core clock genes
core_clock <- c(
  "Arntl", "Clock", "Npas2", "Cry1", "Cry2",
  "Per1", "Per2", "Per3", "Nr1d1", "Nr1d2",
  "Dbp", "Tef", "Nfil3", "Ciart"
)

# 2. fixed 7-celltype colors
celltype_pal_npg <- c(
  "Hep.PV" = "#E84D33",
  "Hep.CV" = "#55B3CF",
  "Kupffer cells" = "#455A8B",
  "Fibroblasts" = "#9ED3C9",
  "Endothelial" = "#13A88E",
  "Lymphocytes" = "#F29C7E",
  "Cholangiocytes" = "#6A78A8"
)

celltype_levels <- c(
  "Hep.PV",
  "Hep.CV",
  "Kupffer cells",
  "Fibroblasts",
  "Endothelial",
  "Lymphocytes",
  "Cholangiocytes"
)

# 4. standardize gene names and keep core clock genes
param_core <- param_long_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene_std = tools::toTitleCase(tolower(gene)),
    celltype = as.character(celltype_source)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    gene_std %in% core_clock,
    celltype %in% celltype_levels
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene = gene_std,
    celltype = celltype,
    Phase = as.numeric(Phase),
    Amplitude = as.numeric(Amplitude),
    FDR = as.numeric(FDR),
    Mean = as.numeric(Mean)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    phase_wrap = ((Phase %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi),
    phase_hour = (phase_wrap / (2 * pi)) * 24,
    sig_flag = FDR < 0.05,
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = celltype_levels)
  )

# 5. keep genes with at least 2 celltypes available
core_keep <- param_core %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_ct = sum(!is.na(Phase)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_ct >= 2) %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene)

core_long2 <- param_core %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% core_keep)

# 6. gene order: by Hep.PV phase if available, otherwise overall mean phase
gene_order <- core_long2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(celltype == "Hep.PV") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(phase_hour) %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene)

gene_order_fallback <- core_long2 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_phase = mean(phase_hour, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(mean_phase) %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene)

gene_order <- unique(c(gene_order, gene_order_fallback))

core_long2$gene <- factor(core_long2$gene, levels = gene_order)

# 7. plotting function: one gene one polar panel with 7 celltypes
plot_core_gene_panel <- function(gene_use) {
  
  df_sub <- core_long2 %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene == gene_use) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      point_x = phase_wrap,
      point_y = 0.92
    )
  
  # light jitter to reduce overlap when phases are close
  if (nrow(df_sub) > 1) {
    df_sub <- df_sub %>%
      dplyr::arrange(celltype) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        point_x = point_x + seq(-0.06, 0.06, length.out = n())
      )
  }
  
  circle_df <- tibble::tibble(
    theta = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 400),
    r = 0.92
  )
  
  label_df <- tibble::tibble(
    theta = c(0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2),
    r = c(1.06, 1.06, 1.06, 1.06),
    lab = c("0", "6", "12", "18")
  )
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = df_sub,
      aes(x = point_x, y = point_y, fill = celltype),
      shape = 21,
      size = 5.8,
      stroke = 0.20,
      color = "black",
      alpha = 0.75
    ) +
    geom_path(
      data = circle_df,
      aes(x = theta, y = r),
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.50
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = label_df,
      aes(x = theta, y = r, label = lab),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 3.2,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_pal_npg, drop = FALSE) +
    coord_polar(theta = "x", start = 0, direction = 1, clip = "off") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 2 * pi),
      breaks = NULL,
      labels = NULL
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.10)) +
    labs(title = gene_use) +
    theme_void(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 11),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    )
}

# 8. batch generate panels
plot_list <- lapply(levels(core_long2$gene), plot_core_gene_panel)

# 9. combine panels
ncol_use <- 7
p_core_clock <- patchwork::wrap_plots(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = ncol_use)

# 10. separate legend
legend_df <- tibble::tibble(
  x = seq_along(celltype_levels),
  y = 1,
  celltype = factor(celltype_levels, levels = celltype_levels)
)

p_legend <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = legend_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y, fill = celltype),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5.6,
    stroke = 0.20,
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_pal_npg, drop = FALSE) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = seq_along(celltype_levels),
    y = 0.72,
    label = celltype_levels,
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(0.5, length(celltype_levels) + 0.5),
    ylim = c(0.5, 1.25),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_final <- p_core_clock / p_legend + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(12, 1.8))

print(p_final)

# 11. save
out_dir <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/core_clock_polar_7celltypes"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

readr::write_tsv(
  core_long2,
  file.path(out_dir, "core_clock_polar_input_7celltypes.tsv")
)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "core_clock_phase_similarity_panels_7celltypes.pdf"),
  p_final,
  width = 8.8,
  height = 3.8
)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "core_clock_phase_similarity_panels_7celltypes.png"),
  p_final,
  width = 8.8,
  height = 3.8,
  dpi = 300
)
```
