```{r}
# phase cumulative plot using OVR-M3 genes only, 7 celltypes together
rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggpubr)

})

# =========================================================
# 0. current paths
# =========================================================
ovr_file  <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/OVR_group1_group2/Liver_group1_vs_group2_all.tsv"
param_dir <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/per_celltype_param"
plot_dir  <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/PHASE_CUMULATIVE_OVR_M3"
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# =========================================================
# 1. fixed 7-celltype colors
# =========================================================
celltype_pal_npg <- c(
  "Hep.PV" = "#E84D33",
  "Hep.CV" = "#55B3CF",
  "Kupffer cells" = "#455A8B",
  "Fibroblasts" = "#9ED3C9",
  "Endothelial" = "#13A88E",
  "Lymphocytes" = "#F29C7E",
  "Cholangiocytes" = "#6A78A8"
)

celltype_levels <- c(
  "Hep.PV",
  "Hep.CV",
  "Kupffer cells",
  "Fibroblasts",
  "Endothelial",
  "Lymphocytes",
  "Cholangiocytes"
)

# =========================================================
# 2. read OVR results and keep M3 genes only
# =========================================================
ovr_all <- readr::read_tsv(
  ovr_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TargetCellType = as.character(TargetCellType),
    gene = as.character(gene)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(TargetCellType),
    !is.na(gene),
    gene != "",
    Module3_flag
  )

m3_gene_table <- ovr_all %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, TargetCellType) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TargetCellType = factor(TargetCellType, levels = celltype_levels)
  )

readr::write_tsv(
  m3_gene_table,
  file.path(plot_dir, "OVR_M3_gene_table.tsv")
)

m3_genes_union <- unique(m3_gene_table$gene)

readr::write_tsv(
  tibble::tibble(gene = m3_genes_union),
  file.path(plot_dir, "OVR_M3_gene_union.tsv")
)

# =========================================================
# 3. read all per-celltype param files
# =========================================================
param_files <- list.files(
  path = param_dir,
  pattern = "_infer_scRhythm_param\\.Rdata$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

celltype_name_map <- c(
  "Hep PV" = "Hep.PV",
  "Hep CV" = "Hep.CV",
  "Kupffer cells" = "Kupffer cells",
  "Fibroblasts" = "Fibroblasts",
  "Endothelial" = "Endothelial",
  "Lymphocytes" = "Lymphocytes",
  "Cholangiocytes" = "Cholangiocytes"
)

param_long_list <- lapply(param_files, function(f) {
  
  load(f)   # loads res_param
  
  celltype_now <- gsub("_infer_scRhythm_param\\.Rdata$", "", basename(f))
  celltype_now <- gsub("_", " ", celltype_now)
  celltype_now <- dplyr::recode(celltype_now, !!!celltype_name_map)
  
  res_param$param_long %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      celltype = celltype_now
    )
})

param_long_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(param_long_list) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    celltype %in% celltype_levels
  )

readr::write_tsv(
  param_long_all,
  file.path(plot_dir, "param_long_all_celltypes.tsv")
)

# =========================================================
# 4. keep only OVR-M3 genes
# =========================================================
gene_all <- param_long_all %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene = as.character(gene),
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = celltype_levels),
    Phase_rad = as.numeric(Phase),
    FDR = as.numeric(FDR),
    Amplitude = as.numeric(Amplitude),
    Mean = as.numeric(Mean)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    gene %in% m3_genes_union
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    phase_hour = (((Phase_rad %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi)) / (2 * pi) * 24
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(phase_hour),
    !is.na(celltype)
  )

readr::write_tsv(
  gene_all,
  file.path(plot_dir, "Phase_input_OVR_M3_only.tsv")
)

print(table(gene_all$celltype, useNA = "ifany"))

# =========================================================
# 5. helper
#    cumulative count of genes with phase >= threshold
# =========================================================
make_phase_cumulative_df_multi <- function(df_long, thresholds) {
  
  out_list <- lapply(levels(df_long$celltype), function(ct_use) {
    
    values_use <- df_long$phase_hour[df_long$celltype == ct_use]
    
    tibble::tibble(
      Phase_hour = thresholds,
      Cumulative.Count = sapply(thresholds, function(thresh) {
        sum(values_use >= thresh, na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      celltype = ct_use
    )
  })
  
  dplyr::bind_rows(out_list) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      celltype = factor(celltype, levels = celltype_levels),
      log10.Cumulative.Count = log10(Cumulative.Count + 1)
    )
}

# =========================================================
# 6. cumulative plot for OVR-M3 genes only
# =========================================================
phase_thresholds <- seq(0, 24, by = 1)

cum_all <- make_phase_cumulative_df_multi(
  df_long = gene_all,
  thresholds = phase_thresholds
)

readr::write_tsv(
  cum_all,
  file.path(plot_dir, "Phase_cumulative_OVR_M3_all_7celltypes.tsv")
)

p_all <- ggpubr::ggline(
  cum_all,
  x = "Phase_hour",
  y = "log10.Cumulative.Count",
  color = "celltype",
  plot_type = "l",
  palette = celltype_pal_npg,
  size = 2,
  ylab = "Log10 Cumulative Number of Genes",
  xlab = "Phase (hour)",
  numeric.x.axis = TRUE
) +
  ggtitle("SRB_OVR marker phase cumulative distribution")+
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24),
    limits = c(0, 24)
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_all)

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "Phase_OVR_M3_all_7celltypes.pdf"),
  p_all,
  width = 7.5,
  height = 5.2
)

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "Phase_OVR_M3_all_7celltypes.png"),
  p_all,
  width = 7.5,
  height = 5.2,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================

  dplyr::transmute(
    gene = as.character(gene),
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = celltype_levels),
    Phase_rad = as.numeric(Phase),

# =========================================================
# 5. helper
#    cumulative count of genes with phase >= threshold
# =========================================================
make_phase_cumulative_df_one <- function(values_use, celltype_use, thresholds) {
  
  tibble::tibble(
    Phase_hour = thresholds,
    Cumulative.Count = sapply(thresholds, function(thresh) {
      sum(values_use >= thresh, na.rm = TRUE)
    }),
    celltype = celltype_use
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      log10.Cumulative.Count = log10(Cumulative.Count + 1)
    )
}

# =========================================================
# 6. one plot per celltype
# =========================================================
phase_thresholds <- seq(0, 24, by = 1)

for (ct_use in celltype_levels) {
  
  message("Plotting: ", ct_use)
  
  gene_sub <- gene_all %>%
    dplyr::filter(celltype == ct_use)
  
  if (nrow(gene_sub) == 0) next
  
  cum_df <- make_phase_cumulative_df_one(
    values_use = gene_sub$phase_hour,
    celltype_use = ct_use,
    thresholds = phase_thresholds
  )
  
  readr::write_tsv(
    cum_df,
    file.path(
      plot_dir,
      paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", ct_use), "_Phase_cumulative.tsv")
    )
  )
  
  p_ct <- ggpubr::ggline(
  cum_df,
  x = "Phase_hour",
  y = "log10.Cumulative.Count",
  color = "celltype",
  plot_type = "l",
  palette = celltype_pal_npg[ct_use],
  size = 2,
  ylab = "Log10 Cumulative Number of Genes",
  xlab = "Phase (hour)",
  numeric.x.axis = TRUE
) +
  ggtitle("SRB_OVR marker phase cumulative distribution")+
  labs(subtitle = ct_use) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24),
    limits = c(0, 24)
  ) +
scale_y_continuous(
  breaks = seq(1.5, 3.3, by = 0.5)
) +
coord_cartesian(ylim = c(1.5, 3.3)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 20),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
  print(p_ct)
  
  file_tag <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", ct_use)
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0(file_tag, "_Phase_OVR_M3.pdf")),
    p_ct,
    width = 6,
    height = 4.5
  )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0(file_tag, "_Phase_OVR_M3.png")),
```

```{r}
# amplitude cumulative plot using OVR-M3 genes only, 7 celltypes together
rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)

# =========================================================
# 0. current paths
# =========================================================
ovr_file  <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/OVR_group1_group2/Liver_group1_vs_group2_all.tsv"
param_dir <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/per_celltype_param"
plot_dir  <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/AMP_CUMULATIVE_OVR_M3"
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# =========================================================
# 1. fixed 7-celltype colors
# =========================================================
celltype_pal_npg <- c(
  "Hep.PV" = "#E84D33",
  "Hep.CV" = "#55B3CF",
  "Kupffer cells" = "#455A8B",
  "Fibroblasts" = "#9ED3C9",
  "Endothelial" = "#13A88E",
  "Lymphocytes" = "#F29C7E",
  "Cholangiocytes" = "#6A78A8"
)

celltype_levels <- c(
  "Hep.PV",
  "Hep.CV",
  "Kupffer cells",
  "Fibroblasts",
  "Endothelial",
  "Lymphocytes",
  "Cholangiocytes"
)

# =========================================================
# 2. read OVR results and keep M3 genes only
# =========================================================
ovr_all <- readr::read_tsv(
  ovr_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TargetCellType = as.character(TargetCellType),
    gene = as.character(gene)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(TargetCellType),
    !is.na(gene),
    gene != "",
    Module3_flag
  )

m3_gene_table <- ovr_all %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, TargetCellType) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TargetCellType = factor(TargetCellType, levels = celltype_levels)
  )

readr::write_tsv(
  m3_gene_table,
  file.path(plot_dir, "OVR_M3_gene_table.tsv")
)

m3_genes_union <- unique(m3_gene_table$gene)

readr::write_tsv(
  tibble::tibble(gene = m3_genes_union),
  file.path(plot_dir, "OVR_M3_gene_union.tsv")
)

# =========================================================
# 3. read all current per-celltype param files
# =========================================================
param_files <- list.files(
  path = param_dir,
  pattern = "_infer_scRhythm_param\\.Rdata$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

celltype_name_map <- c(
  "Hep PV" = "Hep.PV",
  "Hep CV" = "Hep.CV",
  "Kupffer cells" = "Kupffer cells",
  "Fibroblasts" = "Fibroblasts",
  "Endothelial" = "Endothelial",
  "Lymphocytes" = "Lymphocytes",
  "Cholangiocytes" = "Cholangiocytes"
)

param_long_list <- lapply(param_files, function(f) {
  
  load(f)   # loads res_param
  
  celltype_now <- gsub("_infer_scRhythm_param\\.Rdata$", "", basename(f))
  celltype_now <- gsub("_", " ", celltype_now)
  celltype_now <- dplyr::recode(celltype_now, !!!celltype_name_map)
  
  res_param$param_long %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      celltype = celltype_now
    )
})

param_long_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(param_long_list) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    celltype %in% celltype_levels
  )

readr::write_tsv(
  param_long_all,
  file.path(plot_dir, "param_long_all_celltypes.tsv")
)

# =========================================================
# 4. keep only OVR-M3 genes and extract amplitude
# =========================================================
gene_all <- param_long_all %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene = as.character(gene),
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = celltype_levels),
    Amplitude = as.numeric(Amplitude),
    FDR = as.numeric(FDR),
    Phase = as.numeric(Phase),
    Mean = as.numeric(Mean)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    gene %in% m3_genes_union,
    is.finite(Amplitude),
    !is.na(celltype)
  )

readr::write_tsv(
  gene_all,
  file.path(plot_dir, "Amp_input_OVR_M3_only.tsv")
)

print(table(gene_all$celltype, useNA = "ifany"))

# =========================================================
# 5. helper
#    cumulative count of genes with amplitude >= threshold
# =========================================================
make_amp_cumulative_df_multi <- function(df_long, step = 0.01, x_cap = 4) {
  
  thresholds <- seq(0, x_cap, by = step)
  
  out_list <- lapply(levels(df_long$celltype), function(ct_use) {
    
    values_use <- df_long$Amplitude[df_long$celltype == ct_use]
    
    tibble::tibble(
      Amplitude = thresholds,
      Cumulative.Count = sapply(thresholds, function(thresh) {
        sum(values_use >= thresh, na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      celltype = ct_use
    )
  })
  
  dplyr::bind_rows(out_list) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      celltype = factor(celltype, levels = celltype_levels),
      Cumulative.Count = dplyr::if_else(Amplitude == 0, 0, Cumulative.Count),
      log10.Cumulative.Count = suppressWarnings(log10(Cumulative.Count))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(log10.Cumulative.Count),
      log10.Cumulative.Count > 0
    )
}

# =========================================================
# 6. cumulative plot for OVR-M3 genes only
# =========================================================
cum_all <- make_amp_cumulative_df_multi(
  df_long = gene_all,
  step = 0.01,
  x_cap = 4
)

readr::write_tsv(
  cum_all,
  file.path(plot_dir, "Amp_cumulative_OVR_M3_all_7celltypes.tsv")
)

p_all <- ggpubr::ggline(
  cum_all,
  x = "Amplitude",
  y = "log10.Cumulative.Count",
  color = "celltype",
  plot_type = "l",
  palette = celltype_pal_npg,
  size = 2,
  ylab = "Log10 Number of Genes",
  xlab = "Amplitude",
  numeric.x.axis = TRUE
) +
  ggtitle("Amplitude distribution of SRB_OVR-defined rhythmic markers") +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0.25,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 4)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 1, 2, 3, 4),
    labels = c("0", "0.25", "1", "2", "3", "4")
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_all)

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "Amp_OVR_M3_all_7celltypes.pdf"),
  p_all,
  width = 8,
  height = 5.2
)

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "Amp_OVR_M3_all_7celltypes.png"),
  p_all,
  width = 8,
  height = 5.2,
  dpi = 300
)
```

#patch
```{r}
# Combined phase + amplitude cumulative plots using SRB_OVR-defined
# cell-type-specific rhythmic markers
# Output: one phase + amplitude panel per cell type

rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(patchwork)
})

# =========================================================
# 0. paths
# =========================================================
ovr_file  <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/OVR_group1_group2/Liver_group1_vs_group2_all.tsv"
param_dir <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/per_celltype_param"
plot_dir  <- "outputs/liver/scLiver_global_phase/PHASE_AMP_CUMULATIVE_SRB_OVR_MARKERS"
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# =========================================================
# 1. colors and order
# =========================================================
celltype_pal_npg <- c(
  "Hep.PV" = "#E84D33",
  "Hep.CV" = "#55B3CF",
  "Kupffer cells" = "#455A8B",
  "Fibroblasts" = "#9ED3C9",
  "Endothelial" = "#13A88E",
  "Lymphocytes" = "#F29C7E",
  "Cholangiocytes" = "#6A78A8"
)

celltype_levels <- c(
  "Hep.PV",
  "Hep.CV",
  "Kupffer cells",
  "Fibroblasts",
  "Endothelial",
  "Lymphocytes",
  "Cholangiocytes"
)

# =========================================================
# 2. read OVR results and keep SRB_OVR-defined markers
#    Module3_flag is the internal implementation flag for
#    target-rhythmic / Rest-nonrhythmic genes
# =========================================================
ovr_all <- readr::read_tsv(
  ovr_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TargetCellType = as.character(TargetCellType),
    gene = as.character(gene)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(TargetCellType),
    !is.na(gene),
    gene != "",
    Module3_flag
  )

srb_ovr_marker_table <- ovr_all %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, TargetCellType) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TargetCellType = factor(TargetCellType, levels = celltype_levels)
  )

readr::write_tsv(
  srb_ovr_marker_table,
  file.path(plot_dir, "SRB_OVR_marker_gene_table.tsv")
)

srb_ovr_marker_union <- unique(srb_ovr_marker_table$gene)

readr::write_tsv(
  tibble::tibble(gene = srb_ovr_marker_union),
  file.path(plot_dir, "SRB_OVR_marker_gene_union.tsv")
)

# =========================================================
# 3. read per-celltype parameter files
# =========================================================
param_files <- list.files(
  path = param_dir,
  pattern = "_infer_scRhythm_param\\.Rdata$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

celltype_name_map <- c(
  "Hep PV" = "Hep.PV",
  "Hep CV" = "Hep.CV",
  "Kupffer cells" = "Kupffer cells",
  "Fibroblasts" = "Fibroblasts",
  "Endothelial" = "Endothelial",
  "Lymphocytes" = "Lymphocytes",
  "Cholangiocytes" = "Cholangiocytes"
)

param_long_list <- lapply(param_files, function(f) {
  
  load(f)
  
  celltype_now <- gsub("_infer_scRhythm_param\\.Rdata$", "", basename(f))
  celltype_now <- gsub("_", " ", celltype_now)
  celltype_now <- dplyr::recode(celltype_now, !!!celltype_name_map)
  
  res_param$param_long %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      celltype = celltype_now
    )
})

param_long_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(param_long_list) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    celltype %in% celltype_levels
  )

readr::write_tsv(
  param_long_all,
  file.path(plot_dir, "param_long_all_celltypes.tsv")
)

# =========================================================
# 4. keep only SRB_OVR-defined markers
# =========================================================
gene_all <- param_long_all %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene = as.character(gene),
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = celltype_levels),
    Phase_rad = as.numeric(Phase),
    Amplitude = as.numeric(Amplitude),
    FDR = as.numeric(FDR),
    Mean = as.numeric(Mean)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    gene %in% srb_ovr_marker_union,
    is.finite(Phase_rad),
    is.finite(Amplitude),
    !is.na(celltype)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    phase_hour = (((Phase_rad %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi)) / (2 * pi) * 24
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(phase_hour)
  )

readr::write_tsv(
  gene_all,
  file.path(plot_dir, "Phase_Amp_input_SRB_OVR_markers.tsv")
)

print(table(gene_all$celltype, useNA = "ifany"))

# =========================================================
# 5. cumulative phase data
# =========================================================
phase_thresholds <- seq(0, 24, by = 1)

phase_cum_all <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  celltype = factor(celltype_levels, levels = celltype_levels),
  Phase_hour = phase_thresholds
) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Cumulative.Count = sum(
      gene_all$phase_hour[
        as.character(gene_all$celltype) == as.character(celltype)
      ] >= Phase_hour,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    log10.Cumulative.Count = log10(Cumulative.Count + 1)
  )

readr::write_tsv(
  phase_cum_all,
  file.path(plot_dir, "Phase_cumulative_SRB_OVR_markers_all_7celltypes.tsv")
)

# =========================================================
# 6. cumulative amplitude data
# =========================================================
amp_thresholds <- seq(0, 4, by = 0.01)

amp_cum_all <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  celltype = factor(celltype_levels, levels = celltype_levels),
  Amplitude = amp_thresholds
) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Cumulative.Count = sum(
      gene_all$Amplitude[
        as.character(gene_all$celltype) == as.character(celltype)
      ] >= Amplitude,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Cumulative.Count = dplyr::case_when(
      Amplitude == 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ Cumulative.Count
    ),
    log10.Cumulative.Count = suppressWarnings(log10(Cumulative.Count))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(log10.Cumulative.Count),
    log10.Cumulative.Count > 0
  )

readr::write_tsv(
  amp_cum_all,
  file.path(plot_dir, "Amp_cumulative_SRB_OVR_markers_all_7celltypes.tsv")
)

# =========================================================
# 7. plotting functions
# =========================================================
plot_phase_one <- function(ct_use) {
  
  df_ct <- phase_cum_all %>%
    dplyr::filter(celltype == ct_use)
  
  ggplot(
    df_ct,
    aes(x = Phase_hour, y = log10.Cumulative.Count)
  ) +
    geom_line(
      color = celltype_pal_npg[[ct_use]],
      linewidth = 1.15
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(0, 8, 16, 24),
      limits = c(0, 24),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(1.5, 3.5, by = 0.5)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(1.5, 3.35)) +
    labs(
      title = ct_use,
      x = "Phase (h)",
      y = "Log10 cumulative\nnumber of genes"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold",
        size = 22
      ),
      axis.title.x = element_text(
        size = 16,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(t = 4)
      ),
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        size = 14,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(r = 3)
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 13,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 13,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.55),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.55),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )
}

plot_amp_one <- function(ct_use) {
  
  df_ct <- amp_cum_all %>%
    dplyr::filter(celltype == ct_use)
  
  ggplot(
    df_ct,
    aes(x = Amplitude, y = log10.Cumulative.Count)
  ) +
    geom_line(
      color = celltype_pal_npg[[ct_use]],
      linewidth = 1.15
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0.25,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "red",
      linewidth = 0.75
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(0, 0.25, 2, 4),
      labels = c("0", "0.25", "2", "4"),
      limits = c(0, 4),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(1.5, 3.5, by = 0.5)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(1.5, 3.35)) +
    labs(
      x = "Amplitude",
      y = "Log10 cumulative\nnumber of genes"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_text(
        size = 16,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(t = 4)
      ),
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        size = 14,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(r = 3)
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 13,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 13,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.55),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.55),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)

}

# =========================================================
# 8. save one phase + amplitude panel per cell type
# =========================================================
for (ct_use in celltype_levels) {
  
  message("Saving phase + amplitude panel: ", ct_use)
  
  p_phase <- plot_phase_one(ct_use)
  p_amp   <- plot_amp_one(ct_use)

  )
}
```

#simdata
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(Matrix)
})

set.seed(1)

## 0. load simulated Seurat object
obj_sim <- readRDS("data/simulate_data_new2.rds")
DefaultAssay(obj_sim) <- "RNA"

count0 <- Seurat::GetAssayData(
  obj_sim,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "counts"
)

meta0 <- obj_sim@meta.data
meta0$cell <- rownames(meta0)

stopifnot(identical(colnames(count0), meta0$cell))

default_mouse <- c(
  "Cdkn1a", "Mmp14", "Clock", "Per2", "Per1", "Bmal1", "Arntl", "Por",
  "Wee1", "Slc16a1", "Per3", "Nr1d1", "Dbp", "Npas2", "Tsc22d3",
  "Tef", "Hlf", "Nfil3", "Usp2", "Nr1d2", "Fmo2", "Tspan4",
  "Leo1", "Stk35", "Lonrf3", "Gramd4", "Coq10b", "Dtx4"
)

## 1. select genes
seed_keep <- intersect(default_mouse, rownames(count0))

target_n_gene <- 1000
gene_pool <- setdiff(rownames(count0), seed_keep)

gene_extra <- sample(
  gene_pool,
  size = target_n_gene - length(seed_keep),
  replace = FALSE
)

genes_use <- c(seed_keep, gene_extra)

## 2. stratified cell sampling by celltype
target_n_cell_per_celltype <- 1000

cell_idx_list <- split(seq_len(ncol(count0)), meta0$celltype)

cell_idx_use <- unlist(lapply(cell_idx_list, function(idx) {
  sample(idx, min(length(idx), target_n_cell_per_celltype), replace = FALSE)
}))

cell_idx_use <- sort(cell_idx_use)

count_use <- count0[genes_use, cell_idx_use, drop = FALSE]
meta_use0 <- meta0[cell_idx_use, , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(colnames(count_use), meta_use0$cell))

## 3. build balanced A/B condition within celltype x ZT
set.seed(2)

zt_use <- meta_use0$ZT_sym
celltype_use <- as.character(meta_use0$celltype)

condition_use <- rep(NA_character_, length(zt_use))

block_list <- split(
  seq_along(zt_use),
  interaction(celltype_use, zt_use, drop = TRUE)
)

for (idx in block_list) {
  condition_use[idx] <- sample(rep(c("A", "B"), length.out = length(idx)))
}

stopifnot(!any(is.na(condition_use)))

## 4. anonymize cells and create metadata
cell_new <- paste0("Cell", sprintf("%05d", seq_len(ncol(count_use))))
colnames(count_use) <- cell_new

meta_use <- data.frame(
  cell = cell_new,
  ZT = as.numeric(meta_use0$ZT_sym),
  celltype = as.character(meta_use0$celltype),
  condition = condition_use,
  T_true = as.numeric(meta_use0$t_true),
  Theta_true = as.numeric(meta_use0$theta_rad),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

rownames(meta_use) <- meta_use$cell

stopifnot(identical(colnames(count_use), meta_use$cell))

## 5. hidden module-effect injection
## This modifies selected genes so all 8 rhythm-state modules are represented.
set.seed(3)

genes_available <- rownames(count_use)
seed_genes <- intersect(default_mouse, genes_available)
nonseed_genes <- setdiff(genes_available, seed_genes)

genes_per_module <- 35

module_genes <- sample(
  nonseed_genes,
  size = genes_per_module * 8,
  replace = FALSE
)

module_id <- rep(0:7, each = genes_per_module)
names(module_id) <- module_genes

## helper functions
wrap24 <- function(x) {
  ((x %% 24) + 24) %% 24
}

simulate_module_counts <- function(
    module,
    t_vec,
    condition_vec,
    lib_vec,
    base_expr,
    phi_A,
    amp_A,
    dropout_strength = 0.6
) {
  omega <- 2 * pi / 24
  n <- length(t_vec)

  amp_B <- amp_A
  phi_B <- phi_A

  rhythmic_A <- TRUE
  rhythmic_B <- TRUE

  if (module == 0) {
    rhythmic_A <- FALSE
    rhythmic_B <- FALSE
  }

  if (module == 2) {
    rhythmic_A <- FALSE
    rhythmic_B <- TRUE
  }

  if (module == 3) {
    rhythmic_A <- TRUE
    rhythmic_B <- FALSE
  }

  if (module == 4) {
    amp_B <- amp_A * 2.5
  }

  if (module == 5) {
    amp_B <- amp_A * 0.25
  }

  if (module == 6) {
    phi_B <- wrap24(phi_A - 4)
  }

  if (module == 7) {
    phi_B <- wrap24(phi_A + 4)
  }

  mu <- rep(base_expr, n)

  idx_A <- condition_vec == "A"
  idx_B <- condition_vec == "B"

  if (any(idx_A)) {
    if (rhythmic_A) {
      mu[idx_A] <- base_expr + amp_A * cos(omega * (t_vec[idx_A] - phi_A))
    } else {
      mu[idx_A] <- base_expr
    }
  }

  if (any(idx_B)) {
    if (rhythmic_B) {
      mu[idx_B] <- base_expr + amp_B * cos(omega * (t_vec[idx_B] - phi_B))
    } else {
      mu[idx_B] <- base_expr
    }
  }

  mu <- pmax(mu, 0.001)

  ## convert to count scale
  lib_scaled <- lib_vec / median(lib_vec)
  lambda <- pmax(0.001, mu * lib_scaled)

  y <- stats::rpois(n, lambda = lambda)

  ## mild dropout
  drop_prob <- stats::plogis(0.8 - dropout_strength * log(lambda + 1e-8))
  y[stats::runif(n) < drop_prob] <- 0L

  as.numeric(y)
}

## use original library sizes from selected count matrix
lib_vec <- Matrix::colSums(count_use)
lib_vec <- pmax(as.numeric(lib_vec), 1)

t_vec <- meta_use$T_true
condition_vec <- meta_use$condition

## overwrite selected module genes
count_mod <- count_use

for (g in module_genes) {
  m <- module_id[g]

  base_expr <- runif(1, 1.5, 4.0)
  phi_A <- runif(1, 0, 24)

  if (m == 0) {
    amp_A <- 0
  } else {
    amp_A <- runif(1, 1.2, 2.2)
  }

  y_new <- simulate_module_counts(
    module = m,
    t_vec = t_vec,
    condition_vec = condition_vec,
    lib_vec = lib_vec,
    base_expr = base_expr,
    phi_A = phi_A,
    amp_A = amp_A
  )

  count_mod[g, ] <- y_new
}

count_use <- methods::as(count_mod, "dgCMatrix")

## 6. final example object: Count + meta only
srb_example_data <- list(
  Count = count_use,
  meta = meta_use
)

## 7. quick checks
str(srb_example_data, max.level = 1)
dim(srb_example_data$Count)

head(srb_example_data$meta)

table(srb_example_data$meta$celltype)
table(srb_example_data$meta$condition)
table(srb_example_data$meta$ZT)

table(srb_example_data$meta$celltype, srb_example_data$meta$condition)
table(srb_example_data$meta$ZT, srb_example_data$meta$condition)

summary(srb_example_data$meta$T_true)
summary(srb_example_data$meta$Theta_true)

sum(default_mouse %in% rownames(srb_example_data$Count))

## local-only check; do not save this into srb_example_data
table(module_id)

## 8. save
saveRDS(
  srb_example_data,
  file = "outputs/liver/srb_example_data.rds"
)
```

# GHI 新版功能通路（20261019）

本节直接衔接新版 CV→PV module 结果；不重新运行上游推断或富集。H 为 M6 胆固醇合成，I 为 M7 黏附连接/细胞外基质；热图仍按 CV、PV 分别绘制。旧章节保留供对照。

本节结果另存至 `outputs/liver/GHI_inline_20261019.yOb6m4`，不覆盖旧图。图型、颜色、字号和平滑沿用旧代码；H/I 热图已修正为全 RNA 总 counts 归一化，单独另存至 GHI_heatmap_fullRNA_20261019.UnxFTP，不覆盖旧热图；PDF 显式使用 Cairo + sans，避免继承当前会话的 PDF CID 字体设置。

G 仅使用 Reactome 结果：功能条目来自原始 FDR 显著结果，横轴仍为原始 P 值；完整 Reactome Top 5 复原版为可选块。相位密度的统计单位为基因；热图逐组 z-score 不表示绝对振幅差异。当前 sample_by=NULL 的结果不等于独立动物重复验证。

末尾两段 MAGIC 曲线默认 eval=FALSE：仅在现有 Python 含 numpy/magic 后执行，不替换拟合方法；阴影为 ±1 拟合标准误。

# H_Cholesterol_heatmap
```{r GHI_inline_H_Cholesterol_heatmap}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(mgcv)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)

  library(Matrix)

  library(furrr)

})

# 0. load data
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_object_celltype_use.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_infer_scRhythm_phase.Rdata")

DefaultAssay(obj_use) <- "RNA"
module_result <- res2_module$module_result %>%
  dplyr::rename(q_Hep.CV = FDR_Hep.CV, q_Hep.PV = FDR_Hep.PV,
                A_Hep.CV = Amplitude_Hep.CV, A_Hep.PV = Amplitude_Hep.PV,
                phi_Hep.CV = Phase_Hep.CV, phi_Hep.PV = Phase_Hep.PV)

expr_mat <- GetAssayData(obj_use, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")

# 1. Cholesterol biosynthesis genes
focus_genes_final <- readr::read_tsv(
  "outputs/liver/GHI_inline_20261019.yOb6m4/H_functional_heatmap_genes.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE
)$gene

# 2. metadata
wrap_phase <- function(x) {
  ((as.numeric(x) %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi)
}

theta_pred_vec <- as.numeric(res_phase_liver$theta_pred)
names(theta_pred_vec) <- res_phase_liver$cell
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(res_phase_liver$cell), all(colnames(obj_use) %in% names(theta_pred_vec)))

cell_meta <- obj_use@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    theta_pred = theta_pred_vec[cell],
    theta_wrap = wrap_phase(theta_pred)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    celltype %in% c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"),
    is.finite(theta_wrap)
  )

rownames(cell_meta) <- cell_meta$cell

# 3. gene annotation + fixed CV phase ordering
gene_meta2 <- module_result %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene = gene,
    module_id = as.character(module_map),
    phase_ref_cv = as.numeric(phi_Hep.CV)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    gene %in% focus_genes_final,
    module_id == "6",
    gene %in% rownames(expr_mat)

    phase_wrap_cv = wrap_phase(phase_ref_cv)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(phase_wrap_cv, gene)

gene_order <- gene_meta2$gene

# 4. helper functions
row_zscore <- function(mat) {
  z <- t(apply(mat, 1, function(x) {
    sdx <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    out <- (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sdx
    out[!is.finite(out)] <- 0
    out
  }))
  z <- as.matrix(z)
  rownames(z) <- rownames(mat)
  colnames(z) <- colnames(mat)
  z[!is.finite(z)] <- 0
  z
}

make_phase_cat_from_theta <- function(theta_grid) {
  zt_grid <- round((theta_grid / (2 * pi) * 24) %% 24, 10)
  phase_cat <- floor((zt_grid - 2) / 4) * 4 + 2
  phase_cat <- phase_cat %% 24
  factor(phase_cat, levels = c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22))
}

cyclic_smooth_matrix <- function(expr_sub, theta_sub, k = 8, n_grid = 60) {
  expr_sub <- as.matrix(expr_sub)
  theta_use <- wrap_phase(theta_sub)
  theta_grid <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_grid + 1)[-1]
  
  pred_list <- furrr::future_map(
    seq_len(nrow(expr_sub)),
    function(i) {
      dat <- data.frame(
        expr = as.numeric(expr_sub[i, ]),
        theta = theta_use
      )
      
      fit <- try(
        mgcv::gam(
          expr ~ s(theta, bs = "cc", k = k),
          data = dat,
          method = "REML",
          knots = list(theta = c(0, 2 * pi))
        ),
        silent = TRUE
      )
      
      pred <- rep(NA_real_, length(theta_grid))
      pred[seq_along(pred)] <- tryCatch(
        predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(theta = theta_grid)),
        error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(theta_grid))
      )
      pred
    },
    .options = furrr::furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
  )
  
  smoothed_mat <- do.call(rbind, pred_list)
  smoothed_mat <- as.matrix(smoothed_mat)
  
  rownames(smoothed_mat) <- rownames(expr_sub)
  colnames(smoothed_mat) <- paste0("Theta_", seq_len(ncol(smoothed_mat)))
  
  keep <- complete.cases(smoothed_mat)
  smoothed_mat <- smoothed_mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  
  list(
    mat_raw = smoothed_mat,
    mat_z = row_zscore(smoothed_mat),
    theta_grid = theta_grid,
    keep_genes = rownames(smoothed_mat)
  )
}

build_top_annotation <- function(theta_grid, group_name) {
  phase_cat <- make_phase_cat_from_theta(theta_grid)
  group_cat <- factor(rep(group_name, length(theta_grid)), levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
  
  anno_df <- data.frame(
    phase = phase_cat,
    group = group_cat,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  
  colnames(anno_df) <- c("Cell phase", "Group")
  
  HeatmapAnnotation(
    df = anno_df,
    col = list(
      `Cell phase` = c(
        "2"  = "#000000",
        "6"  = "#000000",
        "10" = "#F5F5F5",
        "14" = "#F5F5F5",
        "18" = "#F5F5F5",
        "22" = "#000000"
      ),
      Group = c(
        "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",
        "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"
      )
    ),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE,
    show_legend = TRUE,
    annotation_legend_param = list(
      `Cell phase` = list(
        title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 18, fontface = "bold"),
        labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 16),
        grid_width = unit(0.5, "cm"),
        grid_height = unit(0.5, "cm")
      ),
      Group = list(
        title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 18, fontface = "bold"),
        labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 16),
        grid_width = unit(0.5, "cm"),
        grid_height = unit(0.5, "cm")
      )
    ),
    simple_anno_size = unit(2, "cm"),
    annotation_height = unit(c(2, 2), "cm"),
    gap = unit(0, "mm"),
    border = FALSE,
    gp = gpar(col = NA, lwd = 0)
  )
}

add_phase_separators <- function(theta_grid, anno_name = "Cell phase", lwd = 1.4) {
  phase_num <- as.character(make_phase_cat_from_theta(theta_grid))
  boundary_idx <- which(phase_num[-1] != phase_num[-length(phase_num)])
  x_pos <- boundary_idx / pmax(length(phase_num), 1)
  
  decorate_annotation(anno_name, {
    for (xline in x_pos) {
      grid::grid.lines(
        x = unit(c(xline, xline), "npc"),
        y = unit(c(0, 1), "npc"),
        gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = lwd)
      )
    }
  })
}

col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(

  colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Blues"))(25)
```

```{r GHI_inline_I_ECM_adhesion_heatmap}
row_zscore <- function(mat) {
  z <- t(apply(mat, 1, function(x) {
    sdx <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    out <- (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sdx
    out[!is.finite(out)] <- 0
    out
  }))
  z <- as.matrix(z)
  rownames(z) <- rownames(mat)
  colnames(z) <- colnames(mat)
  z[!is.finite(z)] <- 0
  z
}

make_phase_cat_from_theta <- function(theta_grid) {
  zt_grid <- round((theta_grid / (2 * pi) * 24) %% 24, 10)
  phase_cat <- floor((zt_grid - 2) / 4) * 4 + 2
  phase_cat <- phase_cat %% 24
  factor(phase_cat, levels = c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22))
}

cyclic_smooth_matrix <- function(expr_sub, theta_sub, k = 8, n_grid = 60) {
  expr_sub <- as.matrix(expr_sub)
  theta_use <- wrap_phase(theta_sub)
  theta_grid <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_grid + 1)[-1]
  
  pred_list <- furrr::future_map(
    seq_len(nrow(expr_sub)),
    function(i) {
      dat <- data.frame(
        expr = as.numeric(expr_sub[i, ]),
        theta = theta_use
      )
      
      fit <- try(
        mgcv::gam(
          expr ~ s(theta, bs = "cc", k = k),
          data = dat,
          method = "REML",
          knots = list(theta = c(0, 2 * pi))
        ),
        silent = TRUE
      )
      
      pred <- rep(NA_real_, length(theta_grid))
      pred[seq_along(pred)] <- tryCatch(
        predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(theta = theta_grid)),
        error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(theta_grid))
      )
      pred
    },
    .options = furrr::furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
  )
  
  smoothed_mat <- do.call(rbind, pred_list)
  smoothed_mat <- as.matrix(smoothed_mat)
  
  rownames(smoothed_mat) <- rownames(expr_sub)
  colnames(smoothed_mat) <- paste0("Theta_", seq_len(ncol(smoothed_mat)))
  
  keep <- complete.cases(smoothed_mat)
  smoothed_mat <- smoothed_mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  
  list(
    mat_raw = smoothed_mat,
    mat_z = row_zscore(smoothed_mat),
    theta_grid = theta_grid,
    keep_genes = rownames(smoothed_mat)
  )
}


build_top_annotation <- function(theta_grid, group_name) {
  phase_cat <- make_phase_cat_from_theta(theta_grid)
  group_cat <- factor(rep(group_name, length(theta_grid)), levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
  
  anno_df <- data.frame(
    phase = phase_cat,
    group = group_cat,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  
  colnames(anno_df) <- c("Cell phase", "Group")
  
  HeatmapAnnotation(
    df = anno_df,
    col = list(
      `Cell phase` = c(
        "2"  = "#000000",
        "6"  = "#000000",
        "10" = "#F5F5F5",
        "14" = "#F5F5F5",
        "18" = "#F5F5F5",
        "22" = "#000000"
      ),
      Group = c(
        "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",
        "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"
      )
    ),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE,
    show_legend = TRUE,
    annotation_legend_param = list(
      `Cell phase` = list(
        title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 18, fontface = "bold"),
        labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 16),
        grid_width = unit(0.5, "cm"),
        grid_height = unit(0.5, "cm")
      ),
      Group = list(
        title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 18, fontface = "bold"),
        labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 16),
        grid_width = unit(0.5, "cm"),
        grid_height = unit(0.5, "cm")
      )
    ),
    simple_anno_size = unit(2, "cm"),
    annotation_height = unit(c(1.3, 1.3), "cm"),
    gap = unit(0, "mm"),
    border = FALSE,
    gp = gpar(col = NA, lwd = 0)
  )
}

add_phase_separators <- function(theta_grid, anno_name = "Cell phase", lwd = 1.4) {
  phase_num <- as.character(make_phase_cat_from_theta(theta_grid))
  boundary_idx <- which(phase_num[-1] != phase_num[-length(phase_num)])
  x_pos <- boundary_idx / pmax(length(phase_num), 1)
  
  decorate_annotation(anno_name, {
    for (xline in x_pos) {
      grid::grid.lines(
        x = unit(c(xline, xline), "npc"),
        y = unit(c(0, 1), "npc"),
        gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = lwd)
      )
    }
  })
}
```

```{r GHI_inline_I_ECM_adhesion_phase_density}
make_phase_long_self <- function(method_df, target_id) {
  method_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(module_id == target_id) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(phase_Hep.CV, phase_Hep.PV),
      names_to = "Group",
      values_to = "Phase_hour"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(

      Phase_hour = as.numeric(Phase_hour),
      Module = module_label_map[as.character(target_id)],
      Module = factor(
        Module,
        levels = c(
          "M1 Stable Rhythm",
          "M2 Rhythm Gain",
          "M6 Phase Advanced",
          "M7 Phase Delayed"
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(Phase_hour))
}

draw_phase_density <- function(plot_df) {
  
  module_now <- unique(as.character(plot_df$Module))
  
  ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = Phase_hour, color = Group, fill = Group)
  ) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.18, linewidth = 2, adjust = 1.1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colors, name = "Group") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors, name = "Group") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 24),
      breaks = c(0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "ECM / adhesion phases",
      subtitle = module_now,
      x = "Phase (hour)",
      y = "Density",
      color = "Group",
      fill = "Group"
    ) +

      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 15),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 15)
    )
}

for (m in c(7)) {
```

```{r GHI_inline_H_Cholesterol_curves, eval=FALSE}
# Cholesterol genes MAGIC cos
rm(list = ls()); gc()

stopifnot(reticulate::py_module_available("magic"))

# 0. load data
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_object_celltype_use.Rdata")

load("outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/scCircadianliver_result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV.Rdata")

DefaultAssay(obj_use) <- "RNA"
module_result <- res2_module$module_result %>%

                A_Hep.CV = Amplitude_Hep.CV, A_Hep.PV = Amplitude_Hep.PV,

expr_data <- GetAssayData(
  obj_use,

)

theta_pred_vec <- as.numeric(res_phase_liver$theta_pred)
names(theta_pred_vec) <- res_phase_liver$cell
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(res_phase_liver$cell), all(colnames(obj_use) %in% names(theta_pred_vec)))

cell_meta <- obj_use@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    theta_pred = theta_pred_vec[cell]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    celltype %in% c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"),
    is.finite(theta_pred)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
  )

focus_genes_final <- readr::read_tsv(
  "outputs/liver/GHI_inline_20261019.yOb6m4/H_functional_curve_genes.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE
)$gene

# 2. module map
module_label_map <- c(
  "0" = "M0 Non-rhythmic",
  "1" = "M1 Stable Rhythm",
  "2" = "M2 Rhythm Gain",
  "3" = "M3 Rhythm Loss",
  "4" = "M4 Amp Enhanced",
  "5" = "M5 Amp Attenuated",
  "6" = "M6 Phase Advanced",
  "7" = "M7 Phase Delayed"
)

module_df <- module_result %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene = gene,
    module_id = as.character(module_map),
    module_label = dplyr::recode(as.character(module_map), !!!module_label_map)
  )

# 3. split cells by celltype once
cell_meta_cv <- cell_meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(celltype == "Hep.CV") %>%

cell_meta_pv <- cell_meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(celltype == "Hep.PV") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(theta_pred)

expr_cv <- expr_data[, cell_meta_cv$cell, drop = FALSE]
expr_pv <- expr_data[, cell_meta_pv$cell, drop = FALSE]

magic_input_cv <- t(as.matrix(expr_cv))
magic_input_pv <- t(as.matrix(expr_pv))

celltype_pal <- c(
  "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",
  "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"
)

theta_grid <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 300)

out_dir <- "outputs/liver/GHI_inline_20261019.yOb6m4/H_Cholesterol_curves"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 4. loop over genes
for (gene_use in focus_genes_final) {
  
  message("Running: ", gene_use)
  
  gene_in_cv <- gene_use %in% colnames(magic_input_cv)
  gene_in_pv <- gene_use %in% colnames(magic_input_pv)
  
  if (!(gene_in_cv && gene_in_pv)) {
    message("Skip gene not found in MAGIC input: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  
  data_MAGIC_cv <- tryCatch(
    magic(magic_input_cv, genes = gene_use),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  data_MAGIC_pv <- tryCatch(
    magic(magic_input_pv, genes = gene_use),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(data_MAGIC_cv) || is.null(data_MAGIC_pv)) {
    message("Skip gene due to MAGIC failure: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  
  plot_df_magic_cv <- cell_meta_cv %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      expr_magic = as.numeric(data_MAGIC_cv$result[, gene_use])
    )
  
  plot_df_magic_pv <- cell_meta_pv %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      expr_magic = as.numeric(data_MAGIC_pv$result[, gene_use])
    )
  
  plot_df_magic <- dplyr::bind_rows(plot_df_magic_cv, plot_df_magic_pv) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(expr_magic))
  
  if (nrow(plot_df_magic) == 0) {
    message("Skip gene due to empty plotting df: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  
  cosinor_df <- plot_df_magic %>%
    dplyr::group_by(celltype) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(~{
      df_ct <- .x %>%
        dplyr::select(theta_pred, expr_magic) %>%
        dplyr::filter(is.finite(theta_pred), is.finite(expr_magic))
      
      if (nrow(df_ct) < 10 || sd(df_ct$expr_magic) == 0) {
        return(tibble())
      }
      
      fit <- tryCatch(
        lm(expr_magic ~ cos(theta_pred) + sin(theta_pred), data = df_ct),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      
      if (is.null(fit)) {
        return(tibble())
      }
      
      pred <- tryCatch(
        predict(fit, newdata = tibble(theta_pred = theta_grid), se.fit = TRUE),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      
      if (is.null(pred)) {
        return(tibble())
      }
      
      tibble(
        theta_pred = theta_grid,
        expr_fit = as.numeric(pred$fit),
        expr_lower = as.numeric(pred$fit - pred$se.fit),
        expr_upper = as.numeric(pred$fit + pred$se.fit)
      )
    }) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
  
  if (nrow(cosinor_df) == 0) {
    message("Skip gene due to empty cosinor df: ", gene_use)
    next
  }
  
  module_info <- module_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene == gene_use) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(gene, module_id, module_label)
  
  module_id_use <- module_info$module_id[1]
  module_label_use <- module_info$module_label[1]
  
  p_magic_dual <- ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = cosinor_df,
      aes(
        x = theta_pred,
        ymin = expr_lower,
        ymax = expr_upper,
        fill = celltype
      ),
      alpha = 0.18,
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = cosinor_df,
      aes(x = theta_pred, y = expr_fit, color = celltype),
      linewidth = 4
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = celltype_pal, name = NULL) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_pal, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 2*pi),
      breaks = c(0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2, 2*pi),
      labels = c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2", "2π"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.04))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = gene_use,
      x = expression("Predicted phase " * phi),
      y = "Normalized Expression"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 45),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 32, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 32, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 27),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 27),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 25),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 10)
    )
  
  print(p_magic_dual)
  
  file_stub <- paste0(
    "M", module_id_use, "_",
    gsub("[[:space:]]+", "_", module_label_use), "_",
    gene_use, "_MAGIC_cosinor"
  )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_stub, ".pdf")),
    p_magic_dual,
    width = 5,
    height = 5.7, device = grDevices::cairo_pdf, family = "sans"
  )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_stub, ".png")),
    p_magic_dual,
    width = 5,
    height = 5.7,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```

# BCDF 新版结果复原（20261019）

本节仅恢复 B、C、D、F 的旧版画法并接入已保存的新版结果，不运行上游推断。B/C 使用 cell barcode 配对相位，左 CV、右 PV；C 保留原周期扩展 KDE 与带宽，但归一化为单位面积，因此纵轴不再沿用旧代码约三分之一面积的数值。

D 保留全部八个模块及原排序/平滑，仅把归一化分母修正为全部 RNA 基因。使用独立的绘图函数副本，不修改现有算法或原绘图函数。D 的部分基因若缺少排序相位，按原函数规则保留在末尾；平滑失败的基因会在验证记录中列出。

F 保留原图显著性/振幅展示筛选、每模块最多 50 个基因及原排序分数，依次输出 M2/M4/M6、M3/M5/M7；不是模块全集，也不重新分类。点大小与手工图例使用一致的全局振幅尺度。

本节全部新图与来源表保存至 `outputs/liver/BCDF_restore_20261019.yfTH34`，不覆盖已有结果。先运行 B/C/F，D 八模块平滑单独运行；此前 G/H/I 代码不变。

# B_cell_phase_by_ZT
```{r BCDF_restore_B}
# cellphase plot
rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(purrr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_object_celltype_use.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_infer_scRhythm_phase.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_countmat.Rdata")

DefaultAssay(obj_use) <- "RNA"


# Step 1. helper

wrap_phase <- function(x) {
  ((as.numeric(x) %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi)
}

hour_to_rad <- function(h) {
  (h %% 24) / 24 * 2 * pi
}


# Step 2. metadata

theta_pred_vec <- as.numeric(res_phase_liver$theta_pred)
names(theta_pred_vec) <- res_phase_liver$cell
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(res_phase_liver$cell), all(colnames(obj_use) %in% names(theta_pred_vec)))

meta_plot <- obj_use@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    ZT_true = readr::parse_number(as.character(ZT)),
    theta_pred = theta_pred_vec[cell]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    celltype %in% c("Hep.PV", "Hep.CV"),
    is.finite(ZT_true),
    is.finite(theta_pred)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    theta_pred = wrap_phase(theta_pred),
    ZT_group = factor(ZT_true, levels = c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22)),
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
  )

print(table(meta_plot$celltype, meta_plot$ZT_group))


# Step 3. circular density for theta_pred

circ_density_df <- function(theta_vec, group_name, celltype_name, n_grid = 720, bw = 0.35) {
  
  theta_vec <- as.numeric(theta_vec)
  theta_vec <- theta_vec[is.finite(theta_vec)]
  theta_vec <- wrap_phase(theta_vec)
  
  theta_ext <- c(theta_vec - 2 * pi, theta_vec, theta_vec + 2 * pi)
  
  dens <- stats::density(
    theta_ext,
    from = 0,
    to = 2 * pi,
    n = n_grid,
    bw = bw
  )
  
  tibble::tibble(
    theta = dens$x,
    density = dens$y,
    group = group_name,
    celltype = celltype_name
  )
}

density_df <- meta_plot %>%
  dplyr::group_by(celltype, ZT_group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    theta_list = list(theta_pred),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  purrr::pmap_dfr(function(celltype, ZT_group, theta_list) {
    circ_density_df(
      theta_vec = unlist(theta_list),
      group_name = as.character(ZT_group),
      celltype_name = as.character(celltype),
      n_grid = 720,
      bw = 0.35
    )
  })

density_df <- density_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(celltype, group) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    density_scaled = density / max(density, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    r_inner = 1.10,
    r_outer = 1.10 + density_scaled * 0.95
  )


# Step 4. middle colored ring
# 直接按真实 ZT 组放到对应时间区间：
# ZT02 -> 0~4h
# ZT06 -> 4~8h
# ...
# ZT22 -> 20~24h

ring_base <- tibble::tibble(
  hour = seq(0, 24, length.out = 721)
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    theta = hour_to_rad(hour),
    ZT_group = cut(
      hour %% 24,
      breaks = c(0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24),
      labels = c("2", "6", "10", "14", "18", "22"),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      right = FALSE
    ),
    r0 = 0.98,
    r1 = 1.18
  )

ring_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  ring_base %>% dplyr::mutate(celltype = "Hep.PV"),
  ring_base %>% dplyr::mutate(celltype = "Hep.CV")
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
  )


# Step 5. outer circle + ticks + labels
# 主刻度每4h，次刻度每2h

circle_df <- tibble::tibble(
  theta = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 500),
  r = 2.05
)

major_tick_df <- tibble::tibble(
  hour = c(0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20),
  theta = hour_to_rad(hour)
)

minor_tick_df <- tibble::tibble(

label_df_major <- tibble::tibble(

  lab = paste0(hour, "h")
)

label_df_minor <- tibble::tibble(
  hour = c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22),
  theta = hour_to_rad(hour),

)


# Step 6. colors

zt_cols <- c(
  "2"  = "#D97B93",
  "6"  = "#F08A72",
  "10" = "#F3B36A",

# Step 7. plot
# 关键：这里只做一次统一旋转

p_circ_facet <- ggplot() +
```

```{r BCDF_restore_C}
#cell phase density by celltype
rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
})

load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_object_celltype_use.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_infer_scRhythm_phase.Rdata")
load("outputs/liver/scCircadianliver_countmat.Rdata")

DefaultAssay(obj_use) <- "RNA"

# 1. helper
wrap_phase <- function(x) {
  ((as.numeric(x) %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi)
}

# 2. metadata
theta_pred_vec <- as.numeric(res_phase_liver$theta_pred)
names(theta_pred_vec) <- res_phase_liver$cell
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(res_phase_liver$cell), all(colnames(obj_use) %in% names(theta_pred_vec)))

meta_plot <- obj_use@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    theta_pred = theta_pred_vec[cell]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    celltype %in% c("Hep.PV", "Hep.CV"),
    is.finite(theta_pred)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    theta_pred = wrap_phase(theta_pred),
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
  )

# 3. circular density helper
circ_density_df <- function(theta_vec, group_name, n_grid = 720, bw = 0.35) {
  
  theta_vec <- as.numeric(theta_vec)
  theta_vec <- theta_vec[is.finite(theta_vec)]
  theta_vec <- wrap_phase(theta_vec)
  
  # circular extension
  theta_ext <- c(theta_vec - 2*pi, theta_vec, theta_vec + 2*pi)
  
  dens <- stats::density(
    theta_ext,
    from = 0,
    to = 2*pi,
    n = n_grid,
    bw = bw
  )
  
  tibble(
    theta = dens$x,
    density = dens$y / sum(diff(dens$x) * (head(dens$y, -1) + tail(dens$y, -1)) / 2),
    celltype = group_name
  )
}

# 4. density dataframe
density_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    circ_density_df(
    theta_vec = meta_plot$theta_pred[meta_plot$celltype == "Hep.CV"],
    group_name = "Hep.CV",
    n_grid = 720,
    bw = 0.35
  ),
  circ_density_df(
    theta_vec = meta_plot$theta_pred[meta_plot$celltype == "Hep.PV"],
    group_name = "Hep.PV",
    n_grid = 720,
    bw = 0.35
  )

) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
  )

# 5. colors
celltype_pal <- c(
  "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",
  "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"

)

# 6. plot
p_phase_density <- ggplot(density_df, aes(x = theta, y = density, color = celltype)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = celltype_pal, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 2*pi),
    breaks = c(0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2, 2*pi),
    labels = c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2", "2π"),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Phase distribution by cell type",
    x = expression("Predicted phase " * phi),
    y = "Cell density"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 30),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 18, 5.5, 5.5)
  )

p_phase_density

out_dir <- "outputs/liver/BCDF_restore_20261019.yfTH34/C_cell_phase_density"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "cell_phase_density_by_celltype.pdf"),
  p_phase_density,
  width = 6.8,
```

# F_module_polar
```{r BCDF_restore_F}
# genelevel celltype/module polar
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(readr)
  library(scales)
  library(purrr)
  library(grid)
})

# 1. load updated results
load("outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/scCircadianliver_result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV.Rdata")

module_result <- res2_module$module_result %>%
  dplyr::rename(q_Hep.CV = FDR_Hep.CV, q_Hep.PV = FDR_Hep.PV,
                A_Hep.CV = Amplitude_Hep.CV, A_Hep.PV = Amplitude_Hep.PV,
                phi_Hep.CV = Phase_Hep.CV, phi_Hep.PV = Phase_Hep.PV)
stopifnot(identical(unique(as.character(module_result$group1)), "Hep.CV"),
          identical(unique(as.character(module_result$group2)), "Hep.PV"))

# 2. basic maps
module_label_map <- c(
  "0" = "M0 Non-rhythmic",
  "1" = "M1 Stable Rhythm",
  "2" = "M2 Rhythm Gain",
  "3" = "M3 Rhythm Loss",
  "4" = "M4 Amp Enhanced",
  "5" = "M5 Amp Attenuated",
  "6" = "M6 Phase Advanced",
  "7" = "M7 Phase Delayed"
)

module_pal <- c(
  "M0 Non-rhythmic"   = "#BDBDBD",
  "M1 Stable Rhythm"  = "#AFC0D6",
  "M2 Rhythm Gain"    = "#EDC0A0",
  "M3 Rhythm Loss"    = "#7F9DBF",
  "M4 Amp Enhanced"   = "#DF8F79",
  "M5 Amp Attenuated" = "#E7EDF4",
  "M6 Phase Advanced" = "#FAEFD9",
  "M7 Phase Delayed"  = "#4973A8"
)

celltype_pal <- c(
  "Hep.CV" = "#7BC0CD",
  "Hep.PV" = "#ED8D5A"
)

# 3. directly build long table from updated module_result
plot_df0 <- module_result %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene = gene,
    module_id = as.character(module_map),
    module_label = dplyr::recode(as.character(module_map), !!!module_label_map),
    Phase_Hep.CV = as.numeric(phi_Hep.CV),
    Phase_Hep.PV = as.numeric(phi_Hep.PV),
    Amplitude_Hep.CV = as.numeric(A_Hep.CV),
    Amplitude_Hep.PV = as.numeric(A_Hep.PV),
    FDR_Hep.CV = as.numeric(q_Hep.CV),
    FDR_Hep.PV = as.numeric(q_Hep.PV)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Phase_Hep.CV, Phase_Hep.PV,
      Amplitude_Hep.CV, Amplitude_Hep.PV,
      FDR_Hep.CV, FDR_Hep.PV
    ),
    names_to = c(".value", "celltype"),
    names_pattern = "^(Phase|Amplitude|FDR)_(Hep\\.PV|Hep\\.CV)$"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    phase_wrap = ((Phase %% (2 * pi)) + 2 * pi) %% (2 * pi)
  )

# 4. gene filtering
# shared modules: M1/M4/M5/M6/M7
# non-shared modules: M2/M3
gene_keep_df <- plot_df0 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene, module_id, module_label) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_celltype = sum(!is.na(Phase) & !is.na(Amplitude) & !is.na(FDR)),
    fdr_pv = FDR[celltype == "Hep.PV"][1],
    fdr_cv = FDR[celltype == "Hep.CV"][1],
    amp_pv = Amplitude[celltype == "Hep.PV"][1],
    amp_cv = Amplitude[celltype == "Hep.CV"][1],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    both_sig = (fdr_pv < 0.05 & fdr_cv < 0.05),
    one_sig  = xor(fdr_pv < 0.05, fdr_cv < 0.05),
    min_amp  = pmin(amp_pv, amp_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_amp  = pmax(amp_pv, amp_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
    keep_gene = dplyr::case_when(
      module_id %in% c("1", "4", "5", "6", "7") ~
        n_celltype == 2 & both_sig & min_amp > 0.10,
      module_id %in% c("2", "3") ~
        n_celltype >= 1 & one_sig & max_amp > 0.10,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

plot_df1 <- plot_df0 %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    gene_keep_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(keep_gene) %>%
      dplyr::select(gene, module_id, module_label),
    by = c("gene", "module_id", "module_label")
  )

# 5. global amplitude scaling
amp_cap <- quantile(plot_df1$Amplitude, probs = 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)

plot_df2 <- plot_df1 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig_flag = FDR < 0.05,
    amp_clip = pmin(Amplitude, amp_cap),
    radius_raw = rescale(amp_clip, to = c(0.18, 0.95), from = c(0, amp_cap)),
    radius = dplyr::case_when(
      module_id %in% c("2", "3") & !sig_flag ~ 0.12,
      TRUE ~ radius_raw
    ),
    x = radius * sin(phase_wrap),
    y = radius * cos(phase_wrap)
  )

# 6. make pairwise table
pair_df <- plot_df2 %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, celltype, phase_wrap, radius, x, y, Amplitude, FDR, sig_flag, module_id, module_label) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = celltype,
    values_from = c(phase_wrap, radius, x, y, Amplitude, FDR, sig_flag)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    delta_phase = atan2(
      sin(phase_wrap_Hep.CV - phase_wrap_Hep.PV),
      cos(phase_wrap_Hep.CV - phase_wrap_Hep.PV)
    ),
    abs_delta_phase = abs(delta_phase),
    delta_amp = Amplitude_Hep.CV - Amplitude_Hep.PV,
    abs_delta_amp = abs(delta_amp),
    mean_amp = (Amplitude_Hep.PV + Amplitude_Hep.CV) / 2,
    max_amp = pmax(Amplitude_Hep.PV, Amplitude_Hep.CV, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_logfdr = -log10(FDR_Hep.PV + 1e-300) + -log10(FDR_Hep.CV + 1e-300)
  )

# 7. module-specific ranking score
pair_df <- pair_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(module_id) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    z_abs_delta_phase = as.numeric(scale(abs_delta_phase)),
    z_abs_delta_amp   = as.numeric(scale(abs_delta_amp)),
    z_mean_amp        = as.numeric(scale(mean_amp)),
    z_max_amp         = as.numeric(scale(max_amp)),
    z_sum_logfdr      = as.numeric(scale(sum_logfdr))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    rank_score = dplyr::case_when(
      module_id == "1" ~ z_mean_amp + z_sum_logfdr - z_abs_delta_phase - z_abs_delta_amp,
      module_id == "2" ~ z_max_amp,
      module_id == "3" ~ z_max_amp,
      module_id == "4" ~ z_abs_delta_amp + 0.5 * z_mean_amp + 0.5 * z_sum_logfdr - 0.5 * z_abs_delta_phase,
      module_id == "5" ~ z_abs_delta_amp + 0.5 * z_mean_amp + 0.5 * z_sum_logfdr - 0.5 * z_abs_delta_phase,
      module_id == "6" ~ z_abs_delta_phase + 0.5 * z_mean_amp + 0.5 * z_sum_logfdr,
      module_id == "7" ~ z_abs_delta_phase + 0.5 * z_mean_amp + 0.5 * z_sum_logfdr,
      TRUE ~ z_mean_amp
    )
  )

# 8. choose top genes per module
top_n_per_module <- 50

top_gene_df <- pair_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(module_id) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(order_by = rank_score, n = top_n_per_module, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, module_id, module_label, rank_score, abs_delta_phase, abs_delta_amp)

# 9. keep only top genes for plotting
plot_df_top <- plot_df2 %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    top_gene_df %>% dplyr::select(gene, module_id),
    by = c("gene", "module_id")
  )

pair_df_top <- pair_df %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    top_gene_df %>% dplyr::select(gene, module_id),
    by = c("gene", "module_id")
  )

# 10. background for polar frame
circle_df <- tibble(
  r = c(0.18, 0.36, 0.54, 0.72, 0.95)
)

angle_df <- tibble(
  angle = c(0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2),
  xend = 0.98 * sin(angle),
  yend = 0.98 * cos(angle),
  lab_x = 1.16 * sin(angle),
  lab_y = 1.16 * cos(angle)
)

# 11. amplitude tick labels
amp_breaks_raw <- pretty(c(0, amp_cap), n = 4)
amp_breaks_raw <- amp_breaks_raw[amp_breaks_raw >= 0]
amp_breaks_raw <- unique(amp_breaks_raw)
amp_breaks_raw <- amp_breaks_raw[amp_breaks_raw <= amp_cap]

amp_tick_df <- tibble(
  amp_raw = amp_breaks_raw,
  r = rescale(
    pmin(amp_breaks_raw, amp_cap),
    to = c(0.18, 0.95),
    from = c(0, amp_cap)
  ),
  x = r,
  y = 0,
  label = format(round(amp_raw, 2), nsmall = 2)
)

amp_legend_vals <- amp_breaks_raw[amp_breaks_raw > 0]
amp_legend_vals <- sort(unique(amp_legend_vals))
amp_legend_vals <- amp_legend_vals[c(1, ceiling(length(amp_legend_vals) / 2), length(amp_legend_vals))]

amp_legend_sizes <- rescale(
  sqrt(pmin(amp_legend_vals, amp_cap)),
  to = c(3.8, 8.2),
  from = c(0, sqrt(amp_cap))
)

# 12. plotting function
plot_module_polar <- function(module_use,
                              line_alpha = 0.65,
                              point_size_range = c(3.8, 8.2)) {

  df_sub <- plot_df_top %>%
    dplyr::filter(module_id == module_use)

  pair_sub <- pair_df_top %>%
    dplyr::filter(module_id == module_use)

  title_use <- unique(df_sub$module_label)

  circle_path_df <- map_dfr(circle_df$r, ~ tibble(
    t = seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 400),
    x = .x * sin(t),
    y = .x * cos(t),
    r = .x
  ))

  is_gain_loss <- module_use %in% c("2", "3")

  ggplot() +
    geom_path(
      data = circle_path_df,
      aes(x = x, y = y, group = r),
      color = "grey82",
      linewidth = 0.38
    ) +

    geom_segment(
      data = angle_df,
      aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = xend, yend = yend),
      color = "grey85",
      linewidth = 0.32
    ) +

    geom_segment(
      data = pair_sub %>% dplyr::filter(!is_gain_loss),
      aes(
        x = x_Hep.PV, y = y_Hep.PV,
        xend = x_Hep.CV, yend = y_Hep.CV
      ),
      color = scales::alpha("grey55", line_alpha),
      linewidth = 0.50
    ) +

    # Hep.CV significant = 蓝色实心
    geom_point(
      data = df_sub %>% dplyr::filter(celltype == "Hep.CV", sig_flag),
      aes(x = x, y = y, size = amp_clip),
      shape = 21,
      fill = celltype_pal["Hep.CV"],
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.24,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +

    # Hep.PV significant = 橙色空心
    geom_point(
      data = df_sub %>% dplyr::filter(celltype == "Hep.PV", sig_flag),
      aes(x = x, y = y, size = amp_clip),
      shape = 1,
      color = celltype_pal["Hep.PV"],
      stroke = 0.95,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +

    annotate(
      "text",
      x = angle_df$lab_x,
      y = angle_df$lab_y,
      label = c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2"),
      size = 4.8,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +

    geom_segment(
      data = amp_tick_df,
      aes(x = x, y = -1.225, xend = x, yend = -1.195),
      linewidth = 0.30,
      color = "grey35"
    ) +
    annotate("segment", x = min(amp_tick_df$x), xend = max(amp_tick_df$x), y = -1.21, yend = -1.21, linewidth = 0.30, color = "grey35") +

    geom_text(
      data = amp_tick_df,
      aes(x = x, y = -1.29, label = label),
      size = 3.1,
      hjust = 0.5,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +

    annotate("text", x = mean(range(amp_tick_df$x)), y = -1.42, label = "Amplitude", size = 3.8, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text", x = 0.65, y = 1.00, label = "Peak phase", angle = -50, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +

    coord_equal(xlim = c(-1.18, 1.55), ylim = c(-1.50, 1.18), clip = "off") +

    scale_size_continuous(
      range = point_size_range,
      limits = c(0, amp_cap),
      guide = "none"
    ) +

    labs(title = title_use) +

    theme_void(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 22, 8, 8)
    ) +

    # ---------- celltype legend ----------
    annotate("point", x = 1.08, y = 0.96, shape = 21, size = 4.6,
             fill = celltype_pal["Hep.CV"], color = "black", stroke = 0.24) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.15, y = 0.96, label = "Hep.CV", hjust = 0, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +

    annotate("point", x = 1.08, y = 0.84, shape = 1, size = 4.6,
             color = celltype_pal["Hep.PV"], stroke = 0.95) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.15, y = 0.84, label = "Hep.PV", hjust = 0, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +

    # ---------- global amplitude legend ----------
    annotate("text", x = 1.08, y = 0.58, label = "Amplitude", hjust = 0, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +

    annotate("point", x = 1.08, y = 0.49, shape = 16,
             size = amp_legend_sizes[1], color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = 1.18, y = 0.49, label = amp_legend_vals[1], hjust = 0, size = 3.0) +

    annotate("point", x = 1.08, y = 0.39, shape = 16,
             size = amp_legend_sizes[min(2, length(amp_legend_sizes))], color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = 1.18, y = 0.39, label = amp_legend_vals[min(2, length(amp_legend_vals))], hjust = 0, size = 3.0) +

    annotate("point", x = 1.08, y = 0.27, shape = 16,
             size = amp_legend_sizes[min(3, length(amp_legend_sizes))], color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = 1.18, y = 0.27, label = amp_legend_vals[min(3, length(amp_legend_vals))], hjust = 0, size = 3.0)
}
```

# E_module_gene_count

沿用旧版八模块柱状图，统计与 D/F 相同的新版 module_result 全部基因，不使用热图平滑后的基因数。CV→PV 的比较方向不变。

```{r E_restore_module_count}
# module gene count barplot
rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(plotthis)
  library(ggplot2)
})

load("outputs/liver/result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018/scCircadianliver_result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV.Rdata")
module_result <- res2_module$module_result
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(module_result$gene), !anyNA(module_result$gene),
          !anyNA(module_result$module_map), all(module_result$module_map %in% 0:7),
          identical(unique(as.character(module_result$group1)), "Hep.CV"),
          identical(unique(as.character(module_result$group2)), "Hep.PV"))

# 1. module label map
module_label_map <- c(
  "0" = "M0 Non-rhythmic",
  "1" = "M1 Stable Rhythm",
  "2" = "M2 Rhythm Gain",
  "3" = "M3 Rhythm Loss",
  "4" = "M4 Amp Enhanced",
  "5" = "M5 Amp Attenuated",
  "6" = "M6 Phase Advanced",
  "7" = "M7 Phase Delayed"
)

module_pal <- c(
  "M0 Non-rhythmic"   = "#9FC9D6",
  "M1 Stable Rhythm"  = "#BFDFD2",
  "M2 Rhythm Gain"    = "#ECB66C",
  "M3 Rhythm Loss"    = "#7BC0CD",
  "M4 Amp Enhanced"   = "#ED8D5A",
  "M5 Amp Attenuated" = "#51999F",
  "M6 Phase Advanced" = "#EA9E58",
  "M7 Phase Delayed"  = "#4198AC"
)

# 2. count genes in each module
plot_df_module <- module_result %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::transmute(gene = gene, module_id = factor(module_map, levels = 0:7)) %>%
  dplyr::count(module_id, name = "Count", .drop = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    module_label = factor(module_label_map[as.character(module_id)], levels = unname(module_label_map)),
    Proportion = Count / sum(Count),
    label_n_pct = paste0(Count, "\n", scales::percent(Proportion, accuracy = 0.1))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(module_id)
stopifnot(sum(plot_df_module$Count) == nrow(module_result))
print(plot_df_module)

# 3. save table
out_dir <- "outputs/liver/BCDF_restore_20261019.yfTH34/E_module_count_20261019.yVkwFn"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
readr::write_tsv(plot_df_module, file.path(out_dir, "E_module_gene_count.tsv"))

# 4. barplot
p_module_bar <- plotthis::BarPlot(
  data = plot_df_module,
  x = "module_id",
  y = "Count",
  group_by = "module_label",
  group_name = "",
  palcolor = module_pal,
  label = "Count",
  label_size = 5,
  label_nudge = 0.04,
  label_bg = NA,
  y_min = 0,
  y_max = max(plot_df_module$Count) * 1.12,
  legend.position = "top",
  legend.direction = "horizontal"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "Gene Count Across 8 Modules", x = NULL, y = "Gene count", fill = NULL) +
  ggplot2::guides(fill = ggplot2::guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, ceiling(max(plot_df_module$Count) / 2000) * 2000, 2000)) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15),
    plot.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8.5),
    panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "grey80", linetype = 2),
    panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank()
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate("segment", x = seq(0.5, 8.5, 1), xend = seq(0.5, 8.5, 1), y = 0, yend = max(plot_df_module$Count) * 1.12, colour = "grey80", linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.4)
print(p_module_bar)

# 5. save plot
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "E_module_gene_count_barplot.pdf"), p_module_bar, width = 7.5, height = 5.5, device = grDevices::cairo_pdf, family = "sans")
```

# C_cell_phase_rose
```{r GSE288579_restore_C}
load(file.path(new_output_root, "scCircadianliver_object_celltype_use.Rdata"))
load(file.path(new_output_root, "scCircadianliver_infer_scRhythm_phase.Rdata"))

theta_gse288579 <- stats::setNames(as.numeric(res_phase_liver$theta_pred), res_phase_liver$cell)
phase_gse288579 <- obj_use@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::transmute(cell, celltype = as.character(celltype), theta_pred = theta_gse288579[cell]) %>%
  dplyr::filter(celltype %in% c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"), is.finite(theta_pred))

plot_phase_rose_gse288579 <- function(df_one, celltype_name, fill_col, rmax_fix, n_bin = 24) {
  breaks_theta <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_bin + 1)
  mids_theta <- (breaks_theta[-1] + breaks_theta[-length(breaks_theta)]) / 2
  h <- hist(df_one$theta_pred, breaks = breaks_theta, plot = FALSE)
  plot_df <- tibble::tibble(theta_mid = mids_theta, count = h$counts, prop = h$counts / sum(h$counts)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(label = dplyr::if_else(count > 0, as.character(count), ""))
  ggplot2::ggplot(plot_df, ggplot2::aes(x = theta_mid, y = prop)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(width = 2 * pi / n_bin * 0.94, fill = fill_col, alpha = 0.9, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(y = prop + rmax_fix * 0.035, label = label), size = 3, fontface = "bold", family = "Arial") +
    ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.35, y = rmax_fix * 0.88, label = paste0("N = ", nrow(df_one)), size = 4.8, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, fontface = "bold", family = "Arial") +
    ggplot2::coord_polar(start = 0, direction = 1, clip = "off") +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2 * pi), breaks = seq(0, 2 * pi - 2 * pi / 8, length.out = 8), labels = c("0:00", "3:00", "6:00", "9:00", "12:00", "15:00", "18:00", "21:00")) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-rmax_fix * 0.22, rmax_fix * 1.18), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = celltype_name, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 15, base_family = "Arial") +
    ggplot2::theme(axis.title = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"), panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(), panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey80"), panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey88"), plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 17), plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(8, 8, 8, 8))
}

rmax_gse288579 <- phase_gse288579 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(celltype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(max_prop = max(hist(theta_pred, breaks = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 25), plot = FALSE)$counts / dplyr::n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::pull(max_prop) %>% max()
p_gse288579_C_pv <- plot_phase_rose_gse288579(dplyr::filter(phase_gse288579, celltype == "Hep.PV"), "Hep.PV", gse288579_pal["Hep.PV"], rmax_gse288579)
p_gse288579_C_cv <- plot_phase_rose_gse288579(dplyr::filter(phase_gse288579, celltype == "Hep.CV"), "Hep.CV", gse288579_pal["Hep.CV"], rmax_gse288579)
p_gse288579_C <- p_gse288579_C_pv | p_gse288579_C_cv
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(gse288579_panel_root, "C_cell_phase_rose.pdf"), p_gse288579_C, width = 8, height = 4, device = grDevices::cairo_pdf, family = "Arial")
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(gse288579_panel_root, "C_cell_phase_rose.png"), p_gse288579_C, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

# D_core_clock_acrophase
```{r GSE288579_restore_D}
load(file.path(new_output_root, "result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018", "scCircadianliver_result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV.Rdata"))
module_gse288579 <- res2_module$module_result
core_clock <- c("Arntl", "Clock", "Npas2", "Cry1", "Cry2", "Per1", "Per2", "Per3", "Nr1d1", "Nr1d2", "Dbp", "Tef", "Nfil3", "Ciart")
core_gse288579 <- module_gse288579 %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gene = tools::toTitleCase(tolower(gene))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% core_clock) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, dplyr::starts_with("Phase_"), dplyr::starts_with("Amplitude_"), dplyr::starts_with("FDR_")) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = c(".value", "celltype"), names_pattern = "^(Phase|Amplitude|FDR)_(Hep\\.CV|Hep\\.PV)$") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(phase_wrap = Phase %% (2 * pi), phase_hour = phase_wrap / (2 * pi) * 24) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::filter(sum(is.finite(Phase)) == 2) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()
gene_order <- core_gse288579 %>% dplyr::filter(celltype == "Hep.CV") %>% dplyr::arrange(phase_hour) %>% dplyr::pull(gene)
core_gse288579$gene <- factor(core_gse288579$gene, levels = gene_order)

plot_core_gse288579 <- function(gene_use) {
  df_sub <- dplyr::filter(core_gse288579, gene == gene_use) %>% dplyr::arrange(celltype) %>% dplyr::mutate(point_x = phase_wrap + c(-0.035, 0.035), point_y = 0.92)
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_point(data = df_sub, ggplot2::aes(x = point_x, y = point_y, fill = celltype), shape = 21, size = 5.8, stroke = 0.2, color = "black", alpha = 0.75) +

    ggplot2::geom_text(data = tibble::tibble(theta = c(0, pi / 2, pi, 3 * pi / 2), r = 1.06, lab = c("0", "6", "12", "18")), ggplot2::aes(x = theta, y = r, label = lab), size = 3.2, fontface = "bold", family = "Arial") +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = gse288579_pal) +
    ggplot2::coord_polar(theta = "x", start = 0, direction = 1, clip = "off") +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2 * pi), breaks = NULL) +

}
```
