# F_module_density_cumulative
```{r GSE288579_restore_F}
load(file.path(new_output_root, "result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV_20261018", "scCircadianliver_result_module_phase2_CV_to_PV.Rdata"))
module_gse288579 <- res2_module$module_result
module_labels <- c("M0 Non-rhythmic", "M1 Stable Rhythm", "M2 Rhythm Gain", "M3 Rhythm Loss", "M4 Amp Enhanced", "M5 Amp Attenuated", "M6 Phase Advanced", "M7 Phase Delayed")
module_long_gse288579 <- module_gse288579 %>%
  dplyr::transmute(gene, module_id = as.integer(module_map), Amplitude_Hep.CV, Amplitude_Hep.PV, Phase_Hep.CV, Phase_Hep.PV) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -c(gene, module_id), names_to = c("metric", "Group"), names_pattern = "^(Amplitude|Phase)_(Hep\\.CV|Hep\\.PV)$", values_to = "value") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(value = dplyr::if_else(metric == "Phase", (value %% (2 * pi)) / (2 * pi) * 24, value), Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV")))

blank_module_plot <- function(title_text) ggplot2::ggplot() + ggplot2::labs(title = title_text) + ggplot2::theme_void(base_family = "Arial") + ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 8))
module_density_plot <- function(module_id, metric) {
  title_text <- paste0(module_labels[module_id + 1], " - ", metric, " Density")
  df <- module_long_gse288579 %>% dplyr::filter(module_id == !!module_id, metric == !!metric, is.finite(value))
  if (module_id == 0 || nrow(df) < 2 || dplyr::n_distinct(df$value) < 2) return(blank_module_plot(title_text))
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(x = value, color = Group, fill = Group)) +
    ggplot2::geom_density(alpha = 0.18, linewidth = 0.7, adjust = 1.1) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = gse288579_pal) + ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = gse288579_pal) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = title_text, x = if (metric == "Phase") "Phase (hour)" else "Amplitude", y = "Density") +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 6, base_family = "Arial") + ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 7), legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(), legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 5))
  if (metric == "Phase") p + ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 24), breaks = c(0, 8, 16, 24)) else p + ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.4) + ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 4))
}
module_cumulative_plot <- function(module_id, metric) {
  title_text <- paste0(module_labels[module_id + 1], " - ", metric, " Cumulative Distribution")
  df <- module_long_gse288579 %>% dplyr::filter(module_id == !!module_id, metric == !!metric, is.finite(value))
  if (module_id == 0 || nrow(df) == 0) return(blank_module_plot(title_text))
  thresholds <- if (metric == "Phase") seq(0, 24, by = 1) else seq(0, 4, by = 0.02)
  cum_df <- tidyr::expand_grid(Group = factor(c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"), levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV")), threshold = thresholds) %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(n = sum(df$value[df$Group == Group] >= threshold, na.rm = TRUE), log10_n = log10(n + 1)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(cum_df, ggplot2::aes(x = threshold, y = log10_n, color = Group)) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) + ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = gse288579_pal) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = title_text, x = if (metric == "Phase") "Phase (hour)" else "Amplitude", y = "Log10 Cumulative Number of Genes") +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 6, base_family = "Arial") + ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 7), legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(), legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 5))
  if (metric == "Phase") p + ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 24), breaks = c(0, 8, 16, 24)) else p + ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.4) + ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 4))
}

amp_density <- lapply(0:7, module_density_plot, metric = "Amplitude")
phase_density <- lapply(0:7, module_density_plot, metric = "Phase")
amp_cumulative <- lapply(0:7, module_cumulative_plot, metric = "Amplitude")
phase_cumulative <- lapply(0:7, module_cumulative_plot, metric = "Phase")
p_gse288579_F <- patchwork::wrap_plots(c(amp_density[1:4], phase_density[1:4], amp_density[5:8], phase_density[5:8], amp_cumulative[1:4], phase_cumulative[1:4], amp_cumulative[5:8], phase_cumulative[5:8]), ncol = 8)
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(gse288579_panel_root, "F_module_density_cumulative.pdf"), p_gse288579_F, width = 20, height = 10, device = grDevices::cairo_pdf, family = "Arial")
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(gse288579_panel_root, "F_module_density_cumulative.png"), p_gse288579_F, width = 20, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

# GSE145197 新版三层分析

## Load data

```{r GSE145197_load_data}
gse145197_algo_dir <- "../R"
gse145197_data_file <- "data/circadian scLiver(Felix Naef).qs"
gse145197_root <- "outputs/liver_GSE145197"
gse145197_phase_file <- file.path(gse145197_root, "GSE145197_infer_cell_phase.rds")
gse145197_param_file <- file.path(gse145197_root, "GSE145197_infer_gene_param.rds")
gse145197_module_file <- file.path(gse145197_root, "GSE145197_infer_rhythm_module_CV_to_PV.rds")
gse145197_n_worker <- min(12L, max(1L, parallel::detectCores() - 2L))

source(file.path(gse145197_algo_dir, "infer_cell_phase.R"))
source(file.path(gse145197_algo_dir, "infer_gene_param.R"))
source(file.path(gse145197_algo_dir, "infer_rhythm_module.R"))

dir.create(gse145197_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

gse145197 <- qs::qread(gse145197_data_file)
Seurat::DefaultAssay(gse145197) <- "RNA"
cells_use_gse145197 <- colnames(gse145197)[as.character(gse145197$celltype) %in% c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV")]
gse145197_obj <- base::subset(gse145197, cells = cells_use_gse145197)
Seurat::DefaultAssay(gse145197_obj) <- "RNA"
gse145197_count <- SeuratObject::GetAssayData(gse145197_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
gse145197_meta <- gse145197_obj@meta.data
gse145197_meta <- gse145197_meta[colnames(gse145197_count), , drop = FALSE]
gse145197_meta$cell <- rownames(gse145197_meta)
gse145197_meta$celltype <- factor(as.character(gse145197_meta$celltype), levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV"))
gse145197_meta$ZT_num <- as.numeric(gsub("h$", "", gsub("^ZT-?", "", as.character(gse145197_meta$ZT))))

stopifnot(identical(colnames(gse145197_count), gse145197_meta$cell))
stopifnot(!anyNA(gse145197_meta$ZT_num), !anyNA(gse145197_meta$celltype))
stopifnot(setequal(as.character(unique(gse145197_meta$celltype)), c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV")))
```

## Cell phase

```{r GSE145197_cell_phase}
res_phase_gse145197 <- infer_cell_phase(
  count = gse145197_count,
  metadata = gse145197_meta,
  ZT_by = "ZT_num",
  strata_by = "celltype",
  Species = "mouse",
  setseed = 1,
  Verbose = TRUE
)

phase_id_gse145197 <- match(colnames(gse145197_count), res_phase_gse145197$cell)
stopifnot(!anyNA(phase_id_gse145197))

theta_gse145197 <- res_phase_gse145197$theta_pred[phase_id_gse145197]
r_gse145197 <- res_phase_gse145197$r_cell[phase_id_gse145197]

stopifnot(all(is.finite(theta_gse145197)), all(is.finite(r_gse145197)))
saveRDS(res_phase_gse145197, gse145197_phase_file)
```

## Gene parameters

```{r GSE145197_gene_parameters}
res_param_gse145197 <- infer_gene_param(
  count = gse145197_count,
  metadata = gse145197_meta,
  theta_pred = theta_gse145197,
  r_cell = r_gse145197,
  strata_by = "celltype",
  ZT_by = "ZT_num",
  B = 100,
  n_worker = gse145197_n_worker,
  setseed = 1,
  sample_by = NULL,
  Verbose = TRUE
)

stopifnot(all(c("gene", "FDR_Hep.CV", "FDR_Hep.PV", "Amplitude_Hep.CV", "Amplitude_Hep.PV", "Phase_Hep.CV", "Phase_Hep.PV") %in% colnames(res_param_gse145197$param_wide)))
saveRDS(res_param_gse145197, gse145197_param_file)
```

## Rhythm modules

```{r GSE145197_rhythm_modules}
res_module_gse145197 <- infer_rhythm_module(
  param_wide = res_param_gse145197$param_wide,
  compare_by = "celltype",
  group1 = "Hep.CV",
  group2 = "Hep.PV",
  tau_q = 0.05,
  tau_A = 0.25,
  tau_dA = 1,
  tau_dphi = pi / 6,
  Verbose = TRUE
)

stopifnot(identical(unique(as.character(res_module_gse145197$module_result$group1)), "Hep.CV"))
stopifnot(identical(unique(as.character(res_module_gse145197$module_result$group2)), "Hep.PV"))

saveRDS(res_module_gse145197, gse145197_module_file)
utils::write.csv(res_module_gse145197$module_result, file.path(gse145197_root, "GSE145197_module_result.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
utils::write.csv(res_module_gse145197$module_summary, file.path(gse145197_root, "GSE145197_module_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
utils::write.csv(res_module_gse145197$input_diagnostics, file.path(gse145197_root, "GSE145197_module_input_diagnostics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

res_module_gse145197$module_summary
table(res_module_gse145197$input_diagnostics$complete_parameters)
```

# B_cell_phase_density
```{r GSE145197_panel_B}
res_phase_gse145197 <- readRDS(gse145197_phase_file)
theta_gse145197 <- stats::setNames(as.numeric(res_phase_gse145197$theta_pred), res_phase_gse145197$cell)
phase_gse145197 <- gse145197_meta %>%
  dplyr::transmute(cell, celltype = factor(as.character(celltype), levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV")), theta_pred = theta_gse145197[cell] %% (2 * pi)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(theta_pred))

circ_density_gse145197 <- function(theta_vec, celltype_name, n_grid = 720, bw = 0.35) {
  theta_ext <- c(theta_vec - 2 * pi, theta_vec, theta_vec + 2 * pi)
  dens <- stats::density(theta_ext, from = 0, to = 2 * pi, n = n_grid, bw = bw)
  tibble::tibble(theta = dens$x, density = dens$y, celltype = celltype_name)
}
density_gse145197 <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  circ_density_gse145197(phase_gse145197$theta_pred[phase_gse145197$celltype == "Hep.CV"], "Hep.CV"),
  circ_density_gse145197(phase_gse145197$theta_pred[phase_gse145197$celltype == "Hep.PV"], "Hep.PV")
) %>% dplyr::mutate(celltype = factor(celltype, levels = c("Hep.CV", "Hep.PV")))

p_gse145197_B <- ggplot2::ggplot(density_gse145197, ggplot2::aes(x = theta, y = density, color = celltype)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 3) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = gse145197_pal, name = NULL) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2 * pi), breaks = c(0, pi / 2, pi, 3 * pi / 2, 2 * pi), labels = c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2", "2π"), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "Cell Phase distribution", x = expression("Predicted phase " * phi), y = "Cell density") +
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 14, base_family = "Arial") +
  ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16), axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"), axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"), axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12), legend.position = "top", legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12))
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(gse145197_panel_root, "B_cell_phase_density.pdf"), p_gse145197_B, width = 6.8, height = 4.8, device = grDevices::cairo_pdf, family = "Arial")
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(gse145197_panel_root, "B_cell_phase_density.png"), p_gse145197_B, width = 6.8, height = 4.8, dpi = 300)
```

# C_cell_phase_rose
```{r GSE145197_panel_C}
plot_phase_rose_gse145197 <- function(df_one, celltype_name, fill_col, rmax_fix, n_bin = 24) {
  breaks_theta <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_bin + 1)
  mids_theta <- (breaks_theta[-1] + breaks_theta[-length(breaks_theta)]) / 2
  h <- hist(df_one$theta_pred, breaks = breaks_theta, plot = FALSE)
  plot_df <- tibble::tibble(theta_mid = mids_theta, count = h$counts, prop = h$counts / sum(h$counts)) %>% dplyr::mutate(label = dplyr::if_else(count > 0, as.character(count), ""))
  ggplot2::ggplot(plot_df, ggplot2::aes(x = theta_mid, y = prop)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(width = 2 * pi / n_bin * 0.94, fill = fill_col, alpha = 0.9, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(y = prop + rmax_fix * 0.035, label = label), size = 3, fontface = "bold", family = "Arial") +
    ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.35, y = rmax_fix * 0.88, label = paste0("N = ", nrow(df_one)), size = 4.8, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, fontface = "bold", family = "Arial") +
    ggplot2::coord_polar(start = 0, direction = 1, clip = "off") +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2 * pi), breaks = seq(0, 2 * pi - 2 * pi / 8, length.out = 8), labels = c("0:00", "3:00", "6:00", "9:00", "12:00", "15:00", "18:00", "21:00")) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-rmax_fix * 0.22, rmax_fix * 1.18), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = celltype_name, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 15, base_family = "Arial") +
    ggplot2::theme(axis.title = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"), panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(), panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey80"), panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey88"), plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 17), plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(8, 8, 8, 8))
}
rmax_gse145197 <- phase_gse145197 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(celltype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(max_prop = max(hist(theta_pred, breaks = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 25), plot = FALSE)$counts / dplyr::n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::pull(max_prop) %>% max()
p_gse145197_C_cv <- plot_phase_rose_gse145197(dplyr::filter(phase_gse145197, celltype == "Hep.CV"), "Hep.CV", gse145197_pal["Hep.CV"], rmax_gse145197)
p_gse145197_C_pv <- plot_phase_rose_gse145197(dplyr::filter(phase_gse145197, celltype == "Hep.PV"), "Hep.PV", gse145197_pal["Hep.PV"], rmax_gse145197)
p_gse145197_C <- p_gse145197_C_cv | p_gse145197_C_pv
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(gse145197_panel_root, "C_cell_phase_rose.pdf"), p_gse145197_C, width = 8, height = 4, device = grDevices::cairo_pdf, family = "Arial")
```

```{r GSE145197_panel_D}
    dplyr::mutate(n = sum(df$value[df$Group == Group] >= threshold, na.rm = TRUE), log10_n = log10(n + 1)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(cum_df, ggplot2::aes(x = threshold, y = log10_n, color = Group)) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) + ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = gse145197_pal) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = title_text, x = if (metric == "Phase") "Phase (hour)" else "Amplitude", y = "Log10 Cumulative Number of Genes") +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 6, base_family = "Arial") + ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 7), legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(), legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 5))
  if (metric == "Phase") p + ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 24), breaks = c(0, 8, 16, 24)) else p + ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.4) + ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 4))
}

amp_density <- lapply(0:7, density_gse145197, metric = "Amplitude")
phase_density <- lapply(0:7, density_gse145197, metric = "Phase")
amp_cumulative <- lapply(0:7, cumulative_gse145197, metric = "Amplitude")
phase_cumulative <- lapply(0:7, cumulative_gse145197, metric = "Phase")
p_gse145197_D <- patchwork::wrap_plots(c(amp_density[1:4], phase_density[1:4], amp_density[5:8], phase_density[5:8], amp_cumulative[1:4], phase_cumulative[1:4], amp_cumulative[5:8], phase_cumulative[5:8]), ncol = 8)
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(gse145197_panel_root, "D_module_density_cumulative.pdf"), p_gse145197_D, width = 20, height = 10, device = grDevices::cairo_pdf, family = "Arial")
```

# E_core_clock_acrophase
```{r GSE145197_panel_E}
res_module_gse145197 <- readRDS(gse145197_module_file)
module_gse145197 <- res_module_gse145197$module_result
core_clock <- c("Arntl", "Clock", "Npas2", "Cry1", "Cry2", "Per1", "Per2", "Per3", "Nr1d1", "Nr1d2", "Dbp", "Tef", "Nfil3", "Ciart")
core_gse145197 <- module_gse145197 %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gene = tools::toTitleCase(tolower(gene))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% core_clock) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, dplyr::starts_with("Phase_"), dplyr::starts_with("Amplitude_"), dplyr::starts_with("FDR_")) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = c(".value", "celltype"), names_pattern = "^(Phase|Amplitude|FDR)_(Hep\\.CV|Hep\\.PV)$") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(phase_wrap = Phase %% (2 * pi), phase_hour = phase_wrap / (2 * pi) * 24) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::filter(sum(is.finite(Phase)) == 2) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()
gene_order <- core_gse145197 %>% dplyr::filter(celltype == "Hep.CV") %>% dplyr::arrange(phase_hour) %>% dplyr::pull(gene)
core_gse145197$gene <- factor(core_gse145197$gene, levels = gene_order)

plot_core_gse145197 <- function(gene_use) {
  df_sub <- dplyr::filter(core_gse145197, gene == gene_use) %>% dplyr::arrange(celltype) %>% dplyr::mutate(point_x = phase_wrap + c(-0.035, 0.035), point_y = 0.92)
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_point(data = df_sub, ggplot2::aes(x = point_x, y = point_y, fill = celltype), shape = 21, size = 5.8, stroke = 0.2, color = "black", alpha = 0.75) +
    ggplot2::geom_path(data = tibble::tibble(theta = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 400), r = 0.92), ggplot2::aes(x = theta, y = r), color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(data = tibble::tibble(theta = c(0, pi / 2, pi, 3 * pi / 2), r = 1.06, lab = c("0", "6", "12", "18")), ggplot2::aes(x = theta, y = r, label = lab), size = 3.2, fontface = "bold", family = "Arial") +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = gse145197_pal) +
    ggplot2::coord_polar(theta = "x", start = 0, direction = 1, clip = "off") +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2 * pi), breaks = NULL) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.1)) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = gene_use) +
    ggplot2::theme_void(base_size = 11, base_family = "Arial") +
    ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 11), legend.position = "none", plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(8, 8, 8, 8))
}
```

# H_Reactome_pathways
```{r GSE145197_panel_H}
res_module_gse145197 <- readRDS(gse145197_module_file)
module_gse145197 <- res_module_gse145197$module_result
reactome_dir <- file.path(gse145197_panel_root, "H_Reactome")
dir.create(reactome_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

universe_genes <- module_gse145197 %>%
  dplyr::filter(module_map != 0) %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
  unique() %>%
  intersect(rownames(gse145197_count))
module_gene_list <- split(module_gse145197$gene, module_gse145197$module_map)
module_info <- tibble::tribble(
  ~module_id, ~focus_celltype, ~module_label,
  1, "Shared", "Stable_Rhythm",
  2, "Hep.PV", "Rhythm_Gain",
  3, "Hep.CV", "Rhythm_Loss_in_Hep.PV",
  4, "Hep.PV", "Amplitude_Enhanced",
  5, "Hep.PV", "Amplitude_Attenuated",
  6, "Hep.PV", "Phase_Advanced",
  7, "Hep.PV", "Phase_Delayed"
)
universe_map <- clusterProfiler::bitr(universe_genes, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db)
universe_entrez <- unique(universe_map$ENTREZID)
reactome_list <- list()
reactome_summary <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(module_info))) {
  module_id <- module_info$module_id[i]
  genes_symbol <- unique(module_gene_list[[as.character(module_id)]]) %>% intersect(universe_genes)
  gene_map <- tryCatch(clusterProfiler::bitr(genes_symbol, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(gene_map) || nrow(gene_map) == 0) {
    reactome_summary[[as.character(module_id)]] <- tibble::tibble(module_id, status = "no_mapped_genes")
    next
  }
  ego_rt <- tryCatch(ReactomePA::enrichPathway(gene = unique(gene_map$ENTREZID), organism = "mouse", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", qvalueCutoff = 0.2, universe = universe_entrez), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(ego_rt) || nrow(ego_rt@result) == 0) {
    reactome_summary[[as.character(module_id)]] <- tibble::tibble(module_id, status = "no_terms")
    next
  }
  reactome_list[[as.character(module_id)]] <- tibble::as_tibble(ego_rt@result) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(module_id = module_id, focus_celltype = module_info$focus_celltype[i], module_label = module_info$module_label[i])
  reactome_summary[[as.character(module_id)]] <- tibble::tibble(module_id, status = "ok")
  readr::write_tsv(reactome_list[[as.character(module_id)]], file.path(reactome_dir, paste0("module", module_id, "_Reactome_full.tsv")))
}

reactome_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(reactome_list)
stopifnot(nrow(reactome_all) > 0)
saveRDS(reactome_list, file.path(reactome_dir, "GSE145197_Reactome_by_module.rds"))
readr::write_tsv(dplyr::bind_rows(reactome_summary), file.path(reactome_dir, "GSE145197_Reactome_summary.tsv"))

module_label_map <- c("1" = "M1 Stable Rhythm", "2" = "M2 Rhythm Gain", "3" = "M3 Rhythm Loss", "4" = "M4 Amp Enhanced", "5" = "M5 Amp Attenuated", "6" = "M6 Phase Advanced", "7" = "M7 Phase Delayed")
module_pal <- c("M1 Stable Rhythm" = "#8FA9C9", "M2 Rhythm Gain" = "#DDA17E", "M3 Rhythm Loss" = "#5F84B3", "M4 Amp Enhanced" = "#CC735E", "M5 Amp Attenuated" = "#C9D7E8", "M6 Phase Advanced" = "#E8D9B8", "M7 Phase Delayed" = "#325F97")
use_pathway <- reactome_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(module_id, module_label, focus_celltype) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p.adjust, dplyr::desc(Count), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(module_show = factor(module_label_map[as.character(module_id)], levels = unname(module_label_map)), neglog10_p = -log10(pvalue), Description_wrapped = as.character(Description)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(module_show, p.adjust, dplyr::desc(Count)) %>%
  tibble::rowid_to_column("index") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(y_show_chr = make.unique(Description_wrapped), y_show = factor(y_show_chr, levels = rev(y_show_chr)))

width <- 0.55
xaxis_max <- max(use_pathway$neglog10_p, na.rm = TRUE) + 1
rect.data <- use_pathway %>%
  dplyr::count(module_show, name = "n", .drop = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(module_show)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(xmin = -3.2 * width, xmax = -2 * width, ymax = cumsum(n), ymin = dplyr::lag(ymax, default = 0) + 0.6, ymax = ymax + 0.4)

p_gse145197_H <- ggplot2::ggplot(use_pathway, ggplot2::aes(x = neglog10_p, y = y_show, fill = module_show)) +
  gground::geom_round_col(width = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(x = 0.08, label = Description_wrapped), hjust = 0, size = 5.2, fontface = "bold", family = "Arial", color = "black") +
  ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(x = -width, size = Count), shape = 21, stroke = 0.6, fill = "white", color = "black") +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(x = -width, label = Count), size = 4, fontface = "bold", family = "Arial") +
  ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(name = "Count", range = c(4.5, 12)) +
  gground::geom_round_rect(data = rect.data, ggplot2::aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = module_show), alpha = 0.5, radius = grid::unit(2.5, "mm"), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(data = rect.data, ggplot2::aes(x = (xmin + xmax) / 2, y = (ymin + ymax) / 2, label = module_show), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4.2, fontface = "bold", angle = 90, family = "Arial") +
  ggplot2::annotate("segment", x = 0, y = 0, xend = xaxis_max, yend = 0, linewidth = 1.2) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = expression(-log[10](pvalue)), y = NULL, title = "Top enriched Reactome pathways across rhythmic modules") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(name = "Module", values = module_pal) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, xaxis_max, by = 2), expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  ggprism::theme_prism(base_family = "Arial") +
  ggplot2::theme(axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"), axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"), axis.line.y = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(), legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"), legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 13), plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 22, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

readr::write_tsv(use_pathway, file.path(reactome_dir, "H_Reactome_top5_for_plot.tsv"))
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(gse145197_panel_root, "H_Reactome_pathways.pdf"), p_gse145197_H, width = 14, height = 14, device = grDevices::cairo_pdf, family = "Arial")
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(gse145197_panel_root, "H_Reactome_pathways.png"), p_gse145197_H, width = 14, height = 14, dpi = 300)
```

# I_module_polar
```{r GSE145197_panel_I}
res_module_gse145197 <- readRDS(gse145197_module_file)
module_gse145197 <- res_module_gse145197$module_result
module_label_map <- c("0" = "M0 Non-rhythmic", "1" = "M1 Stable Rhythm", "2" = "M2 Rhythm Gain", "3" = "M3 Rhythm Loss", "4" = "M4 Amp Enhanced", "5" = "M5 Amp Attenuated", "6" = "M6 Phase Advanced", "7" = "M7 Phase Delayed")

polar_long <- module_gse145197 %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene,
    module_id = as.character(module_map),
    module_label = dplyr::recode(as.character(module_map), !!!module_label_map),
    Phase_Hep.CV, Phase_Hep.PV,
    Amplitude_Hep.CV, Amplitude_Hep.PV,
    FDR_Hep.CV, FDR_Hep.PV
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -c(gene, module_id, module_label), names_to = c(".value", "celltype"), names_pattern = "^(Phase|Amplitude|FDR)_(Hep\\.CV|Hep\\.PV)$") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(phase_wrap = Phase %% (2 * pi))

polar_keep <- polar_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene, module_id, module_label) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_celltype = sum(is.finite(Phase) & is.finite(Amplitude) & is.finite(FDR)),
    fdr_pv = FDR[celltype == "Hep.PV"][1], fdr_cv = FDR[celltype == "Hep.CV"][1],
    amp_pv = Amplitude[celltype == "Hep.PV"][1], amp_cv = Amplitude[celltype == "Hep.CV"][1],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    both_sig = fdr_pv < 0.05 & fdr_cv < 0.05,
    one_sig = xor(fdr_pv < 0.05, fdr_cv < 0.05),
    min_amp = pmin(amp_pv, amp_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_amp = pmax(amp_pv, amp_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
    keep_gene = dplyr::case_when(
      module_id %in% c("1", "4", "5", "6", "7") ~ n_celltype == 2 & both_sig & min_amp > 0.1,
      module_id %in% c("2", "3") ~ n_celltype >= 1 & one_sig & max_amp > 0.1,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

polar_df <- polar_long %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(dplyr::filter(polar_keep, keep_gene) %>% dplyr::select(gene, module_id, module_label), by = c("gene", "module_id", "module_label"))
amp_cap <- stats::quantile(polar_df$Amplitude, 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)
polar_df <- polar_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig_flag = FDR < 0.05,
    amp_clip = pmin(Amplitude, amp_cap),
    radius_raw = scales::rescale(amp_clip, to = c(0.18, 0.95), from = c(0, amp_cap)),
    radius = dplyr::if_else(module_id %in% c("2", "3") & !sig_flag, 0.12, radius_raw),
    x = radius * sin(phase_wrap), y = radius * cos(phase_wrap)
  )

polar_pair <- polar_df %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, celltype, phase_wrap, radius, x, y, Amplitude, FDR, sig_flag, module_id, module_label) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = celltype, values_from = c(phase_wrap, radius, x, y, Amplitude, FDR, sig_flag)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    delta_phase = atan2(sin(phase_wrap_Hep.CV - phase_wrap_Hep.PV), cos(phase_wrap_Hep.CV - phase_wrap_Hep.PV)),
    abs_delta_phase = abs(delta_phase),
    abs_delta_amp = abs(Amplitude_Hep.CV - Amplitude_Hep.PV),
    mean_amp = (Amplitude_Hep.CV + Amplitude_Hep.PV) / 2,
    max_amp = pmax(Amplitude_Hep.CV, Amplitude_Hep.PV, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_logfdr = -log10(FDR_Hep.CV + 1e-300) - log10(FDR_Hep.PV + 1e-300)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(module_id) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    z_phase = as.numeric(scale(abs_delta_phase)), z_amp = as.numeric(scale(abs_delta_amp)),
    z_mean = as.numeric(scale(mean_amp)), z_max = as.numeric(scale(max_amp)), z_fdr = as.numeric(scale(sum_logfdr))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rank_score = dplyr::case_when(
    module_id == "1" ~ z_mean + z_fdr - z_phase - z_amp,
    module_id %in% c("2", "3") ~ z_max,
    module_id %in% c("4", "5") ~ z_amp + 0.5 * z_mean + 0.5 * z_fdr - 0.5 * z_phase,
    module_id %in% c("6", "7") ~ z_phase + 0.5 * z_mean + 0.5 * z_fdr,
    TRUE ~ z_mean
  ))

top_gene_df <- polar_pair %>%
  dplyr::group_by(module_id) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(rank_score, n = 50, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, module_id)
polar_top <- polar_df %>% dplyr::inner_join(top_gene_df, by = c("gene", "module_id"))
polar_pair_top <- polar_pair %>% dplyr::inner_join(top_gene_df, by = c("gene", "module_id"))

circle_r <- c(0.18, 0.36, 0.54, 0.72, 0.95)
circle_path <- purrr::map_dfr(circle_r, ~tibble::tibble(t = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 400), x = .x * sin(t), y = .x * cos(t), r = .x))
angle_df <- tibble::tibble(angle = c(0, pi / 2, pi, 3 * pi / 2), xend = 0.98 * sin(angle), yend = 0.98 * cos(angle), lab_x = 1.16 * sin(angle), lab_y = 1.16 * cos(angle))
amp_breaks <- pretty(c(0, amp_cap), n = 4)
amp_breaks <- amp_breaks[amp_breaks >= 0 & amp_breaks <= amp_cap]
amp_tick_df <- tibble::tibble(amp = amp_breaks, x = scales::rescale(amp_breaks, to = c(0.18, 0.95), from = c(0, amp_cap)), label = format(round(amp_breaks, 2), nsmall = 2))
amp_legend_vals <- unique(amp_breaks[amp_breaks > 0])
amp_legend_vals <- amp_legend_vals[c(1, ceiling(length(amp_legend_vals) / 2), length(amp_legend_vals))]
amp_legend_sizes <- scales::rescale(sqrt(amp_legend_vals), to = c(3.8, 8.2), from = c(0, sqrt(amp_cap)))

plot_module_polar_gse145197 <- function(module_use) {
  df_sub <- dplyr::filter(polar_top, module_id == module_use)
  pair_sub <- dplyr::filter(polar_pair_top, module_id == module_use)
  is_gain_loss <- module_use %in% c("2", "3")
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_path(data = circle_path, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, group = r), color = "grey82", linewidth = 0.38) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(data = angle_df, ggplot2::aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = xend, yend = yend), color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.32) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(data = dplyr::filter(pair_sub, !is_gain_loss), ggplot2::aes(x = x_Hep.PV, y = y_Hep.PV, xend = x_Hep.CV, yend = y_Hep.CV), color = scales::alpha("grey55", 0.65), linewidth = 0.5) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(df_sub, celltype == "Hep.CV", sig_flag), ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, size = amp_clip), shape = 21, fill = gse145197_pal["Hep.CV"], color = "black", stroke = 0.24, alpha = 0.95) +
```

# GSE145197：补充 G 原始模块热图与 H Reactome（2026-10-24）

本节追加在原分析之后，不改动前面的结果。仅使用现有 phase、gene parameter、CV→PV module RDS 和完整 RNA count matrix；不重新推断相位、基因参数或模块。

## G：沿用原热图函数与完整图例

保留原函数的 LogNormalize、ScaleData、cyclic GAM（k=8、REML、60 点）、两组配对 z-score 和行排序。M0 中 Slc13a3、Tbx3os1 未被两组平滑共同保留，已输出排除清单；M1 有 3 个参考相位缺失的基因，按原函数保留在末端，不填补相位。已有逐模块检查点时直接读取，不重复表达平滑。

```{r GSE145197_original_G_heatmap_verified_20261024}
work<-"outputs/additional_analyses/figure5_OVR_A4_20261024"
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(Seurat);library(dplyr);library(readr);library(future)})
helper<-"outputs/liver/BCDF_restore_20261019.yfTH34/module_heatmap_fullRNA.R"
source(helper)
root<-"outputs/liver_GSE145197"
out<-file.path(root,"panels_ABCDEFHI_original_Rmd_20261024","G_original_module_heatmaps")
dir.create(out,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
obj<-qs::qread("data/circadian scLiver(Felix Naef).qs")
obj<-base::subset(obj,cells=colnames(obj)[as.character(obj$celltype)%in%c("Hep.CV","Hep.PV")])
DefaultAssay(obj)<-"RNA"
count_mat<-SeuratObject::GetAssayData(obj,assay="RNA",layer="counts")
res_phase<-readRDS(file.path(root,"GSE145197_infer_cell_phase.rds"))
gene_meta<-readRDS(file.path(root,"GSE145197_infer_rhythm_module_CV_to_PV.rds"))$module_result
cell_meta<-obj@meta.data[colnames(count_mat),,drop=FALSE]
cell_meta$celltype<-as.character(cell_meta$celltype)
cell_meta$theta_pred<-res_phase$theta_pred[match(rownames(cell_meta),res_phase$cell)]
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(res_phase$cell),identical(rownames(cell_meta),colnames(count_mat)),all(is.finite(cell_meta$theta_pred)),all(gene_meta$gene%in%rownames(count_mat)))
future::plan(future::multisession,workers=3)
for(m in 0:7){
 checkpoint<-file.path(out,paste0("G_module",m,"_original_heatmap.rds"))
 if(file.exists(checkpoint))next
 cat(format(Sys.time()),"Starting original heatmap module",m,"genes",sum(gene_meta$module_map==m),"\n")
 res_one<-build_scRhythm_module_heatmap(expr_mat=count_mat,gene_meta=gene_meta,cell_meta=cell_meta,group_by="celltype",theta_col="theta_pred",module_col="module_map",gene_col="gene",group_levels=c("Hep.CV","Hep.PV"),compare_groups=c("Hep.CV","Hep.PV"),module_ids=m,k=8,n_grid=60)
 res_one$input$expr_mat<-NULL
 res_one$input$count_source<-"data/circadian scLiver(Felix Naef).qs"
 saveRDS(res_one,checkpoint)
 readr::write_tsv(res_one$summary,file.path(out,paste0("G_module",m,"_heatmap_summary.tsv")))
 cat(format(Sys.time()),"Completed heatmap module",m,"\n")
}
future::plan(future::sequential)
parts<-lapply(0:7,function(m)readRDS(file.path(out,paste0("G_module",m,"_original_heatmap.rds"))))
res_ht<-parts[[1]]
res_ht$module_list<-do.call(c,lapply(parts,`[[`,"module_list"))
res_ht$summary<-dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(parts,`[[`,"summary"))
res_ht$input$module_ids<-0:7
stopifnot(identical(as.integer(res_ht$summary$n_gene_input),as.integer(table(factor(gene_meta$module_map,levels=0:7)))))
saveRDS(res_ht,file.path(out,"GSE145197_original_GAM_module_heatmaps.rds"))
readr::write_tsv(res_ht$summary,file.path(out,"G_module_heatmap_summary.tsv"))
excluded<-dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(0:7,function(m){z<-res_ht$module_list[[paste0("module",m)]];tibble::tibble(module_id=m,gene=setdiff(z$gene_pool,z$gene_keep),reason="not retained in both groups after original GAM prediction")}))
readr::write_tsv(excluded,file.path(out,"G_original_heatmap_excluded_genes.tsv"))
for(m in 0:7){
 grDevices::cairo_pdf(file.path(out,paste0("G_module",m,"_heatmap.pdf")),width=c(10,rep(12,7))[m+1],height=9,family="sans")
 plot(res_ht,module_id=m)
 grDevices::dev.off()
 grDevices::png(file.path(out,paste0("G_module",m,"_heatmap.png")),width=1600,height=1400,res=220)
 plot(res_ht,module_id=m)
 grDevices::dev.off()
}
writeLines(c("Executed the original build_scRhythm_module_heatmap and original plot method, unmodified.","Full RNA count matrix; LogNormalize scale factor 10000; original ScaleData; cyclic GAM k=8, REML, 60 phase coordinates; original paired row z scores and phase ordering.","Only expression smoothing was run. Saved cell phases, gene parameters and module assignments were not inferred again.",paste("Original heatmap helper MD5:",tools::md5sum(helper)),capture.output(sessionInfo())),file.path(out,"G_original_heatmap_methods_and_sessionInfo.txt"))
```

## H：从已保存模块进行真实 Reactome 富集

背景按原 Rmd 定义为 M1–M7 节律模块基因的并集，不包含 M0；映射至 Entrez 后为 5,514 个，Reactome 实际注释背景见各结果表 BgRatio。小鼠官方 SYMBOL 按大小写无关的唯一对应映射，歧义与未映射项均保留在映射清单。每个模块内对全部已检验通路进行 BH 校正；仅展示 p≤0.05、BH FDR≤0.05、q≤0.2 的前 5 条。此定义下 M1–M6 无显著通路，M7 有 127 条，图中只显示 M7 的前 5 条；不以未校正结果补满模块。完整检验表、富集对象和绘图数据均保存。

```{r GSE145197_Reactome_H_verified_20261024}
gse145197_work<-"outputs/additional_analyses/figure5_OVR_A4_20261024"
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(dplyr);library(ggplot2);library(svglite)})
gse145197_root<-"outputs/liver_GSE145197"
gse145197_panel_root<-file.path(gse145197_root,"panels_ABCDEFHI_original_Rmd_20261024")
reactome_dir<-file.path(gse145197_panel_root,"H_Reactome_verified_20261024")
dir.create(reactome_dir,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
module_gse145197<-readRDS(file.path(gse145197_root,"GSE145197_infer_rhythm_module_CV_to_PV.rds"))$module_result
count_genes<-readRDS(file.path(gse145197_work,"GSE145197_original_count_genes.rds"))
stopifnot(all(tolower(module_gse145197$gene)%in%tolower(count_genes)))
official<-AnnotationDbi::select(org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,keys=AnnotationDbi::keys(org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,keytype="SYMBOL"),columns="ENTREZID",keytype="SYMBOL")%>%
 dplyr::distinct(SYMBOL,ENTREZID)%>%dplyr::mutate(symbol_lower=tolower(SYMBOL))
ambiguous<-official%>%dplyr::group_by(symbol_lower)%>%dplyr::summarise(n_symbol=dplyr::n_distinct(SYMBOL),.groups="drop")%>%dplyr::filter(n_symbol>1)
gene_map<-module_gse145197%>%dplyr::select(gene,module_map)%>%dplyr::mutate(symbol_lower=tolower(gene))%>%
 dplyr::left_join(dplyr::anti_join(official,ambiguous,by="symbol_lower"),by="symbol_lower",relationship="many-to-many")%>%
 dplyr::mutate(mapping_status=dplyr::case_when(symbol_lower%in%ambiguous$symbol_lower~"ambiguous_case_mapping_excluded",is.na(ENTREZID)~"unmapped",TRUE~"mapped"))
readr::write_tsv(gene_map,file.path(reactome_dir,"GSE145197_SYMBOL_ENTREZ_mapping.tsv"))
universe_map<-gene_map%>%dplyr::filter(module_map!=0,mapping_status=="mapped")
universe_entrez<-unique(universe_map$ENTREZID)
readr::write_tsv(universe_map,file.path(reactome_dir,"GSE145197_rhythmic_M1_to_M7_universe.tsv"))
stopifnot(length(universe_entrez)>100)
module_label_map<-c("1"="M1 Stable Rhythm","2"="M2 Rhythm Gain","3"="M3 Rhythm Loss","4"="M4 Amp Enhanced","5"="M5 Amp Attenuated","6"="M6 Phase Advanced","7"="M7 Phase Delayed")
module_pal<-c("M1 Stable Rhythm"="#8FA9C9","M2 Rhythm Gain"="#DDA17E","M3 Rhythm Loss"="#5F84B3","M4 Amp Enhanced"="#CC735E","M5 Amp Attenuated"="#C9D7E8","M6 Phase Advanced"="#E8D9B8","M7 Phase Delayed"="#325F97")
reactome_list<-list();reactome_summary<-list();reactome_objects<-list()
for(module_id in 1:7){
 genes_symbol<-unique(module_gse145197$gene[module_gse145197$module_map==module_id])
 genes_entrez<-gene_map%>%dplyr::filter(module_map==module_id,mapping_status=="mapped")%>%dplyr::pull(ENTREZID)%>%unique()
 cat("Reactome module",module_id,"input",length(genes_symbol),"mapped Entrez",length(genes_entrez),"universe",length(universe_entrez),"\n")
 ego_rt<-ReactomePA::enrichPathway(gene=genes_entrez,organism="mouse",pvalueCutoff=1,pAdjustMethod="BH",qvalueCutoff=1,universe=universe_entrez,minGSSize=10,maxGSSize=500,readable=FALSE)
 if(is.null(ego_rt)){
  reactome_summary[[as.character(module_id)]]<-tibble::tibble(module_id,n_input=length(genes_symbol),n_entrez=length(genes_entrez),n_tested_terms=0,n_BH_005=0,n_display_eligible=0,status="no_testable_terms")
  next
 }
 result<-tibble::as_tibble(ego_rt@result)%>%dplyr::mutate(module_id=module_id,module_label=unname(module_label_map[as.character(module_id)]))
 result<-result%>%dplyr::mutate(display_eligible=is.finite(pvalue)&is.finite(p.adjust)&is.finite(qvalue)&pvalue<=0.05&p.adjust<=0.05&qvalue<=0.2)
 reactome_objects[[as.character(module_id)]]<-ego_rt
 reactome_list[[as.character(module_id)]]<-result
 readr::write_tsv(result,file.path(reactome_dir,paste0("module",module_id,"_Reactome_full.tsv")))
 reactome_summary[[as.character(module_id)]]<-tibble::tibble(module_id,n_input=length(genes_symbol),n_entrez=length(genes_entrez),n_tested_terms=nrow(result),n_BH_005=sum(result$p.adjust<=.05,na.rm=TRUE),n_display_eligible=sum(result$display_eligible),status=if(any(result$display_eligible))"significant_terms_available"else"no_significant_terms")
}
saveRDS(reactome_objects,file.path(reactome_dir,"GSE145197_Reactome_enrichResult_objects.rds"))
saveRDS(reactome_list,file.path(reactome_dir,"GSE145197_Reactome_by_module.rds"))
reactome_all<-dplyr::bind_rows(reactome_list)
readr::write_tsv(dplyr::bind_rows(reactome_summary),file.path(reactome_dir,"GSE145197_Reactome_summary.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(reactome_all,file.path(reactome_dir,"GSE145197_Reactome_all_tested_terms.tsv"))
use_pathway<-reactome_all%>%dplyr::filter(display_eligible)%>%dplyr::group_by(module_id,module_label)%>%
 dplyr::arrange(p.adjust,dplyr::desc(Count),.by_group=TRUE)%>%dplyr::slice_head(n=5)%>%dplyr::ungroup()%>%
 dplyr::mutate(module_show=factor(module_label_map[as.character(module_id)],levels=unname(module_label_map)),neglog10_p=-log10(pmax(pvalue,.Machine$double.xmin)),Description_wrapped=stringr::str_wrap(as.character(Description),width=30))%>%
 dplyr::arrange(module_show,p.adjust,dplyr::desc(Count))%>%tibble::rowid_to_column("index")%>%
 dplyr::mutate(y_show_chr=make.unique(Description_wrapped),y_show=factor(y_show_chr,levels=rev(y_show_chr)))
readr::write_tsv(use_pathway,file.path(reactome_dir,"H_Reactome_top5_for_plot.tsv"),quote="needed")
stopifnot(nrow(use_pathway)>0,all(use_pathway$display_eligible))
width<-1.4;xaxis_max<-max(use_pathway$neglog10_p)+1
rect.data<-use_pathway%>%dplyr::count(module_show,name="n",.drop=TRUE)%>%dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(module_show))%>%
 dplyr::mutate(xmin=-3.2*width,xmax=-2*width,ymax=cumsum(n),ymin=dplyr::lag(ymax,default=0)+0.6,ymax=ymax+0.4)
p_gse145197_H<-ggplot2::ggplot(use_pathway,ggplot2::aes(x=neglog10_p,y=y_show,fill=module_show))+
 gground::geom_round_col(width=1,alpha=0.5)+
 ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(x=0.08,label=Description_wrapped),hjust=0,size=5.2,fontface="bold",family="Arial",color="black")+
 ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(x=-width,size=Count),shape=21,stroke=0.6,fill="white",color="black")+
 ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(x=-width,label=Count),size=4,fontface="bold",family="Arial")+
 ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(name="Count",range=c(10,13))+
 gground::geom_round_rect(data=rect.data,ggplot2::aes(xmin=xmin,xmax=xmax,ymin=ymin,ymax=ymax,fill=module_show),alpha=0.5,radius=grid::unit(2.5,"mm"),inherit.aes=FALSE)+
 ggplot2::geom_text(data=rect.data,ggplot2::aes(x=(xmin+xmax)/2,y=(ymin+ymax)/2,label=module_show),inherit.aes=FALSE,size=4.2,fontface="bold",angle=90,family="Arial")+
 ggplot2::annotate("segment",x=0,y=0,xend=xaxis_max,yend=0,linewidth=1.2)+
 ggplot2::labs(x=expression(-log[10](pvalue)),y=NULL,title="Top enriched Reactome pathways\nacross rhythmic modules")+
 ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(name="Module",values=module_pal)+
 ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0,xaxis_max,by=2),expand=ggplot2::expansion(mult=c(0,0.08)))+
 ggprism::theme_prism(base_family="Arial")+
 ggplot2::theme(axis.text.y=ggplot2::element_blank(),axis.title.x=ggplot2::element_text(size=16,face="bold"),axis.text.x=ggplot2::element_text(size=13,face="bold"),axis.line.y=ggplot2::element_blank(),axis.ticks.y=ggplot2::element_blank(),legend.title=ggplot2::element_text(size=15,face="bold"),legend.text=ggplot2::element_text(size=13),plot.title=ggplot2::element_text(size=20,face="bold",hjust=.5))
saveRDS(p_gse145197_H,file.path(gse145197_panel_root,"H_original_style_plot.rds"))
cairo_pdf(file.path(gse145197_panel_root,"H_Reactome_pathways.pdf"),width=7,height=7,family="Arial")
```
